Conclusion: "更新是否只改了声明的部分"与"改了多少"是两个不同的统计问题，泄漏可被构造为可用无标注数据检验的成对量并给出样本成本界与可组合的终身漂移证书。实践上，声明式更新的合规性难以靠常规手段达成：泄漏几乎由范围外 KL 决定，只有在部署分布上蒸馏原模型决策的"锚定"式更新才能以可接受的样本量通过认证，且该结论限于决策型输出。

Abstract: Deployed language models are updated continually, and regulators increasingly accept changes that were declared in advance. Showing that an update changed behavior only where it was declared to is a different statistical problem from bounding how much it changed: a useful update is meant to change some decisions, so global disagreement and regression bounds cannot certify it. We formalize the problem with declared change envelopes. Before training, the developer commits to a region of inputs, and every decision that changes outside it counts as leakage. Leakage compares two models, so it can be certified from unlabeled traffic with anytime-valid tests whose sample cost we bound from above and below, and per-update certificates compose into a bound on lifetime drift outside all declared scopes. We measure leakage for LoRA and full fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and knowledge editing on models from 1.5B to 72B parameters. Narrow updates leak widely: domain and policy LoRA updates keep only about 7-36% of the decisions they change inside the declared scope. Across 256 trained variants, leakage tracks the update's KL divergence to the incumbent on out-of-scope inputs (Spearman 0.94). None of the customary remedies we tested makes a rule-like update certifiable without giving up much of its intended change. Distilling the incumbent's decisions on unlabeled prompts in the deployment format does: anchored LoRA, GRPO, and (at a small learning rate) full fine-tuning updates certify 5% leakage from a few hundred to a few thousand unlabeled samples, and the certificates replicate on held-out traffic and on written answers. The certificates cover decision-like outputs only; on open-ended chat, re-batching alone changes 11-21% of responses and no update certifies. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/declared-change-envelopes

</details>


### [253] [An Information Budget for Label-Noise Memorization, and What Statistical Complexity Tracks: A Study with Multilayer Perceptrons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04199)
*Nancy Baygorrea C.,Otávio da Fonseca Martins Gomes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多层感知机对标签噪声的记忆量随时间的变化，提出用归一化记忆信息（在噪声独立条件下具有零总体零假设）替代原始记忆比例 M，并在89次MNIST运行中检验十个预设假设，发现统计复杂度峰值通常先于记忆阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始记忆比例 M 缺乏总体上界与零假设基准，难以判断"网络记住了多少噪声、何时记住"，作者希望引入统计复杂度与信息论量来更严格地刻画预测中的记忆成分。

Method: 将预测信息分解为信号、记忆、异质性三项；给出Fano型界；用归一化记忆信息刻画记忆量；在89次MNIST运行中检验十个预设假设，并做280次探索性扩展（Fashion-MNIST、pair-flip噪声、四种训练变体）。

Result: 归一化记忆信息随 M 上升，在新噪声标签的留出样本上接近零，且接近Fano界；全标签替换错误时测试精度降至0.5%但预测仍含真实类信息；复杂度峰值在≤40%噪声率下先于记忆峰值，更高噪声率时落入记忆阶段且与置信度0.6时点无法区分；作为停止规则仅在低噪声下与既有规则相当，检测损坏样本不如简单无标签分数。pair-flip 噪声下结论不成立。

Conclusion: 统计复杂度与归一化记忆信息能提供比 M 更清晰的记忆度量，但结论受限于单一架构、两个小数据集与合成噪声，实用性（停止规则、损坏检测）有限。

Abstract: How much label noise has a network memorized, and when? We study a multilayer perceptron and what statistical complexity adds to a description of its predictions. Standard identities decompose predictive information into signal, memorization, and heterogeneity. The memorization term vanishes in the population under the stated noise-independence condition. A Fano-type bound relates it to training accuracies, but the memorized fraction M provides no upper bound. Across 89 MNIST runs with ten pre-specified hypotheses (five supported, four unsupported, one not testable), normalized memorization information rose with M on training samples, remained near zero on held-out samples with fresh noisy labels, and was close to its Fano bound. Unlike raw M, it has a zero population null under the independence condition and chance correction largely removed this difference. When every label was replaced by an incorrect class, test accuracy fell to 0.5%, yet predictions retained information about the true class. Mean statistical complexity peaked before memorization at corruption rates up to 40%. At higher rates, its peak fell within the memorization phase, near the epoch when mean training confidence reached 0.6 and the two could not be separated. As a stopping rule, it matched established rules only at low noise and detected corrupted samples less well than simple label-free scores. An exploratory extension of 280 runs covering Fashion-MNIST, pair-flip noise, and four training variants yielded similar results under uniform noise, but not pair-flip noise, where complexity peaked within two epochs. Conclusions are limited to this architecture, two small datasets, and synthetic noise.

</details>


### [254] [LENS: Reliability-Aware Stock Prediction via LLM-Extracted Priors and News-Driven Semantic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04217)
*Hao Zhou,Tiejun Ma,Luis Felipe Costa Sperb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LENS是一种静态—动态图框架，用LLM多轮抽取的置信度加权公司关系图和新闻驱动的语义图进行股票收益预测，并把关系可靠性作为一等信号建模，在S&P 500上AR@5提升16.4%、SR@5提升22.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN方法将每条关系边视为可信的二值事实，忽略了不同关系来源的异质可靠性，同时需兼顾公司间持久关系与时变市场信号。

Method: 静态侧：从LLM抽取多关系公司图，多轮聚合并以置信度加权降低低一致性边；动态侧：构建新闻驱动语义图，采用指数衰减时间聚合应对覆盖不均；再用上下文相关的门控融合模块在逐股票、逐日层面重平衡两图。

Result: S&P 500上AR@5提升16.4%、SR@5提升22.6%；NASDAQ 100上分别提升15.5%和20.9%；消融实验分离各组件贡献，人工验证支持关系抽取的有据性。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的LLM关系与新闻语义图提供互补信息，对基于图的金融预测有效。

Abstract: Predicting stock returns requires modeling persistent company relations and time-varying market signals. Graph Neural Network (GNN) approaches combine static priors with dynamic relational graphs, but treat every extracted edge as a trustworthy binary fact, ignoring heterogeneous reliability across relational sources. We propose LENS (LLM-Extracted priors and News-driven Semantics), a static--dynamic graph framework for stock return prediction and ranking that models relational reliability as a first-class signal across the pipeline. On the static side, we extract a multi-relational company graph from a Large Language Model and aggregate it over multiple runs with confidence weighting to downweight low-consistency edges. On the dynamic side, we build a news-driven semantic graph with exponential-decay temporal aggregation to capture changing market context under uneven coverage. A context-dependent gated fusion module rebalances the two graphs at the per-stock, per-day level. On S&P 500, LENS improves AR@5 by 16.4% and SR@5 by 22.6% over the strongest baseline, and on NASDAQ 100 it achieves comparable improvements (15.5% and 20.9% respectively). Ablations isolate each component's contribution, and a human-validation study of sampled relations supports that the aggregation is grounded, providing evidence that reliability-aware LLM relations and news-based semantic graphs carry complementary information for graph-based financial prediction.

</details>


### [255] [LIRA: A More Interpretable Dynamic Loss-Informed Rank Allocation for Low-Rank Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04239)
*Sihao Wang,Bozheng Li,Xuemiao Xu,Haoxin Yang,Yujie Xu,Jie Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LIRA，一种基于损失扰动的动态秩LoRA方法，用二阶近似估计每层LoRA因子变动引起的局部损失扰动幅度来为各层打分，使秩重分配可逐项解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准LoRA使用固定秩，忽略层与训练阶段的差异化适配需求；现有自适应秩方法多依赖启发式或一阶信号，秩重分配与局部损失行为之间只有间接联系，导致重分配的理由不够可解释。

Method: LIRA以二阶近似估计最近LoRA因子变动所对应的局部损失扰动幅度，据此对每层打分；周期性地用DELTA（基于位移的LoRA秩重分配算法）执行重分配，在匹配预算下产生离散有效秩，并兼容标准(A,B)适配器。同时比较了Trajectory EMA与Fixed-point Fisher两种估计方式。

Result: 在RoBERTa-base的GLUE数据集、La-LoRA/LoRA协议下，LIRA优于均匀LoRA及该协议下的自适应秩基线；Trajectory EMA以更低估计成本达到与Fixed-point Fisher相当的性能。

Conclusion: 以损失扰动为依据的秩分配能提升动态秩LoRA的可解释性且不牺牲性能，同时存在更廉价的估计方案，为参数高效微调中的秩调度提供了可解释路径。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large pretrained models. However, standard LoRA typically assigns a fixed rank profile despite layer- and stage-dependent adaptation needs, while recent adaptive-rank variants often rely on heuristic or first-order signals that provide only an indirect link between rank reallocation and local loss behavior. This leaves the rationale behind each rank reallocation insufficiently interpretable. Motivated by this gap, we propose LIRA (Loss-Informed Rank Allocation), a dynamic-rank LoRA method designed to make online rank reallocation more interpretable. LIRA scores each layer by the estimated magnitude of the local loss perturbation associated with its recent LoRA-factor movements under a second-order approximation, making the basis for each rank change interpretable term by term. By periodically applying DELTA (Displacement-Evaluated Loss-Trajectory Allocation), a displacement-based algorithm for LoRA rank reallocation, LIRA produces discrete effective ranks under matched budgets while remaining compatible with standard (A,B) adapters. On RoBERTa-base GLUE under the La-LoRA/LoRA protocol, LIRA outperforms the uniform-LoRA and adaptive-rank baselines reported under this protocol; Trajectory EMA attains performance competitive with Fixed-point Fisher at lower estimation cost.

</details>


### [256] [OmniST: Topology-Invariant Spatiotemporal Forecasting with Guaranteed-Coverage Uncertainty at Unseen Sensor Locations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04256)
*Praveg Vashishtha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OmniST，一种拓扑不变的时空预测器，计算零节点数结构依赖，结合归纳式 split-conformal 校准，可在任意（含未见）传感器位置给出有限样本覆盖率保证的预测区间，并随节点增删保持该保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准时空图卷积网络需固定尺寸邻接矩阵，模型权重与传感器数 N 耦合，无法在训练中缺席的传感器上产生输出，且缺乏分布无关的覆盖保证。

Method: 坐标基元标记化 + 每前向基于地理坐标的 kNN 注意力 + 双向 GRU 逐节点时序处理；再与归纳式 split-conformal 校准组合，并采用滚动自适应 conformal 应对时序漂移。

Result: 德里数据 30 天 PM2.5 MAE 31.0 μg/m³，移除 40% 站点仅退化 ≤1.1%；未见站点优于 kNN 插值约 12%、IGNNK 约 21%；30–50% 节点丢弃下四数据集三领域 90% 覆盖仍成立，325 真实传感器（PeMS-BAY）亦成立。静态 conformal 后期降至约 0.50，滚动自适应恢复至整体 0.89、后期 0.96（代价为更宽区间）。

Conclusion: 拓扑不变架构可实现节点数无关的泛化与未见传感器推断，配合归纳 conformal 提供可迁移的覆盖保证，并揭示需自适应校准以应对时序漂移。

Abstract: Standard spatiotemporal graph convolutional networks need a fixed-size adjacency matrix, coupling model weights to a specific sensor count N; they cannot produce any output at a sensor absent from training. We present OmniST, a topology-invariant forecaster whose computation has zero structural dependency on the number of nodes, and which, composed with inductive split-conformal calibration, gives distribution-free, coverage-guaranteed prediction intervals at arbitrary (including never-seen) sensor locations, preserving that guarantee as sensors are added or removed. Topology invariance follows from coordinate-based tokenization, k-nearest-neighbor attention from geographic coordinates at each forward pass, and per-node temporal processing via a bidirectional GRU. On real Delhi air-quality data (37 stations, 2019-2023), OmniST attains a 30-day PM2.5 MAE of 31.0 ug/m3 and degrades at most 1.1 percent when 40 percent of stations are removed. Its inductive forecasts at unseen stations beat nearest-neighbor interpolation (about 12 percent) and a learned kriging GNN (IGNNK, about 21 percent), and, unlike either, carry a finite-sample coverage guarantee. The guarantee holds at 90 percent or above under 30-50 percent node dropout across four real datasets over three domains (Delhi and Beijing air quality, NOAA GHCN weather, Caltrans PeMSD7-M traffic), and still holds at 325 real sensors (full PeMS-BAY). We also fix a temporal-drift failure: static conformal under-covers over time (about 0.50 late), but a rolling adaptive-conformal estimator restores target coverage (0.89 overall, 0.96 late) at the cost of wider intervals.

</details>


### [257] [Deep Learning Compilers: Architecture, Optimization, and Empirical Characterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04273)
*Jinghao Wen,Ruixuan Wang,Xun Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析深度学习编译器，按前端/中端/后端组织其架构与优化技术，并用PyTorch/TorchInductor在RTX A6000上实证评测图优化收益、编译开销与动态shape处理，指出编译器收益高度依赖负载特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DL模型日益复杂、硬件架构日趋异构，DL编译器对计算效率与可扩展部署至关重要，但缺乏对编译器架构演进、编译流程与优化技术的系统梳理，也缺少量化的实验证据支撑其实际效果判断。

Method: 将DL编译器架构划分为前端、中端、后端三阶段，重点讨论中端在高层模型表示与硬件特定优化之间的桥梁作用；梳理代表性DL编译器及各编译阶段的近期优化技术；并基于PyTorch/TorchInductor在NVIDIA RTX A6000上进行实证评测，考察图优化、编译开销与动态shape处理。

Result: 编译器收益强依赖工作负载特征：融合友好的计算图最高获得8.21倍加速，其他负载提升有限；编译开销需数千次执行才能摊销；动态shape编译将累积shape切换开销降低约70%，但稳态性能略有下降。

Conclusion: 通过系统性架构分析与定量实验相结合，本文为现代DL编译器的设计、优化与实际部署提供了洞见。

Abstract: As deep learning (DL) models become increasingly complex and hardware architectures grow more heterogeneous, DL compilers play a critical role in optimizing computational efficiency and enabling scalable deployment. This paper presents a systematic analysis of DL compilers, covering their architectural evolution, compilation workflows, optimization techniques, and emerging research directions. We organize DL compiler architectures into frontend, middle-end, and backend stages, emphasizing the role of the middle-end in connecting high-level model representations with hardware-specific optimizations. We further examine representative DL compilers and recent optimization techniques across different compilation stages. Beyond architectural and technical analysis, we conduct an empirical evaluation of compiler behaviors to investigate the effectiveness of graph optimization, compilation overhead, and dynamic-shape handling. Experiments using PyTorch/TorchInductor on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 demonstrate that compiler benefits depend strongly on workload characteristics, with speedups of up to 8.21\times for fusion-friendly computation graphs, while other workloads exhibit limited improvements. Our results further reveal that compilation overhead can require thousands of executions to amortize, and dynamic-shape compilation reduces cumulative shape-transition costs by approximately 70\% at the expense of modest steady-state performance degradation. By combining systematic architectural analysis with quantitative experimental evidence, this work provides insights into the design, optimization, and practical deployment of modern DL compilers.

</details>


### [258] [Reciprocity Can Erase Direction:tructural Boundaries and Controlled Utility of Magnetic Graph Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04295)
*Dawei Han,Zicheng Wang,Yaoxing Ren,Yi Lv,Rongqian Wu,Fumin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析了支撑式磁拉普拉斯(Magnetic Laplacian)在可学习图中可能"擦除"方向机制的问题，给出理论刻画与机制检验实验，并强调磁相位仅在特定条件下保留有用方向信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁图网络通过相位编码方向，但可学习图可能在预测前破坏原本的方向机制，这一失效缺乏清晰刻画；同时需区分"方向被擦除"与"任务效用未被确立"两种情形。

Method: 针对基于支撑(support)的磁拉普拉斯给出精确恒等式，联系虚部能量、与零相位距离和幅度加权互易性；分析Top-k选择在观测节点数m≤k+1时的完全坍缩及稠密支撑对互易弧比例的下界；构造节点特征与对称幅度相同但标签相反的传播对，证明方向擦除表示存在可证的机会水平上限；并进行72次固定神经网络拟合的机制检验及DeepDRiD公开数据集的验证研究。

Result: 支撑相位在单向环上测试AUROC为1.0000，但在互易环与完全支撑上降至0.5000；连续分数相位与实值有向对照模型始终保持1.0000；所有模型均通过无方向对照。DeepDRiD中连续相位有效，但其相对零相位的稳健性差异仅为+0.0036（95%区间-0.0014至+0.0095）。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了区分"方向被擦除"与"任务效用未确立"的结构性与实验性框架，精确刻画了磁相位保留有用信息的条件，但不主张普遍的或临床上的优越性。

Abstract: Magnetic graph networks encode direction through phase, but a learned graph can erase the intended directional mechanism before prediction. We characterize this failure for support-based magnetic Laplacians. Exact identities relate imaginary energy and distance from zero phase to amplitude-weighted reciprocity. Top-$k$ selection forces complete collapse when the observed-node count satisfies $m\leq k+1$, and dense support imposes a lower bound on reciprocal-arc fraction. We then construct paired propagation examples with identical node features and symmetric amplitudes but opposite labels, giving a provable chance-level limit for direction-erasing representations. In 72 fixed neural fits, support phase achieved test AUROC 1.0000 on a unilateral ring but 0.5000 on reciprocal ring and complete supports; continuous score phase and a real directed comparator achieved 1.0000 throughout. All models solved the direction-free control. These are oracle-direction mechanism tests, not evidence of learned clinical direction. In the preserved public DeepDRiD development study, continuous phase was active but its robustness difference from zero phase was only $+0.0036$ (descriptive 95\% interval $-0.0014$ to $+0.0095$) on validation patients used for checkpoint selection. The contribution is a structural and experimental framework for distinguishing erased direction from unestablished task utility. It provides a precise circumstance in which magnetic phase preserves useful information, without asserting universal or clinical superiority.

</details>


### [259] [What Is the Influence of Task Order in Continual Learning? An Empirical Study and Order-Aware Evaluation for Motion Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04309)
*Zirui Li,Yunlong Lin,Haohan Yang,Xiaocong Zhao,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Task order accounts for 65–91% of variance in continual learning metrics, mostly due to the starting task; the paper argues benchmarks must declare order distributions and report order-resolved errors.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Aggregate scores of continual learning algorithms implicitly assume some task-order distribution that is rarely declared, so comparisons conflate order variation with training variation.

Method: Formulates algorithm comparison as an expectation over a declared order distribution; runs motion forecasting on four road-layout tasks from INTERACTION with all 24 task orders, 4 algorithms, 3 replicates (288 runs); uses a transition-direction descriptor from task statistics.

Result: Order explains 65–91% of variation in current-task error and backward transfer, 90–99% of which stems from the starting-task identity (smallest task fails from cold start). Beyond stage one, order effect is comparable to training variability. Leading algorithm is usually within one replicate SD of runner-up. Backward transfer depends on order mainly via its reference term; relative improvement and final error pick different leaders for displacement error. Order reweighting by the descriptor leaves ranking unchanged.

Conclusion: Benchmarks should declare their order distribution and report order-resolved, starting-task-resolved, warm-start, and final errors alongside aggregate scores; code and data are released.

Abstract: Aggregate scores for continual learning algorithms rest on a distribution over task orders that is rarely stated. We formulate algorithm comparison as an expectation over a declared order distribution, which separates training variation from order variation, and apply it to motion forecasting with four road-layout tasks from the INTERACTION dataset, all 24 task orders, four algorithms, and three training replicates (288 runs). Task order accounts for 65\% to 91\% of the variation in current-task error and backward transfer, and 90\% to 99\% of this order effect comes from the identity of the starting task: the smallest task cannot be learned from a cold start. Beyond the first stage, the order effect is comparable to training variability. In most orders, the leading algorithm in current-task error and backward transfer is within one replicate standard deviation of the runner-up. Backward transfer depends on the order mainly through its reference term, which weights the first task most heavily, so relative improvement and final error identify different leading algorithms for displacement error. A transition-direction descriptor computed from task statistics tracks the position of the smallest task, and weighting orders by it leaves the algorithm ranking unchanged. These results call for benchmarks that declare their order distribution and report order-resolved, starting-task-resolved, warm-start, and final errors alongside aggregate scores. The code and data are available \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/task-order-cl-4f7b/}{here}.

</details>


### [260] [Coarse Semantic Blocks for Efficient Training-Free Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04313)
*Sosuke Kobayashi,Shoichiro Yamaguchi,Seiya Tokui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练稀疏注意力方法：用提示特定的语义块索引（跨非连续位置的 token 聚成大块），让 long-context LLM 的 prefill 与 decoding 都加速，同时保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文场景下稠密注意力代价过高，而现有稀疏注意力要么需训练、要么块小/预算小导致加速与精度难以兼得；作者希望一种免训练方案能同时加速 prefill 与 decoding 并保持准确率。

Method: 构建 prompt 专属的 key 索引：将 key 聚类为跨非连续位置的大型语义块；每个 query 位置通过质心打分选块，再在块内对原始 key/value 做注意力；选择同一块的 query 被分组批量处理，大块使质心打分和分组处理开销很低。

Result: 在单张 H200 上评估 Qwen3.5-4B 与 35B-A3B：含索引构建与使用开销在内，512K 时 prefill 提速 2.3–2.4x、decoding 1.7–2.0x，1M 时 prefill 2.9–3.0x；35B-A3B 在 RULER 五项（至 1M）、LongBench-v2、MRCR（至 256K）接近稠密；4B 主要在多键检索上掉精度，但三项基准均优于延迟相近的稠密 Qwen3.5-2B。

Conclusion: 更大语义块 + 更大 token 预算可同时更快更准，优于小块小预算方案；该方法免训练即可在长上下文上实现显著端到端加速并基本保持精度。

Abstract: We introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. The method clusters the keys into large semantic blocks that group tokens from noncontiguous positions. Each query position selects blocks by scoring their centroids and attends to the original keys and values within them. Queries that select the same block are processed together, so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. Large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap, so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. Larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. We evaluate two hybrid LLMs, Qwen3.5-4B and 35B-A3B, on one NVIDIA H200. Including the cost of building and using the index, whole-model wall-clock speedups over dense attention are 2.3-2.4x for prefill and 1.7-2.0x for decoding at 512K tokens, and 2.9-3.0x for prefill at 1M. The 35B-A3B model stays close to dense attention on five RULER tasks through 1M, on LongBench-v2 overall, and on MRCR through 256K. The 4B model loses accuracy mainly on multi-key retrieval, yet outperforms dense Qwen3.5-2B, whose latency is similar at 512K, on all three benchmarks.

</details>


### [261] [Anchor: Augmented Cross-Layer Recurrent State for Long-Context Retrieval in Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04327)
*Vimal William,Yuanzhe Li,Danella Zhao,Huanrui Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Anchor：发现混合注意力+循环记忆模型的检索能力稀疏分布在少数"锚层"，其余层状态信息冗余且仅经层特定变换表达；据此只在锚层放置TTT记忆，并设计跨层共享循环状态（写一次、多层读取，每层用学习读映射实现拉伸与旋转），在大幅压缩状态与降低延迟的同时提升长上下文检索与MMLU准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数高效线性化（如SWA+TTT循环记忆的混合模型）虽高效，但并非每层循环状态都对长上下文检索有贡献。作者希望探明循环状态在深度方向上的作用分布，以便消除冗余、进一步降低状态规模与计算开销，同时不损失长上下文检索能力。

Method: 1）对SWA+TTT混合模型做逐层分析：检索能力在深度上稀疏，集中在少数锚层；非锚层循环状态携带相似信息，仅为层特定变换。2）基于此设计Anchor：仅在锚层保留TTT循环记忆；引入跨层共享循环状态，写一次、由多个层读取，每层通过各自学习的读映射（层特定拉伸stretch与旋转rotation）读取。3）验证该思路可推广到其他混合注意力形式。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B与Mistral-7B上，相比LoLCATs，Anchor的循环状态缩小10倍的情况下召回率提升2.3–3.1倍、MMLU准确率高6.7–8.9分；保留教师模型MMLU准确率的91–95%；端到端延迟相对softmax注意力最多降低4.3倍。

Conclusion: 循环检索能力在深度上稀疏、状态信息高度冗余，可被显式利用；Anchor通过锚层TTT记忆+跨层共享状态与层特定读映射，实现了更小状态、更强长上下文检索与更低延迟的参数高效线性化，且具有向其他混合注意力推广的潜力。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient linearization turns a pretrained autoregressive Transformer into an efficient model by hybridizing sliding-window attention (SWA) with a constant-size recurrent memory. But does every layer's recurrent state contribute to long-context retrieval? Investigating an SWA and Test-Time Training (TTT) hybrid, we find that retrieval is sparse across depth, concentrated in a few anchor layers, and that the remaining states hold similar information expressed through layer-specific transformations. We exploit both observations in Anchor: TTT memory placed only at the anchor layers, and a cross-layer recurrent state written once and read by many layers, each through its own learned read map that realizes a layer-specific stretch and rotation, along with demonstrated generalization to other hybrid attentions. On Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, Anchor delivers 2.3-3.1x higher recall and 6.7-8.9 points higher MMLU accuracy than LoLCATs with a 10x smaller recurrent state, retains 91-95% of the teacher's MMLU accuracy, and cuts end-to-end latency by up to 4.3x relative to softmax attention.

</details>


### [262] [Proper Agnostic Learning of Affine Halfspaces under Log-Concave Marginals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04344)
*Zhijie Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在全维对数凹边缘分布下，给出首个带常数因子的不可知（agnostic）仿射半空间学习器，对任意二值标签返回误差≤ C·OPT+ε 的单个半空间，样本与算术复杂度均为多项式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前不可知学习仿射半空间的结果多依赖已知均值/协方差、高斯或isotropic假设，且噪声条件下条件化会造成误差放大；本文希望在对数凹边缘、未知均值协方差下实现常数因子不可知学习。

Method: 核心几何结论：对质量 p 的少数类半空间，全局不一致度与平衡限制上的不一致度在常数因子内相差 p 倍（当后者足够小时）。用噪声标签构造该限制：鲁棒估计少数类"帽"的均值与协方差、近似最小化经典 zonoid-depth 对偶目标、将超水平集扩展到边缘分位数。分析结合对数凹律的四次平方和（SoS）矩界与基于平移将平衡仿射学习归约到齐次半空间学习。

Result: 得到误差 ≤ C·OPT+ε 的单个仿射半空间；样本与实数算术复杂度关于维数、1/ε、log(1/δ) 均为多项式，样本复杂度对 log(1/δ) 可线性；无需已知边缘均值与协方差。

Conclusion: 不一致度比较抵消了条件化带来的噪声放大，使学习到的半空间可直接用于整个空间；该框架实现了对数凹分布下常数因子的不可知仿射半空间学习。

Abstract: We give a proper constant-factor agnostic learner for affine halfspaces under full-dimensional log-concave marginals. For arbitrary binary labels, the algorithm uses independent labeled samples and returns a single affine halfspace with error at most $C\mathrm{OPT}+\varepsilon$. Its sample and real-arithmetic complexity are polynomial in dimension, inverse accuracy, and the logarithm of the reciprocal failure probability. The mean and covariance of the marginal need not be known, and the sample complexity can be made linear in this logarithmic confidence factor. The main geometric result compares global disagreement with disagreement on a balanced restriction: for a minority halfspace of mass $p$, global disagreement is within universal constant factors of $p$ times conditional disagreement, provided the latter is sufficiently small. To construct the restriction from noisy labels, we estimate the minority cap's mean and covariance robustly, approximately minimize the classical zonoid-depth dual objective, and expand a superlevel set to a marginal quantile. The disagreement comparison cancels the noise amplification caused by conditioning and allows the learned halfspace to be used on the entire space. The analysis combines degree-four sum-of-squares moment bounds for log-concave laws with a translation-based reduction from balanced affine learning to homogeneous halfspace learning.

</details>


### [263] [Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04376)
*Hei Yi Mak,Hoang Le,Mehran Taghian Jazi,Yunke Peng,Huan Lin,Zhengzhi Tang,Zhexu Liu,Yao Wang,Yaoyuan Wang,Anandharaju Durai Raju,Tanzila Rahman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究FP4强化学习后训练在MoE大模型上的失效原因，发现MoE路由器离散选择使训练-推理对齐对"对称恢复"高度敏感，提出MoeResQ实现训练/推理两侧对称量化恢复，显著缩小与全精度的精度差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FP4 RL的恢复配方在密集模型上有效，但直接用于MoE时相比朴素FP4基线无改进，需查明根因。

Method: 深入分析指出根因是MoE特有的路由机制：路由器做离散专家选择，非对称恢复（如仅修正rollout侧）会破坏训练-推理策略对齐，用训练/推理概率的Pearson相关系数与路由选择匹配率衡量；据此提出MoeResQ，强制训练侧与推理侧修正对称。

Result: 非对称配方导致对齐急剧恶化；MoeResQ恢复训练-推理对齐，大幅缩小与全精度的精度差距。

Conclusion: 对称恢复是MoE模型FP4 RL的关键原则。

Abstract: In this work, we study end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. Recent work on FP4 RL has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models, but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive FP4 baseline in the MoE setting. We conduct an in-depth study to understand why. Our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to MoE: because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions, training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. When an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach, which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply, as measured by the Pearson correlation coefficient between training and inference probabilities, and router selection matching rates. Building on this finding, we propose MoeResQ, a quantization-recovery recipe for MoE RL post-training that enforces symmetry between the training- and inference-side corrections. MoeResQ restores training-inference alignment and substantially closes the accuracy gap to full precision, establishing symmetric recovery as the key principle in FP4 RL for MoE models.

</details>


### [264] [Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04434)
*Mostafa 'Neo' Mohsenvand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Unexpected Error


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1 validation error for Structure
conclusion
  Field required [type=missing, input_value={'tldr': '提出 Sketchpa...高层符号算法。'}, input_type=dict]
    For further information visit https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.10/v/missing

Method: N/A

Result: N/A

Conclusion: N/A

Abstract: Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots and greatest common divisors at arbitrary length. It solved 200 of 200 pre-registered problems in the browser, and 220 of 220 sums of up to 1,000 digits and products of up to 20 digits, of which GPT-6.1 Sol, the strongest of ten other models, solved 217. A symbolic runtime built on these procedures solves, expands and factors polynomials with every number computed by the model, and a multiplicative gate on the adapter recovers the base model exactly when the sheet is not in use.

</details>


### [265] [Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04449)
*Xin Liu,Boyuan Sun,Yuxin Wang,Haoran Song,Mingjian Zhao,Mengyu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文调查了开源权重语言模型仓库中"近零输入嵌入行"的普遍性，揭示其在未绑定权重（untied）的门控/混合模型中出现率达52.6%，并阐明其成因（罕见token零梯度+AdamW衰减）、放大机制（门控序列模型中梯度放大30+数量级、Pre-RMSNorm逐层放大）及导致梯度裁剪溢出使更新被丢弃的后果，最后提出GroupClip与GateFloor两种修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近零输入嵌入行在门控与混合架构的开源模型中广泛存在，可能引发灾难性的梯度爆炸与训练更新丢失，但此前缺乏系统性调查与机制解释，也缺少针对已发布检查点和预训练阶段的实用修复手段。

Method: 1) 调查291个开源权重仓库（280个不同嵌入表），统计近零行分布；2) 分析成因：未见罕见/模板token输入梯度为零，AdamW权重衰减使untied嵌入收缩；3) 在Transformer与门控序列模型（Mamba、Gated DeltaNet、xLSTM）中复现并分析梯度放大链路（SiLU门/线性查询在零输入下消失、残差RMS低于RMSNorm下限、Pre-RMSNorm逐层放大、FP32全局范数裁剪溢出）；4) 提出GroupClip（解耦输入嵌入裁剪，64位或重缩放范数）与GateFloor（SiLU(z)+δ，δ∈[0.01,0.1]）。

Result: 52.6%（20/38）的untied门控/混合检查点含范数低于1e-6的可达输入嵌入行，而weight-tied模型为0%；近零token可使输入嵌入梯度放大超30个数量级（最高35）；Pre-RMSNorm每层可放大反向梯度达1e3；梯度项超过1.84e19时FP32全局范数裁剪在PyTorch、HF Trainer、FSDP2中溢出为inf并清零整批梯度；Nemotron-3-Nano-4B泰卢固语持续预训练中约20%步骤更新被丢弃，触发行被冻结。GroupClip重缩放实现可一步消除更新丢失并修复触发行，端到端开销可忽略；GateFloor在至370M参数实验中将近零梯度降低28个数量级，困惑度与基线相当。

Conclusion: 近零输入嵌入行是门控/混合开源模型中普遍且可复现的隐患，可通过"零输入→门消失→状态读出抑制→Pre-RMSNorm放大→裁剪溢出→更新丢失"的完整链路解释；GroupClip适用于已发布检查点的修复，GateFloor适用于预训练阶段从根本上避免该失败模式，二者均具实用价值且代价可忽略。

Abstract: Among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20/38) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below $10^{-6}$, compared with 0% of weight-tied models. Such near-zero rows can arise during pretraining when unseen rare or template tokens receive zero input gradients while AdamW weight decay shrinks untied embeddings. In tested Transformer configurations, non-initial positions or a BOS token prevent this failure mode. In gated sequence models (Mamba, Gated DeltaNet, xLSTM), a near-zero token can amplify input-embedding gradients by more than 30 orders of magnitude (up to 35). At zero input, current-token readout factors (SiLU gates or linear queries) vanish, suppressing historical-state readout. Residual RMS values can then fall below the square root of the RMSNorm floor across consecutive layers, causing Pre-RMSNorm to amplify backward gradients by up to $10^3$ per layer. When a gradient entry exceeds $1.84 \times 10^{19}$, FP32 global-norm clipping in PyTorch, Hugging Face Trainer, and FSDP2 can overflow to infinity and zero the current batch's gradients. In Telugu continual pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, this discards updates on approximately 20% of steps and leaves triggered rows frozen. We propose two remedies. For released checkpoints, GroupClip decouples input-embedding clipping using a 64-bit or rescaled norm; its rescaled implementation eliminates update loss and heals triggered rows in one step with negligible measured end-to-end overhead. For pretraining, GateFloor ($\mathrm{SiLU}(z) + δ$, $δ\in [0.01, 0.1]$) keeps the gate positive at zero input, reducing near-zero gradients by 28 orders of magnitude in experiments up to 370M parameters, with perplexity comparable to the baseline.

</details>


### [266] [SaMA: Morpho Adaptation via Asymmetric Expansion of Kronecker Product](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04462)
*An Nguyen,Anh Tong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SaMA，一种基于Kronecker积推广的参数高效微调方法，突破LoRA在秩扩展和优化瓶颈上的两大局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA存在两个根本缺陷：(1)其不变流形在损失景观中引入平坦方向，给自适应优化器造成优化瓶颈；(2)有效秩仅随参数预算线性增长。

Method: 提出Scalable Morpho Adaptation (SaMA)，基于Kronecker积的原则性推广；通过放松perfect-shuffle分解中的共享块约束，使模型从低秩到满秩均可覆盖，实际秩随参数预算二次增长（最高达满秩）。理论上证明其不变流形坍缩为对角群，结构上更利于优化器。

Result: 在常识推理与算术推理基准上一致优于强PEFT基线，且参数效率更高。

Conclusion: SaMA通过Kronecker积推广同时改善秩扩展性与优化友好性，是一种更高效的PEFT方案。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has attracted significant attention in the parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) landscape. However, its design suffers from two fundamental limitations. First, its invariance manifold induces flat directions in the loss landscape, creating an optimization bottleneck for adaptive optimizers. Second, its effective rank scales only linearly with the parameter budget. In this paper, we propose Scalable Morpho Adaptation (SaMA), a PEFT method grounded in a principled generalization of the Kronecker product. By relaxing the shared-block constraint in the perfect-shuffle factorization, SaMA spans from low to full rank and achieves a practical rank that scales quadratically with the parameter budget, up to full-rank. Furthermore, we show that its invariance manifold collapses to a diagonal group, making it structurally more optimizer-friendly. Empirically, SaMA consistently outperforms strong PEFT baselines on commonsense and arithmetic reasoning benchmarks while being more parameter-efficient.

</details>


### [267] [Theoretical Analysis of Muon on Transformers for Next-Token Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04465)
*Shengwei Wu,Yixuan Yang,Gao Huang,Song Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了Muon优化器在Transformer下一词预测(NTP)任务中的训练动力学，分预处理阶段与主阶段刻画优化轨迹与收敛速率，解释了Muon高效学习的机制并给出泛化保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon在训练Transformer大模型时展现出强经验性能，但其优化动力学缺乏理论理解。作者希望从理论角度解释Muon为何有效。

Method: 将训练过程分为两阶段：预处理阶段学习输出-值(output-value)分量，主阶段学习key-query分量。对预处理阶段精确刻画优化轨迹，证明每次更新后归一化谱间隔最优；对主阶段在softmax注意力下建立训练损失与归一化间隔的非渐近收敛速率。

Result: 给出了预处理阶段谱间隔最优性的精确刻画，以及主阶段损失和归一化间隔差距的非渐近收敛速率；所学权重结构还带来对未见上下文的泛化保证，并在NTP实验上验证了理论。

Conclusion: Muon的更新规则能帮助模型高效学习哪些token对预测重要，可解释其在大模型训练中的优异表现，理论与实验相互印证。

Abstract: Muon has recently shown strong empirical performance in training Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), yet its optimization dynamics remain poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. In this paper, we analyze the training dynamics of Muon for next-token prediction (NTP) in Transformers. The training procedure consists of two phases: the preprocessing phase learns the output-value component, while the main phase learns the key-query component. For the preprocessing phase, we characterize the optimization trajectory exactly and show that the normalized spectral margin is optimal after each update. For the main phase, we establish nonasymptotic convergence rates for the training loss and the normalized margin gap under softmax attention. These results suggest that Muon's update rule can help models efficiently learn which tokens matter for prediction, offering a possible explanation for its strong performance in large language model training. The learned weight structure also yields a generalization guarantee for unseen contexts. Furthermore, we validate our theoretical insights with experiments on next-token prediction tasks.

</details>


### [268] [SKILL2STEER: One-Pass Hypernetwork for Mapping Natural-Language Skills to Low-Rank Post-Block Activation Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04497)
*Ran Li,Lei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验"编译后的技能产物携带技能内容"这一假设并加以否定，发现技能编译实际带来的是领域通用的行为先验；据此提出 SKILL2STEER，用一次性超网络将技能文档映射为低秩激活偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将自然语言智能体技能编译进模型参数可摆脱提示词并得到可分发的轻量产物，但已有方法都假定该产物承载了技能内容本身，这一假设从未被检验。

Method: 在检索智能体上设计三项控制实验（错误技能文档、单一平均化技能包、同范数随机方向）检验上述假设；随后提出 SKILL2STEER：一个仅在校验/编译阶段运行的一次性超网络，读取技能文档并输出低秩激活偏移，加到每个解码器块的输出上，基座权重冻结。

Result: 控制实验显示错误技能与正确技能表现相当、平均化技能包在双侧等价检验下与逐技能路由无差异、同范数随机方向退化到无注入基线，说明训练出的方向仍起关键作用但内容不特异。每个技能仅编译为 2.36M 参数，比权重空间适配器少 9.25 倍；在 SearchQA 七数据集基准上达到 37.9 EM，比冻结模型高 9.8 点、比参数多 9.25 倍的权重空间方法高 2.3 点。

Conclusion: 技能编译产生的是领域通用行为先验而非技能内容，SKILL2STEER 以更少参数、无路由的单一技能包实现了更强的检索智能体性能。

Abstract: Compiling a natural-language agent skill into model parameters removes the skill text from the prompt and leaves behind a small artifact that can be distributed and reused. Existing methods differ in where they inject the compiled quantity, and all of them assume that the artifact carries the content of the skill. We test that assumption. Through three controls on a retrieval agent, we find that a compiled skill shift carries a domain-general behavioural prior, not the content of the skill. A wrong skill document performs on par with the correct one, a single averaged bundle matches per-skill routing under a two-sided equivalence test, and a same-norm random direction collapses to the no-injection baseline, which shows that the trained direction stays load-bearing. We then introduce SKILL2STEER, a one-pass hypernetwork that reads a skill document once and maps it to low-rank activation shifts added at the output of every decoder block. Each skill compiles to 2.36M parameters, 9.25 times fewer than a weight-space adapter, while the base weights stay frozen and the generator runs only at compile time. The shift can be scheduled across retrieval steps and deployed as one routing-free bundle. On SearchQA, a seven-dataset benchmark, SKILL2STEER reaches 37.9 exact match, 9.8 points above the frozen model and 2.3 points above a weight-space method that ships 9.25 times more parameters per skill.

</details>


### [269] [Sample-Grained Approximate Unlearning with Provable Per-Sample Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04501)
*Yaxin Xiao,Yulin Jin,Li Tang,Haoyang LI,Huadi Zheng,Qingqing Ye,Haibo Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的SALA框架，使近似机器遗忘在单样本层面生效，并定义样本粒度分布差距指标，理论上保证差距收缩、实验上最多降低86.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有近似遗忘方法只用数据集级聚合指标评估效果，这类指标会掩盖单个样本相对完全重训练模型的偏差，因此需要关注逐样本的遗忘有效性。

Method: SALA（Sample-grained Likelihoods ALignment）：将每个样本引导至其正确的目标分布（成员/非成员目标分布），作为可插拔优化框架配合现有近似遗忘方法；并提出样本粒度分布差距指标衡量近似遗忘与精确重训练输出分布的逐样本差异；同时给出低成本的成员/非成员目标分布估计方法。

Result: 理论证明SALA使该差距收缩，且对重训练的逐样本差异有界；在分类与生成任务上，与现有近似遗忘基线结合时样本粒度分布差距最多降低86.67%，并提升对遗忘超参数的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 逐样本视角能揭示聚合指标掩盖的偏差，SALA以低成本方式显著提升样本级遗忘效果与超参数鲁棒性。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to erase the influence of a designated forget set from a trained model while preserving strong utility on the retain set. Approximate unlearning methods efficiently achieve this goal without full retraining, but their effectiveness is primarily assessed using dataset-level aggregate metrics. These aggregate metrics can mask deviations from retraining at the level of individual samples. In this work, we focus on per-sample unlearning effectiveness. We introduce SALA (Sample-grained Likelihoods ALignment), a plug-in optimization framework that enables approximate unlearning methods to operate at the level of individual samples by steering each example toward its correct target distribution. To quantitatively assess this behavior, we further propose the sample-grained distribution gap, a metric that captures per-sample discrepancies between approximate unlearning and exact retraining output distributions. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that SALA contracts this gap and yields a bounded per-sample discrepancy to retraining. To make this framework practical, we develop a low-cost estimation method for the member and non-member target distributions. Extensive experiments on classification and generation tasks demonstrate that SALA reduces the sample-grained distribution gap by up to $86.67\%$ when paired with existing approximate unlearning baselines, while also improving robustness to unlearning hyperparameters.

</details>


### [270] [Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04632)
*Yangrong Hu,Xueyu Zhou,Yue Wu,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 分析 SFT 中 token 级加权的优化目标，指出动态加权会锐化目标分布、静态加权更稳定但依赖先验质量，据此提出 SPFT：用带特权信息的冻结初始模型作为先验进行加权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SFT 改进方法引入 token 级权重，但其权重由模型输出分布导出，缺乏对其优化目标与诱导目标分布的理论理解，需要弄清不同加权方式的影响以指导设计。

Method: 理论上刻画加权的目标分布：动态加权（如 DFT）诱导高度锐化分布，静态加权拟合与“数据分布×冻结先验”成比例的目标。据此提出 SPFT，将以特权信息（如数学题标准答案）为条件的初始模型冻结副本作为先验，并通过贝叶斯分解说明其按 token 对预测正确答案的信息量进行重加权。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，SPFT 在主要设置下均优于标准 SFT 及其他基线。

Conclusion: 静态加权提供更稳定的训练目标，其效果关键取决于先验质量；引入特权信息先验的 SPFT 能有效提升 SFT 效果，为后续强化学习奠定更好基础。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a key component of language model post-training, enabling effective task adaptation and serving as an important foundation for subsequent reinforcement learning. Recent methods seek to improve SFT by introducing token-level weights into the training objective, where these weights are typically derived from a model's output distribution at each token position. To better understand how such weighting schemes affect SFT, we analyze their optimization objectives and theoretically characterize the target distributions they induce. Our analysis shows that dynamic weighting methods, such as Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT), induce a heavily sharpened distribution, whereas static weighting methods fit a target distribution proportional to the product of the data distribution and a frozen prior. These findings suggest that static weighting provides a more stable training target, while its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the prior distribution. Building on this observation, we propose Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning (SPFT), which uses a frozen copy of the initial model conditioned on privileged information (such as ground truth for mathematical questions) as a prior to provide guidance for token-level weighting during fine-tuning. Through a Bayesian decomposition, we further show that SPFT reweights the standard static prior according to how informative each target token is for predicting the ground-truth outcome, thereby assigning larger weights to more predictive tokens. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that SPFT improves over standard SFT and other baselines across the main settings.

</details>


### [271] [Variational Learning with Lie Group Exponential Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04513)
*Eren Mehmet Kıral,Thomas Möllenhoff,Koichi Tojo,Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan,Kenichi Bannai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文把李群框架推广到任意李群，证明其线性近似可视为贝叶斯学习规则(BLR)等自然梯度变分方法的推广，并给出基于调和指数族的系统构造高效变分学习算法的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的变分贝叶斯学习虽有诸多潜在优势，但实现困难：变分分布参数存在约束，且需要低方差梯度估计。此前的李群方法只覆盖乘法群或仿射群，缺乏统一性和与自然梯度方法的显式联系。

Method: 将先前针对乘法/仿射群的李群方法精简并推广到任意一般李群；引入与李群表示相关联的调和指数族（harmonic exponential family）作为关键工具；推导并证明李群算法的线性近似是对贝叶斯学习规则(BLR)的推广，从而给出由表示出发系统构造可高效实现变分学习算法的方案。

Result: 证明了李群算法的线性近似可推广BLR等标准自然梯度变分学习方法；建立了李群框架与自然梯度方法的显式关系，并给出基于表示构造高效算法的通用流程。

Conclusion: 李群与调和指数族为变分贝叶斯深度学习提供了统一、系统且可实现的框架，涵盖并扩展了自然梯度变分学习，为构建高效算法提供了理论依据与构造方法。

Abstract: Variational Bayesian learning for deep neural networks offers many potential benefits. The difficulty in implementation arises from constraints on the parameters of the variational distributions, as well as the need for low-variance gradient estimators. Our recent work proposes Lie group methods for multiplicative or affine groups that naturally overcome such difficulties. Lie groups are essentially parameter spaces with a binary operator such as addition or multiplication, which allows for natural updates within the parameter space. In this article, we streamline and extend our Lie group framework to any general Lie group, and give an explicit relation to standard natural-gradient variational learning methods such as the Bayesian learning rule (BLR). In particular, we prove that linear approximations of the Lie group algorithm give generalizations of the BLR. The key ingredient is the harmonic exponential family, a general class of Lie group exponential families associated to representations of Lie groups. Our work provides a systematic method to construct from such representations efficiently implementable algorithms for variational learning.

</details>


### [272] [The Price of List Replicability: Tight Bounds for Bias Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04532)
*Michael Chen,Atieh Bastan,A. Pavan,N. V. Vinodchandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究估计 d 枚硬币偏置的 list replicable 算法的样本复杂度，给出首个非平凡下界，并给出匹配上下界的最优算法：list size 为 d+1 时最优样本复杂度为 Õ(d²/ε²)；更一般地对每个 k∈[d+1,2^d]，总样本复杂度为 Õ(d²/(ε²log k))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前对该问题已知 (d+1,ε,δ)-list replicable 算法的样本复杂度上界 Õ(d³/ε²)，但没有任何非平凡的样本复杂度下界，无法判断维度依赖是否本质，因此需要确定最优样本复杂度。

Method: 建立该问题的首个非平凡样本复杂度下界，并设计改进的 list replicable 算法，使上界与下界在 polylog 因子内匹配；对一般 list size k∈[d+1,2^d] 给出统一的总样本复杂度上下界分析。

Result: list size 为 d+1 时最优样本复杂度为 Õ(d²/ε²)，说明对维度的二次依赖在 polylog 因子内是固有的；对每个 k∈[d+1,2^d]，总样本复杂度上下界匹配为 Õ(d²/(ε²log k))。

Conclusion: 本文确定性地刻画了 list replicable 硬币偏置估计的最优样本复杂度，证明二次维度依赖不可改进（至 polylog），并给出随 list size 增大而下降的完整样本复杂度曲线。

Abstract: We study the sample complexity of list replicable algorithms for estimating the biases of $d$ coins. An algorithm is $(k,\varepsilon,δ)$-list replicable if for every bias vector $\mathbf{p}\in[0,1]^d$, there is a set of outputs $L_{\mathbf{p}}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ of at most $k$ elements such that every $\mathbf{y}\in L_{\mathbf{p}}$ satisfies $\lVert\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{p}\rVert_\infty\leq\varepsilon$, and the algorithm output is in $L_{\mathbf{p}}$ with probability at least $1-δ$. Prior work gave a $(d+1,\varepsilon,δ)$-list replicable algorithm with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{d^3}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$, but no nontrivial sample complexity lower bound was known.
  We establish the first non-trivial sample complexity lower bound for this problem and give an improved algorithm that matches it up to polylogarithmic factors. Together, these results determine the optimal sample complexity for list size $d+1$ to be $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{d^2}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$, showing that the quadratic dependence on dimension is inherent up to polylogarithmic factors. More generally, for every $k\in[d+1,2^d]$, we establish matching upper and lower bounds of $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{d^2}{\varepsilon^2\log k}\right)$ on the total sample complexity.

</details>


### [273] [CANDO: Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization for Residual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04543)
*Zeyu Gao,Chengkai Hou,Chaoyue Li,Zhuangzhe Wu,Jiaming Liu,Yao Mu,Peng Jia,Li Zhang,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CNDO及CANDO两种噪声空间残差强化学习方法，在冻结生成策略上高效在线微调并超越单空间方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练生成策略虽有良好行为先验，但用在线RL高效适配仍困难：固定隐空间可行域约束可能排除有价值的噪声编辑，而动作空间残差方法虽样本效率较高仍有提升空间。

Method: CNDO在冻结生成策略的高斯潜样本周围学习状态与噪声条件化的方向，移除预定义可行域，改用"软保守约束"（保守价值估计+门控执行）调节噪声空间适配；CANDO在其上叠加动作空间残差，实现结构化的潜空间改进与局部动作修正结合。

Result: CNDO缩小了噪声空间与动作空间残差学习的差距；CANDO进一步优于单空间优化，达到76.1 NAUC与91.4%最终成功率，比最佳单空间结果提升6.6 NAUC和4.1%成功率。

Conclusion: 以软保守约束替代固定可行域可释放噪声空间残差潜力，噪声+动作双空间联合优化是高效适配冻结生成策略的有效方向。

Abstract: Pretrained generative policies provide strong behavior priors for robot control, but adapting them efficiently with online reinforcement learning remains difficult. A central challenge is how to improve a frozen generative policy without destroying the structure learned from offline demonstrations. Noise-space residual methods address this by modifying the policy's input noise, but existing noise-space methods typically regulate adaptation through fixed latent feasible regions, which may exclude valuable noise edits. In contrast, action-space residual methods are more sample-efficient, but their efficiency can still be further improved. We propose Conservative Noise Directional Optimization (CNDO), a noise-space residual RL method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning state- and noise-conditioned directions around Gaussian latent samples. CNDO removes predefined latent feasible regions and instead regulates noise-space adaptation through the soft conservative constraint, which consists of conservative value estimation and gated execution. We further introduce Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization (CANDO), which adds an action-space residual, combining structured latent-space improvement with local action correction. Experiments show that, once CNDO narrows the gap between noise-space and action-space residual learning, CANDO further improves over single-space optimization, achieving 76.1 NAUC and a 91.4% final success rate, surpassing the best single-space results by 6.6 NAUC and 4.1% success rate. More demos and info are available on https://cando-rl.github.io/.

</details>


### [274] [Curriculum unlearning in humans and neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04565)
*Jirko Rubruck,Alice Zhang,Andrew Saxe,Christopher Summerfield*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 人类与神经网络在学习中都存在"简单性偏置"，即倾向于学到欠拟合数据的简单规则；由简到繁的课程通过打破表征压缩、帮助"遗忘"简单规则来促进学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类学习常受益于"先简单规则后例外"的由简到繁课程，但缺乏对该现象的计算层面解释。

Method: 采用经典行为任务，结合人类实验与神经网络建模，提出并检验关于课程学习为何有效的理论；进一步检验理论的两项衍生预测（预暴露于简单任务、初始表征更压缩的学习者获益更大）。

Result: 人和神经网络均表现出简单性偏置，网络中还伴随神经表征压缩；由简到繁课程帮助两类学习者克服压缩，形成与任务匹配维度的表征与策略；预暴露于简单任务及初始表征更压缩者从课程中获益更多，两项预测均获证实。

Conclusion: 课程的作用在于帮助学习者"遗忘"（unlearning）简单规则，从而形成维度适当的表征与策略。

Abstract: During learning, humans often benefit from curricula that teach simple rules before exceptions. However, we lack a computational explanation for this phenomenon. Here, using a canonical behavioural task and modelling with neural networks, we develop and test a theory for why simple-to-complex curricula succeed. We show that during learning, both humans and neural networks show simplicity biases, a tendency to learn simple rules that are underfit to the data. In neural networks this bias is accompanied by compression of neural representations. Simple-to-complex curricula help both types of learners overcome this compression, developing representations (and policy) with appropriate dimensionality for the task. We test and confirm a further prediction from this theory: learners that have been pre-exposed to simple tasks and with more compressed initial representations benefit more from curricula. These findings suggest that curricula help with ``unlearning'' of simple rules.

</details>


### [275] [Ground-Wing: A Parametric 3D Wing-in-Ground-Effect Dataset for Benchmarking Neural Surrogate Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04571)
*Andrea Cenzato,Lukas Karch,Andre Luckow,Yoran Pichon,Francesco Pasqua,Abouzar Ghasemi,Rishikesh Ranade,Ira Shokar,Julia Kowalski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个用于赛车场景、考虑地面效应的三维机翼高度参数化CFD数据集，包含770次RANS仿真覆盖194种构型，并用六种神经网络架构进行基准评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有翼型与机翼数据集缺乏地面效应这一独特物理现象，而赛车应用中地面效应至关重要，因此需要一个具有挑战性的基准数据集来评测神经代理CFD模型。

Method: 构建770次RANS仿真、194种唯一翼型构型的数据集，采样27种翼型剖面、4种离地距离，覆盖后掠、弦长、锥度、攻角、翼尖扭转等变化；评测六种神经网络架构（DoMINO卷积、X-MeshGraphNet图网络、AB-UPT/GeoTransolver/GAOT变换器、AeroJEPA），预测表面压力系数与壁面剪应力并还原阻力/升力系数。

Result: 提供了一个高度参数化、含地面效应的CFD基准数据集，并给出六种代表性架构在表面压力与壁面剪应力预测及积分气动力恢复上的评测结果。

Conclusion: 由于地面效应在其他机翼/翼型数据集中缺失，该数据集可作为神经代理CFD模型的挑战性基准。

Abstract: This paper presents a CFD dataset of a highly parametrized 3D wing operating in ground effect, designed for benchmarking neural surrogate models for aerodynamic prediction, using a wing shape and flow conditions typically encountered in motorsport applications. The dataset comprises 770 RANS simulations of 194 unique wing configurations, sampled across 27 airfoil profile variants and 4 distances from the ground, spanning variations in wing sweep, chord, taper, angle of attack, and tip twist. Six neural network architectures representing distinct paradigms --- convolutional (DoMINO), graph-based (X-MeshGraphNet), transformer-based (AB-UPT, GeoTransolver, GAOT), and JEPA-based (AeroJEPA) --- are evaluated on their ability to predict surface pressure coefficient and wall shear stress distributions, from which integral drag and lift coefficients are recovered. The dataset is intended to be used as a challenging benchmark for surrogate CFD models, due to the uniqueness of the ground effect being absent from other wing and airfoil datasets.

</details>


### [276] [SCANO: Restoring Boundary-Condition Completeness in Sampled Meshes with a Sliced-Cross-Attention Neural Operator for 3D Thermal Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04603)
*Tianyu Li,Zhiwei Cao,Qingang Zhang,Ruihang Wang,Binyang Song,Yonggang Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对百万网格神经算子训练受显存限制、只能子采样训练却部署于全网格导致的边界条件失真问题，作者将解表示为边界数据对类型相关测度的积分，识别出三类子采样失真，提出四个可测一致性条件，并用边界正交注意力(BQA)与锚定全局状态(AGS)两个模块实现SCANO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 百万级网格训练超GPU显存，需子采样训练、全网格或区域部署；但子采样会扭曲边界信息导致精度下降。作者追问：子采样下的边界条件何时与全网格训练保持一致，以及如何聚合并注入边界数据。

Method: 将解写成边界数据相对类型相关测度的积分，由此分析出子采样失真三方式：边界覆盖不全或采样依赖的全局状态、按计数而非面积的面加权、边界输入压缩为低维向量。据此给出训练前可检验的四个可测一致性条件，并用与骨干无关的两模块满足：BQA将所有边界面按类型与面积加权聚合为slice token，供每个查询点在每层读取；AGS用锚点估计全局状态、与采样点无关。二者加到可扩展消息传递+slice注意力骨干上构成SCANO。

Result: 在受控与公开基准及含百万网格的数据中心热仿真数据集DCTS上评估：BQA在两个基准上提升每个骨干，全网格误差最多降低15倍；AGS在所有三个数据集上使区域预测与全网格对齐，公开基准上多数骨干区域误差至少降十倍；两模块合起来使最佳原始骨干的全网格误差近乎减半。SCANO不到1秒预测房间尺度场，比全屋锚点自注意力快100倍以上。

Conclusion: 子采样导致的边界条件失真可被形式化为可检验的一致性条件，并通过BQA与AGS这类骨干无关模块系统性修复，实现大规模网格神经算子的高效高精度部署。

Abstract: Training neural operators on million-cell meshes can exceed GPU memory limits. Models are therefore trained on subsamples and deployed on whole meshes or selected regions. However, subsampling can distort boundary information, degrading accuracy. We ask when boundary conditioning under sampling stays consistent with whole-mesh training, and how to aggregate and inject boundary data. Representing the solution as an integral of boundary data against type-dependent measures, we show that subsampling distorts this conditioning in three ways: incomplete boundary coverage or a sample-dependent global state, face weighting by count rather than area, and compression of boundary inputs into a low-dimensional vector. This analysis yields four measurable consistency conditions checkable before training. We satisfy them with two backbone-agnostic modules. Boundary Quadrature Attention (BQA) aggregates all boundary faces, typed and area-weighted, into slice tokens that every query point reads at every layer. Anchored Global State (AGS) estimates the global state from anchors independent of the sampled points. Adding both to a scalable message-passing and slice-attention backbone yields SCANO. We evaluate the approach on controlled and public benchmarks and a data-centre thermal simulation dataset (DCTS) containing million-cell meshes. On both benchmarks, BQA improves every backbone, reducing whole-mesh error up to 15-fold. On all three datasets, AGS aligns regional with whole-mesh predictions, cutting regional error at least tenfold for most backbones on the public benchmark. Together, the modules nearly halve the best original backbone's whole-mesh error on both benchmarks. SCANO predicts a room-scale field in under one second, over 100 times faster than whole-room anchor self-attention.

</details>


### [277] [LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05304)
*Minsoo Cheong,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LoopVQ，一种针对循环Transformer的KV cache向量量化方法，利用循环轴上KV高度冗余的特性联合编码多步通道，在0.5bit/元素下优于标准LLM的KV量化方法，并在SGLang中显著降低解码延迟、提升吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer虽降低参数内存，但每个循环步仍存自己的KV，KV cache随循环步数线性增长成为主要内存瓶颈；且循环步间KV冗余度高、各步对量化敏感度差异大。

Method: LoopVQ对多个循环步的KV cache通道进行联合编码的向量量化，并微调码本以对齐全精度模型输出；设计上与现有KV量化方法正交，可与TaSQ组合。

Result: 0.5bit/元素时在通用、长链思维推理、长上下文检索任务上（Ouro、Huginn）优于标准LLM的KV向量量化方法；结合TaSQ在0.25bit/元素下仍保留大部分BF16精度。SGLang实现中，32K上下文解码延迟近乎减半，1.4B与2.6B Ouro模型峰值服务吞吐相比BF16基线提升最高4.3倍和6.1倍。

Conclusion: LoopVQ通过利用循环轴冗余有效解决循环模型KV cache内存瓶颈，精度与效率兼优，且可与现有方法正交组合并落地到推理框架。

Abstract: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

</details>


### [278] [CAPSkip: Cancellation-Aware Prefix Skipping for Selective Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04611)
*Heejin Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CAPSkip，一种考虑梯度抵消的逐样本选择性反向传播方法，通过跳过已正确分类样本中排名前缀且向量和受控的部分来加速训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逐样本选择性反向传播规则依据loss或梯度范数等标量排序，忽略了样本间梯度相互抵消：被移除集合的梯度和可能远小于各样本幅度之和，因此标量排序无法准确衡量实际影响。

Method: CAPSkip对已正确分类的样本按末层梯度范数升序排列，跳过最长的、其向量和仍处于批次末层梯度相对预算b内的前缀。利用前向传播中已有的秩一贡献在精确算术下约束末层原始梯度变化；用因子化Gram矩阵使全前缀扫描成本低廉并保持在设备上；配合激活复用与选定行反向传播。

Result: 在CIFAR-100上微调DeiT-S，103个epoch耗时仅为103-epoch稠密训练的0.576倍；且比时间大致匹配的59-epoch稠密训练高0.25个百分点 [+0.08, +0.42]（n=3）。

Conclusion: CAPSkip通过显式考虑梯度抵消，实现更高效且不损失（甚至略优于时间匹配基线）的逐样本选择性反向传播，但理论保证仅限末层原始梯度，不延伸至更深层、优化器更新及训练轨迹。

Abstract: Per-step selective back-propagation forwards every example of a mini-batch but back-propagates only some of them. Most rules rank examples by loss or gradient magnitude, but such scalar scores ignore cancellation between per-example gradients: the gradient removed by a set can be much smaller than its individual magnitudes suggest. We introduce CAPSkip (Cancellation-Aware Prefix Skipping). Among the examples the model already classifies correctly, CAPSkip skips the longest prefix, in increasing order of last-layer gradient norm, whose vector sum stays within a relative budget $b$ of the batch's last-layer gradient. In exact arithmetic this bounds the change of the raw final-layer gradient, using rank-one contributions already available from the forward pass; the bound does not extend to deeper layers, optimizer updates, or the training trajectory. Because the cumulative distortion is not monotone in the prefix length, CAPSkip scans all prefixes; a factorised Gram matrix makes the scan cheap and keeps it on the device. With activation reuse and selected-row backward, CAPSkip fine-tunes DeiT-S on CIFAR-100 for 103 epochs in 0.576x the time of 103-epoch dense training, and is +0.25 pp [+0.08, +0.42] above an approximately time-matched 59-epoch dense run (n=3).

</details>


### [279] [Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05373)
*Austin Tsai,Saurav Nanda,Ganapathy Parthasarathy,Bhuvnesh Kumar,Parivesh Choudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文独立复现DNO-Prct（Direct Nash Optimization的实用变体），在两个开源instruct模型上验证其对齐效果，并做消融与成本分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNO通过对两人偏好博弈的纳什均衡做近似来对齐语言模型，但其实用变体DNO-Prct缺乏独立复现与系统研究，尤其尚不清楚评分步骤是否必须依赖专有模型、以及各组件对效果的贡献。

Method: 独立重实现DNO-Prct：迭代进行on-policy采样、用LLM对样本与教师金标准回答打分、按大间隔筛选偏好对、再做DPO式对比更新。在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct与Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1上，分别用GPT-4o和同族更大开源模型作标注者进行实验，并开展消融（去除金标准回答、去除数据回看、仅接受教师偏好对）、样本数扫描（1–7）与间隔扫描（1–5）。

Result: 以GPT-4o为标注者，AlpacaEval 2.0上三轮迭代使LC胜率从31.7%升至45.3%（Llama）、从6.8%升至18.4%（Mistral），调优后的8B模型在各项胜率上均超过Llama 3.1 70B Instruct。用同族开源标注者时分别保留62%（Llama）和82%（Mistral）的LC增益。去除金标准回答、去除数据回看或仅接受教师偏好对的变体比完整流程低6–10个LC点；每提示采样数（1–7）影响不超过2.1点，间隔（1–5）影响不超过2.4点。

Conclusion: DNO-Prct可在开源模型上有效复现，评分步骤不必依赖专有模型；金标准回答与数据回看等关键组件贡献显著，而采样数与间隔较鲁棒。但所有结果为单次运行，且GPT-4o同时担任教师与评测裁判，所报增益的解释需谨慎。

Abstract: Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas varying the number of on-policy samples per prompt (1 to 7) moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points, and a margin sweep (1 to 5) run in its own pipeline by at most 2.4 points. We also report the cost of the pipeline and where the practical algorithm departs from the theory it approximates. All results are single runs, and GPT-4o is both the teacher and the evaluation judge; we discuss what this implies for the reported gains.

</details>


### [280] [Policy Network Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04614)
*Jiate Liu,Deheng Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DPPG：用Transformer自编码器将策略网络参数patch化压缩，再用任务条件扩散模型按环境生成策略参数；单一模型可跨Classic Control、Atari、MuJoCo生成高质量策略，并在未见环境中实现更快收敛与有竞争力的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像、视频生成上进展显著，但能否用于生成强化学习策略网络参数、且生成策略是否具备泛化能力尚不清楚；此前参数生成方法还受限于网络规模。

Method: DPPG由两部分组成：(1) Transformer-based 自编码器，通过对网络参数做patchify实现高压缩率；(2) 任务条件扩散模型，以不同环境为条件生成对应策略参数。

Result: 单个统一DPPG模型可在来自不同环境域的多类任务（Classic Control、Atari、MuJoCo）上合成高质量策略；相比先前方法可生成参数量更大的网络；在未见环境中生成的参数收敛更快并达到有竞争力性能。

Conclusion: 扩散式策略参数生成可行且具泛化潜力，为未来参数生成应用提供方向。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable progress in AI-generated content, including images and videos. In this paper, we explore whether diffusion models can generate the parameters of policy networks in reinforcement learning (RL), and whether the generated policies exhibit generalization capabilities. To achieve this, we propose Diffusion-based Conditional Policy Network Parameter Generation (DPPG), which consists of a Transformer-based autoencoder and a task-conditioned diffusion model. The autoencoder achieves a high compression rate by patchifying network parameters, while the task-conditioned diffusion model generates corresponding parameters conditioned on different environments. Our experiments demonstrate that, with a single unified DPPG model, we can synthesize high-quality policies across a diverse set of tasks from different environment domains, including Classic Control, Atari games, and MuJoCo. Additionally, our method can generate networks with a larger number of parameters compared to previous approaches. Furthermore, we find that in previously unseen environments, DPPG can generate parameters that achieve faster convergence and reach competitive performance, showcasing the potential future applications of parameter generation via diffusion.

</details>


### [281] [Does LinUCB Need Valid Confidence Sets?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04641)
*Ahmed Ben Yahmed,Marc Abeille,David Janz,Clément Calauzènes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LinUCB的置信宽度β替换为任意固定α>0，在M-光滑、m-强凸动作集上仍保持次线性遗憾，说明有效置信集并非LinUCB成功所必需。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LinUCB依赖置信宽度β构造乐观置信集来保证探索与遗憾界。作者想探究这种"乐观性/有效置信集"是否真的必要，以及为何在无乐观保证时算法仍能有效探索。

Method: 提出α-LinUCB（固定α替代β），并揭示机制：动作集曲率驱使算法探索所有方向。引入对数截断的谱势（logarithmically capped spectral potential）替代标准log-determinant势，对已充分探索方向截断贡献，从而导出设计矩阵最小特征值的下界。

Result: 给出α-LinUCB的高概率遗憾界，证明次线性遗憾；当α=β≍√(d log T)时，d维T轮遗憾为O((M/m)d√(T log T))（忽略迭代对数因子），比经典LinUCB改进√log T。

Conclusion: 有效置信集对LinUCB并非必需，动作集曲率本身即可驱动充分探索；所提谱势工具为分析探索机制提供新手段并改善遗憾界。

Abstract: We show that replacing LinUCB's usual confidence width $β$ by any fixed $α>0$ preserves sublinear regret when the action set is $M$-smooth and $m$-strongly convex. Our high-probability regret bound for this generalisation, $α$-LinUCB, establishes that valid confidence sets are not necessary for the success of LinUCB. We identify the mechanism behind this result: action-set curvature drives $α$-LinUCB to explore every direction, even when optimism is not guaranteed. To analyse this mechanism, we introduce a logarithmically capped spectral potential that, unlike the standard log-determinant potential, caps contributions from well-explored directions. This yields lower bounds on the smallest eigenvalue of the design matrix. At the standard confidence width $α=β\asymp\sqrt{d\log T}$, our $T$-round regret bound in $d$ dimensions is $O\bigl(\frac{M}{m}d\sqrt{T\log T}\bigr)$, up to iterated-logarithmic factors, improving the horizon dependence of the classical LinUCB guarantee by a factor of $\sqrt{\log T}$.

</details>


### [282] [Exploiting Biases in Attention for Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04657)
*Charles Herr,Gabriele Spadaro,Enzo Tartaglione*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现视觉Transformer中注意力矩阵列的“绝对重要性”随网络加深愈发显著，提出在query-key点积中加入输入相关的偏置显式建模该现象，并以此作为注意力图剪枝的代理，在保持分类精度的同时降低attention的FLOPs与推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉Transformer中的注意力已知具有稀疏性。作者观察到注意力矩阵各列对最终计算的相关性并不均等，且这种不均衡随网络深度增加而加剧，即某些token对注意力过程具有与query无关的“绝对重要性”。原有attention公式未显式表达这一性质。

Method: 重新表述注意力公式：在query-key点积上增加一个输入相关的偏置项，使每个token获得一个标量值，表示其在注意力过程中对其他token的预期影响。该标量可作为剪枝注意力图的代理指标，从而减少注意力计算量。

Result: 在多种规模的Transformer模型上，该方法显著降低注意力的计算成本（FLOPs和推理延迟），同时保留大部分原始分类精度。

Conclusion: 注意力中的token绝对重要性可被显式建模并用作剪枝依据，为高效视觉Transformer提供了一种简单有效的注意力加速方案，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Attention is known to be sparse in vision transformers. In particular, we analyze the unequal relevance of attention-matrix columns to the final computation and show that this phenomenon becomes increasingly pronounced with network depth. This can be interpreted as saying that tokens have an absolute importance for the attention process, independently of queries. Inspired by this, we propose a reformulation of the attention formula that makes this phenomenon explicit by adding an input-dependent bias to the query-key dot product. We show that this new term gives each token a scalar value indicating its anticipated influence on other tokens during the attention process, and can thus serve as a proxy for pruning attention maps. Across multiple transformer model sizes, this allows us to substantially reduce the computational cost of attention, in terms of both FLOPs and inference latency, while retaining most of the original classification accuracy. We publicly released the code and models at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/AttentionWithBias.

</details>


### [283] [Leakage-free evaluation of residual graph convolutional networks for network intrusion detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04660)
*Zahid Iqbal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在严格防泄漏协议下，残差图卷积网络相对MLP和其他图网络无可测精度增益；树集成在CICIDS2017和NF-UNSW-NB15-v2上更优，图模型的优势在于对特征噪声的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络入侵检测的图神经网络报告结果常存在乐观偏差：测试流参与构造成训练图、重复流同时出现在划分两侧、仅报告单一划分。作者希望消除这些乐观来源后，衡量残差图卷积网络相对简单模型的真实收益。

Method: 对CICIDS2017和NF-UNSW-NB15-v2进行标签感知的精确去重（NF-UNSW-NB15-v2删除69%流量）；仅用训练流构建最近邻图，验证/测试流在预测时挂接到最近的训练流；两层残差网络与8个模型在同设置下对比（含同图最近邻投票、梯度提升树、随机森林），使用3个种子各自重新划分，并进行消融、留一族（leave-one-family-out）和特征噪声测试。

Result: CICIDS2017二分类F1为98.11%（SD 0.18），NF-UNSW-NB15-v2为90.57%（0.38），与无图MLP及其他图网络无差别。树集成在CICIDS2017上F1高1.48–1.57个点，并在两个数据集上PR-AUC领先；CICIDS2017多分类宏F1为93.08%对64.51%，差距主要来自残差网络把良性流误分到小攻击类。任何消融（含直推式构图）都未使F1超出种子波动。高斯特征噪声（SD 0.5）下残差网络F1保持96.16%，XGBoost跌至0.67%。

Conclusion: 在受控泄漏协议下，流图上的消息传递相对感知机没有可测的精度提升，树集成在两个数据集上均更强；图模型的优势体现在对特征噪声的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are increasingly proposed for network intrusion detection, yet many reported results come from protocols in which test flows shape the graph used for training, duplicated flows sit on both sides of the split, or a single split is reported. This study measures what a residual graph convolutional network gains over simpler models once these sources of optimism are removed. CICIDS2017 and NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 were cleaned with label-aware removal of exact duplicates, removing 69% of NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 flows. Flows were linked in a nearest-neighbour graph built from training flows only, and validation and test flows were attached to their nearest training flows at prediction time. A two-layer residual network was compared with eight models under the same settings, including a nearest-neighbour vote over the same graph, gradient-boosted trees and a random forest, over three seeds that each draw a new split, with ablations, leave-one-family-out and feature-noise tests. On CICIDS2017 the residual network reached a binary F1 of 98.11% (SD 0.18) and on NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 90.57% (0.38), indistinguishable from a multilayer perceptron without the graph and from other graph networks. Tree ensembles were 1.48 to 1.57 F1 points higher on CICIDS2017 and led on the area under the precision-recall curve on both datasets; their CICIDS2017 multiclass macro-F1 reached 93.08% against 64.51%, a gap mainly from benign flows the residual network assigned to small attack classes. No ablation, including transductive graph construction, changed F1 beyond seed variation. Under Gaussian feature noise (SD 0.5), the residual network kept an F1 of 96.16%, while XGBoost fell to 0.67%. Under a leakage-controlled protocol, message passing over flow graphs adds no measurable accuracy over a perceptron, and tree ensembles remain stronger on both; the advantage of graph models lies in robustness to feature noise.

</details>


### [284] [Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04663)
*Shota Takashiro,Takeshi Kojima,Masanori Koyama,Kohei Hayashi,Yusuke Iwasawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Best-of-Depth (BoD)，将循环Transformer的递归轨迹视为候选解集合，通过跨深度的预测损失最小化来训练，显著提升解的覆盖率和发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Looped Transformer虽通过重复隐状态更新扩展推理计算，但仅在最终深度训练无法鼓励中间深度产生有价值的替代解，浪费了轨迹中的中间计算潜能。

Method: BoD将递归轨迹作为候选集，最小化各深度的预测损失，使不同有效目标可匹配到不同深度；无需架构改动或深度专属标签，并用精确匹配分析将该目标与解的覆盖度联系起来。

Result: 在N-Queens补全任务上覆盖率达91.03%（最终深度训练仅45.75%）；图着色任务上优于最终深度和中间监督目标；还可发现超出训练深度的解、在熟悉输入上恢复教师池中未提供的解；微调循环语言模型后代码生成成功率优于最终深度训练。

Conclusion: 应针对递归计算的轨迹训练以支持解发现，而非仅优化最终深度输出。

Abstract: Looped Transformers extend inference-time computation through repeated latent-state updates, but final-depth training does not directly encourage useful intermediate alternatives. We introduce Best-of-Depth (BoD), which trains a recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths. Different valid targets can be matched at different depths without architectural changes or depth-specific labels. An exact-match analysis connects this objective to solution coverage. On N-Queens completion and graph coloring, BoD improves coverage over final-depth and intermediate-supervision objectives. N-Queens coverage reaches 91.03%, versus 45.75% for final-depth training. Further experiments show discovery beyond the training depth and recovery of solutions withheld from teacher pools on familiar inputs. Fine-tuning a pretrained looped language model with BoD yields higher pooled code-generation success than final-depth training when programs are generated separately at evaluated fixed depths. These results support training recurrent computation for solution discovery along its trajectory.

</details>


### [285] [Feature-Based and Deep Learning Methods for Astronomical Light Curve Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04664)
*V. Baymakanov,Kh. Khamitov,A. Raimova,A. Isaeva,R. Taran,M. Zedan,M. Kornilov,M. Demianenko,K. Malanchev,M. Hushchyn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在ZTF StarEmbed数据集上对比特征工程机器学习与端到端深度学习用于变星分类，发现经典特征模型稳定优于直接处理原始光变曲线的深度网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习有望直接从观测数据学习表征，但尚不清楚在变星分类这类天文时间序列任务中，它能否取代依赖物理特征的传统机器学习方法，以及性能差距的来源为何。

Method: 使用约4万天体、7个不平衡类别的ZTF StarEmbed数据集，系统性对比两类方法：(1)基于物理动机特征训练的经典机器学习模型；(2)直接以原始光变曲线为输入的端到端深度网络。

Result: 基于物理特征的经典模型在所有比较中一致优于深度网络；分析表明有限标注数据是性能差距的重要原因，同时光变曲线的多变量、不规则采样与形态多样性进一步加剧了深度模型的困难。

Conclusion: 现有深度学习模型在可用训练集规模下难以泛化，方法本身潜力仍在；研究提出应扩充标注数据并采用大规模无标注巡天的自监督预训练，同时为后续研究建立了定量基线。

Abstract: We compare feature-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning for variable star classification using the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) StarEmbed dataset, which contains about 40,000 objects across seven imbalanced classes. Classical models trained on physically motivated features consistently outperform deep networks trained directly on raw light curves. We find that limited labeled data contributes to the performance gap, while the multivariate, irregularly sampled, and morphologically diverse nature of light curves poses additional challenges for deep learning models. While deep learning holds promise for learning representations directly from observations, our results indicate that current models fail to generalize with the available training set size. These findings motivate further investigation of the benefits of scaling labeled datasets and self-supervised pretraining on large unlabeled surveys. This work establishes a quantitative baseline for future research and highlights the need for further innovations to unlock the potential of deep learning in astronomical time series analysis.

</details>


### [286] [FedCSGA: Client Selection Based on Genetic Algorithm for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04667)
*Ghani Haider,Majid Kundroo,Leo Zhang,Jinchul Choi,Taehong Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FedCSGA，一种基于遗传算法的联邦学习客户端选择方法，将客户端子集编码为染色体，用联合考虑资源感知指标与历史感知参与权重的非线性适应度函数评估，从而同时建模统计异构与系统异构，实验在四个数据集上最高提升 7.0% 准确率并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FL 实践中需每轮选择部分客户端以降低通信开销、缓解掉队者并提升效率；边缘环境下统计异构与系统异构共同影响收敛与性能，但现有选择方法通常独立处理两类因素，忽略了它们在多轮通信中的耦合与动态影响。

Method: FedCSGA：以遗传算法进行客户端选择。将客户端子集编码为染色体，通过非线性适应度函数评估子集，该函数联合整合资源感知指标（系统效率）与历史感知的参与权重（缓解持续选择偏差）；以子集级评估捕捉客户端间交互，平衡统计效用与系统效率。

Result: 在 FMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 Tiny-ImageNet 上的大量实验表明，FedCSGA 在多种异构设置下一致优于 SOTA 基线，准确率最高提升 7.0%，且收敛更快、所需通信轮次更少。

Conclusion: 结果验证了联合建模统计因素与系统因素的有效性，可在异构联邦环境中实现稳健且高效的学习。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. In practical deployments, FL relies on selecting a subset of clients in each communication round to reduce communication cost, mitigate stragglers, and improve training efficiency under heterogeneous data and system conditions. In heterogeneous edge computing environments, both statistical heterogeneity and system heterogeneity significantly affect convergence efficiency and model performance. However, existing client selection methods often address these factors independently, overlooking their coupled and dynamic impact across communication rounds. To address this limitation, we propose FedCSGA, a Client Selection method for Federated learning based on a Genetic Algorithm. FedCSGA encodes client subsets as chromosomes and evaluates these subsets through a non-linear fitness function that jointly integrates resource-aware metrics and history-aware participation weighting. This design captures subset-level interactions, mitigates persistent selection bias, and balances statistical utility with system efficiency. Extensive experiments on FMNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR- 100, and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that FedCSGA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse heterogeneity settings, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 7.0% and faster convergence with fewer communication rounds. These results validate the effectiveness of jointly modeling statistical and system factors to achieve robust and efficient learning in heterogeneous federated environments.

</details>


### [287] [Sheaf-MPNN: A Library for Sheaf Neural Networks as Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04670)
*Alessio Borgi,Mario Severino,Luke Braithwaite,Steve Azzolin,Rémi Bourgerie,Olga Zaghen,Emanuele Mule,Riccardo Ali,Leo Minh Kustermann,Edoardo Coppola,Antonio Purificato,Stefano Fiorini,Christopher Irwin,Filippo Spiga,Fabrizio Silvestri,Michael Bronstein,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Sheaf-MPNN：一个 PyTorch Geometric 库，将 Sheaf 神经网络中的扩散改写为局部关联（incidence）消息传递，避免显式构造全局 sheaf Laplacian，统一实现 15 类 SNN 并附基准套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 GNN 假设邻居共享同一特征空间，导致过平滑与异配图性能差；SNN 虽通过节点/边独立向量空间与限制映射缓解该问题，但现有实现通常显式组装全局稀疏块 Laplacian，带来内存与计算开销，影响可扩展性。

Method: 将 sheaf 扩散重构为按关联边（incidence-wise）的局部传输与聚合，用统一消息传递框架实现；支持同配/异配图、有向/无向、对角、一般、正交、低秩限制映射及基于注意力的预测器；并提供覆盖节点级、图级、异配图学习与效率的统一基准测试套件。

Result: 实现并统一了 15 个 SNN 家族，证明其消息传递形式与原公式的理论等价性，并识别出保持原有传播动力学所需的架构机制；基准套件支持系统、可复现的跨架构比较。

Conclusion: 无需全局 Laplacian 的局部消息传递为 sheaf 架构在标准图学习框架内的实现、比较与扩展提供了有原则的基础，代码已开源。

Abstract: Standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) implicitly assume that neighboring nodes share the same feature space, which contributes to oversmoothing and poor performance on heterophilic graphs.
