Offline, for a given model, we fit a pool of configurations on datasets sampled from a published PFN prior and greedily select the subset with the highest winrate over the random baseline. Online, a new dataset fits only the selected configurations, so the gain comes at no extra cost. Empirically, we observe that scaling both the number of configurations and synthetic datasets has an equal scaling effect on the performance of the final subset of configurations, which we also explain theoretically. On the full BeyondArena benchmark, LightGBM with TabPrep features with our configurations ranks above TabPFN-3 and RealMLP, while being much more efficient at inference. Overall, our results establish existing PFN priors as a scalable source of meta-training data for hyperparameter selection for non-foundational tabular models.

</details>


### [323] [Macrocanonical Generator Networks: Data-Efficient Neural Surrogates for Amortized Physics Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05157)
*Niall Jeffrey,Benjamin D. Wandelt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"宏正则生成网络"(macrocanonical generator networks),通过学习目标过程的多尺度统计量,训练神经代理来摊销昂贵科学模拟的按样本优化,实现快速、数据高效的平稳物理过程模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学模拟计算代价高,限制了其在基于模拟的推断、不确定性量化和决策中的应用;而微正则最大熵合成需对每个样本做内循环优化,开销大且无法摊销。

Method: 受微正则最大熵合成启发(逐样本匹配特征统计量),改为训练神经生成器在期望意义上满足相同约束,以保留真实的样本间涨落;证明梯度下降训练在样本空间诱导预条件梯度下降动力学,继承Bruna-Mallat微正则梯度下降的对称性保持性质;采用近单位初始化的残差生成器参数化与小学习率以局部保持熵、缓解模式坍缩。

Result: 在宇宙学和流体模拟实验中,仅用极小训练集(有时单样本)即可恢复真实样本;生成速度比参考模拟器快超10^6倍/样本,比微正则梯度下降快超10^3倍;训练后的生成器可复用于下游预训练(含模拟推断)。

Conclusion: 宏正则生成网络将逐样本内循环优化摊销为单次训练,前向一次即生成样本,为多保真科学机器学习工作流提供了一条数据高效的路径。

Abstract: Many scientific simulations are computationally expensive, limiting their use in simulation-based inference, uncertainty quantification, and decision making. We introduce macrocanonical generator networks, a framework for learning fast, data-efficient neural surrogates for amortized simulation of stationary physical processes by matching multiscale statistics of a target process. Inspired by microcanonical maximum-entropy synthesis, which matches feature statistics per sample by inner-loop optimization, our approach instead trains a neural generator to satisfy the same constraints in expectation, preserving physically realistic sample-to-sample fluctuations. We prove that gradient-descent training induces preconditioned gradient-descent dynamics in sample space that inherit the symmetry-preservation properties of the microcanonical gradient descent of Bruna and Mallat, amortizing its per-sample inner-loop optimization into a single training run after which every sample is generated in one forward pass. We further show that residual generator parameterizations initialized near the identity, trained with a small learning rate, preserve entropy locally during early optimization and mitigate mode collapse. Experiments on cosmology and fluid simulations show that macrocanonical generators recover realistic samples from extremely small training sets, in some cases a single training example, while generating new realizations more than $10^6$ times faster per sample than the reference simulator and more than $10^3$ times faster than microcanonical gradient descent. The trained generators can be reused for downstream pretraining, including simulation-based inference, providing a data-efficient route to multi-fidelity scientific machine learning workflows.

</details>


### [324] [Basin2Vec: Learning Basin-Centric Embeddings for Scalable Hydrological Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05164)
*Muhammad Talha,Xiaofeng Liu,Yuan Yang,Pang-Ning Tan,A. Pouyan Nejadhashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Basin2Vec：一种自监督流域表征学习框架，从水文气候与地貌数据中学习紧凑流域表示（无需实测径流），在时间泛化与零样本空间迁移上优于手工属性与通用地球观测嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨时间可靠径流预测与无资料流域预测，需要能捕捉水文相关流域特征的表示；现有方法要么依赖固定手工属性，要么使用面向通用目的、未针对流域结构定制的地球观测嵌入。

Method: 提出 Basin2Vec 自监督框架，利用水文气候与地形地貌数据、不使用实测径流，围绕流域尺度以及时空关系组织表征学习，得到紧凑流域表示，并接入多种预测架构。

Result: 在多种预测架构下，时间泛化与零样本空间迁移均持续优于预定义属性和通用地理空间嵌入；时间维度平均相对提升达 8.3%，在未见流域上中位预测性能为最强基线的 3.5 倍。

Conclusion: 以流域为中心的表征预训练对可迁移水文预测有效，为无资料流域与跨时间径流预测提供了新范式。代码已开源。

Abstract: Reliable streamflow prediction across time and in ungauged basins requires representations that capture hydrologically relevant basin characteristics. Existing methods rely on either fixed handcrafted attributes or general-purpose Earth observation embeddings not tailored to basin structure. We introduce \textbf{Basin2Vec}, a self-supervised framework that learns compact basin representations from hydroclimatic and physiographic data without observed streamflow. Basin2Vec organizes representation learning around basin scale and relationships across space and time. Across multiple forecasting architectures, it consistently outperforms predefined attributes and general-purpose geospatial embeddings in temporal generalization and zero-shot spatial transfer. Basin2Vec provides average relative gains of up to 8.3% temporally and achieves 3.5x the median predictive performance of the strongest baselines on unseen basins. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of basin-centric pretraining for transferable hydrologic prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/Muhammad-Talha-MT/basin2vec

</details>


### [325] [Provably Learning Mixtures of Linear Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05184)
*Adrian Candocia,Aamod Varma,Mark Davenport*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次给出门控MoE（线性专家+高斯簇诱导门）联合训练的全局收敛保证：梯度EM在门控随机初始化、专家最小二乘初始化下，于对数级过参数化和门心分离条件下多项式迭代收敛到任意精度；实验验证m log m相变、LS热启动非必需、不加约束的混合权重使路由集中到真实专家数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE被广泛部署，但基于梯度的训练缺乏收敛保证：目标非凸，即使简单混合也会让一阶方法陷入伪局部最优。作者希望为门与专家联合训练建立全局收敛理论。

Method: 分析一个典型门控混合模型：线性专家 + 由输入空间高斯簇诱导的门，对似然做梯度EM；核心是把损失解耦为逐簇子问题，为耦合动力学建立梯度支配（gradient-dominance）不等式。

Result: 在相对真实专家数m的对数级过参数化、门中心分离条件下，梯度EM从随机门+最小二乘专家初始化出发，以多项式迭代数收敛到任意精度。实验验证了预测的m log m相变；最小二乘热启动在实践中并不必要，随机专家初始化表现接近；混合权重不约束时路由集中于真实专家数，负载均衡惩罚则使路由分散。

Conclusion: 为MoE联合训练提供首个全局收敛理论，并给出实践启示：过参数化尺度约为m log m，LS热启动可省略；权重自由化可自动得到可剪枝的稀疏路由模型，精度损失可忽略。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely deployed in modern machine learning. However, few convergence guarantees exist for gradient-based training of MoEs: the objective is nonconvex, and even simple mixtures trap first-order methods in spurious local optima. We analyze a canonical gated mixture featuring linear experts and a gate induced by Gaussian clusters in the input space, and give, to our knowledge, the first global convergence guarantee for jointly training the gate and the experts of such a model by gradient EM on its likelihood. Given a logarithmic overparameterization relative to the true number of experts $m$, gradient EM converges from randomly initialized gates and least-squares-initialized experts to any prescribed accuracy in polynomially many iterations, under a separation condition on the gate centers. Our analysis establishes a gradient-dominance inequality for the coupled dynamics by decoupling the loss into per-cluster subproblems. Empirical results validate the predicted $m\log m$ phase transition and suggest that the least-squares warm start required by our analysis is not needed in practice: randomly initialized experts perform nearly as well. We also find that leaving the mixing weights unconstrained concentrates routing onto the true number of experts, whereas load-balancing penalties spread it, so that the fitted model can be pruned to a fraction of its width without loss of accuracy.

</details>


### [326] [Stepsize modulation for cross entropy from local quadratic optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05191)
*Bruno Bauwens,Viacheslav Krivodub,Bingyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出两种基于额外前向传播估计小批量损失导数的学习率扰动方法，用于在SGD训练中微调已有学习率调度，使损失下降更快、更单调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有学习率调度（schedule）往往是预设的，未必适配当前小批量损失曲面；作者希望用廉价的导数估计动态地小幅上调或下调学习率，从而加速损失下降并提升训练单调性。

Method: 利用一次额外前向传播估计导数。方法一：线性化softmax值，最小化 1/2||y - q - ηq'||_F^2 求η；方法二：对minibatch损失做二次Taylor近似（在外层Hessian近似下），最小化 L(0)+ηL'(0)+1/2η²L''(0)。两者得到的η高度相似，随后用它略微调整既有调度。

Result: 两种方法给出的η值非常接近。在Cifar10/Cifar100上训练Resnet，相比被扰动的基线调度，损失下降更快、单调性更好；Cifar10测试精度有小幅提升，Cifar100测试精度基本不变。

Conclusion: 基于导数估计的学习率扰动是一种低成本、有效的调度增强手段，主要收益体现在优化速度与稳定性上，泛化精度提升有限。

Abstract: Two methods are presented that perturb a given learning rate schedule in stochastic gradient descent with cross entropy loss.
  Both methods use an extra forward pass to estimate various derivatives of the minibatch loss.
  The first method selects a value $η$ by linearising the softmax values and minimizing the squared error $\tfrac 1 2 ||y - q - ηq'||_F^2$, where $q$ is the matrix representing the softmax values of the minibatch and $y$ is the matrix with one-hot encodings of the labels. The second method considers a quadratic Taylor approximation of the minibatch loss under the outer approximation of the Hessian. Thus, it minimizes $L(0) + ηL'(0) + \tfrac 1 2 η^2 L''(0)$. Here, the derivatives $L'$ and $L''$ are computed from the derivatives of the logits (using the outer approximation of the Hessian of the loss).
  We observe that both methods give very similar values of $η$.
  Finally, these estimated $η$ are used to slightly increase or decrease the learning rate of an existing schedule. The method is evaluated on Cifar10 and Cifar100 datasets for training Resnets, where they decrease the loss faster than the schedule that is perturbed and increase monotonicity. For Cifar10 it also leads to a small improvement of test accuracy, but in Cifar100 test accuracy remains the same.

</details>


### [327] [Ensembles of Random Partition-Based Models under Covariate Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05195)
*Mary Versa Clemens-Sewall,Eliza O'Reilly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将协变量偏移严重性的理论从单模型推广到集成模型，提出新的偏移严重性度量以控制分区核估计器的风险，并证明足够大的集成规模下可达极小极大最优收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经验上集成模型（无论是否下游适配）比单模型对协变量偏移更鲁棒，但缺乏理论解释；单模型的协变量偏移严重性理论尚未覆盖集成。

Method: 扩展协变量偏移严重性理论到集成；引入新的协变量偏移严重性差异度量（discrepancy measures）；针对分区式核估计器进行风险控制分析。

Result: 证明在集成规模充分大时，分区基核估计器在协变量偏移下可达到极小极大最优的风险收敛率；偏移越严重所需集成规模越大。

Conclusion: 为集成模型鲁棒性提供理论依据，并给出实用指引：建模者应根据协变量偏移严重程度选择集成规模。

Abstract: Distribution shifts, including covariate shifts, are ubiquitous in real-world applications of machine learning. Empirical evidence suggests that, across a variety of models with and without downstream adaptation, ensembles tend to be more robust to covariate shift than single models. We extend the theory of covariate shift severity from single models to ensembles, providing theoretical justification for the empirical trends. We introduce new discrepancy measures of covariate shift severity to control the risk of partition-based kernel estimators. We then show that with sufficient ensemble size, these models can achieve minimax-optimal risk convergence rates under covariate shift. Our results suggest that modelers can expect to need larger ensemble sizes for more severe covariate shifts.

</details>


### [328] [Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05202)
*Daniel Aibinder,Azmi Haider,Dan Rosenbaum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM)，用蒙特卡洛随机近似 EM 框架直接从未直接观测的高维隐变量中学习 flow matching 先验，用于 cryo-EM 连续构象异质性建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维隐变量（如 cryo-EM 中 3D 原子结构）无法直接观测，只能通过复杂非线性前向算子得到的含噪 2D 投影间接推断；现有生成先验通常需干净数据预训练，难以适配非线性前向模型与连续异质性。

Method: EB-FM 交替执行 E 步与 M 步：E 步通过引导式 flow 生成从后验 p_θ(x|y) 近似采样，并用随机近似维护持续更新的隐变量估计；M 步以这些稳定化隐变量为目标更新 flow 模型。无需干净数据预训练，天然支持非线性前向模型。

Result: 在 two-moons 与 MNIST 的受控逆问题上验证有效；在已知位姿的模拟 cryo-EM 数据上，可直接在原子坐标空间恢复蛋白质构象的连续分布。

Conclusion: EB-FM 为间接含噪观测下的生成先验学习提供了无需预训练的实用框架，并展示了在 cryo-EM 连续构象异质性建模中的潜力。

Abstract: We address the problem of learning generative priors over high-dimensional latent variables from indirect, noisy observations, with a focus on continuous heterogeneity in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). In this setting, 3D atomic structures $x \in \mathbb{R}^{3N_a}$ are never directly observed and must be inferred from 2D projection images $y$ generated by a complex, non-linear forward operator. We propose Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM), a method that learns a flow matching prior $p_θ(x)$ directly from observations using a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework. EB-FM alternates between an E-step that performs approximate posterior sampling from $p_θ(x \mid y)$ via guided flow-based generation while maintaining persistent latent estimates through stochastic approximation, and an M-step that updates the flow model using these stabilized latent variables as training targets. This approach eliminates the need for pretraining on clean data and naturally accommodates non-linear forward models. We validate our method on controlled inverse problems using two-moons and MNIST data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on simulated cryo-EM data with known poses, showing that EB-FM can recover continuous distributions of protein conformations directly in atomic-coordinate space.

</details>


### [329] [Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05207)
*Juan Guevara,Riccardo De Santi,Andreas Krause,Raul Astudillo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HVFT（超体积微调），将单个预训练生成器微调为最大化样本期望超体积，同时以KL正则约束偏离预训练分布的程度，在肽与分子设计任务上取得最优的期望超体积与权衡覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现需要在多个相互竞争的性质之间取得有用权衡的设计（如高结合亲和力但难合成），而现有做法存在局限：推理时搜索每样本成本高；常规微调依赖固定的逐候选奖励，无法刻画候选之间的互补关系。

Method: 指出期望超体积无法写成固定逐候选奖励的期望，故不能用标准方法直接优化；关键观察是其一阶变分等于候选的期望边际超体积贡献，从而可用基于模型样本的无偏估计得到自适应奖励；HVFT据此将目标分解为一系列KL邻近的标量奖励子问题。

Result: 从理论上证明了该分布层优化过程的凹性、相对光滑性与收敛性保证；在离散扩散与连续流匹配模型上，针对治疗性肽与分子设计任务，HVFT均达到当前最优的期望超体积与权衡覆盖。

Conclusion: 以集体超体积为导向、用边际贡献构成自适应奖励的微调框架，可在接近预训练分布的前提下有效提升多目标权衡设计的质量与覆盖度。

Abstract: Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive reward via an unbiased estimator based on model samples. HVFT uses this reward to decompose the objective into a sequence of KL-proximal scalar-reward subproblems. We establish concavity, relative smoothness, and convergence guarantees for the resulting distributional procedure. Across therapeutic-peptide and molecular design tasks spanning discrete diffusion and continuous flow-matching models, HVFT achieves state-of-the-art expected hypervolume and trade-off coverage.

</details>


### [330] [Privacy for Free in Efficient Agnostic Halfspace Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05208)
*Giorgio Racca,Amartya Sanyal,Vikrant Singhal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首批计算高效且差分隐私的不可知半空间学习算法，在三种设置下隐私的样本复杂度代价与非隐私情形一致，实现"免费隐私"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不可知学习半空间是经典难题，此前缺乏既计算高效又满足差分隐私的算法；作者希望探明隐私约束是否必然带来样本复杂度损失。

Method: 分别针对三种设置设计差分隐私算法：(1)高斯与对数凹边缘分布下的 improper 学习；(2)高斯边缘分布下的 proper 学习；(3)semi-agnostic 学习。核心思路是使隐私机制带来的额外样本开销被非隐私样本复杂度吸收。

Result: 三种设置均获得计算高效的差分隐私算法，且隐私导致的样本复杂度增量与非隐私各设置的最优样本复杂度相同，即隐私无需额外代价。

Conclusion: 表明在不可知半空间学习中隐私可与计算效率兼得且不牺牲样本效率，部分回答了隐私代价何时为零的问题。

Abstract: We provide the first computationally efficient, differentially private algorithms for agnostically learning halfspaces. In particular, we study three different settings of agnostic learning: improper learning under Gaussian and log-concave marginals; proper learning under Gaussian marginals; and semi-agnostic learning under Gaussian marginals. In all three aforementioned settings, the added cost in the sample complexity due to privacy matches the respective non-private sample complexity, implying that we get privacy for free.

</details>


### [331] [Fusing Earth observation embeddings and spaceborne terrain with meteorological forcing for flood peak depth prediction from high-water marks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05220)
*Wen Zhou,Shaowen Wang,Upmanu Lall,Venkatesh Merwade,Dingqi Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出用USGS实测高水位标记（HWM）监督深度学习模型，融合星载地形、地理空间基础模型嵌入与前期气象强迫，在洪峰前6小时预测洪水峰值水深，MAE为0.39 m，优于DEM推算的0.93 m。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 洪水峰值水深是灾害损失与人员风险的关键，但观测稀疏（仅事后HWM调查）；基于卫星洪水范围推算的水深依赖DEM且继承其垂向误差；现有深度学习洪水模型多用水动力模拟而非实测水深训练。

Method: 汇集39场事件（2011-2025，24州及波多黎各）的5689个USGS HWM调查点，用邻近传感器确定洪峰时间，为每点配对同址无雨窗口，并链接Copernicus GLO-30地形、AlphaEarth嵌入及144小时逐时气象强迫（按预报提前期掩码）。构建跨模态融合网络进行监督训练。

Result: 在调查标记点处，洪峰前6小时预测深度MAE为0.39 m；同一位置直接用实测峰值水位与DEM求差为0.93 m（大2.4倍）。消融显示气象强迫贡献77%的误差降低，地形与嵌入统计等价，合计贡献剩余23%。在11场留出事件上，模型仍能区分洪水与无雨条件，但不再能解析标记点深度（R²=0.03）。

Conclusion: 实测调查水深可监督洪水深度预测，并隐式校正基于范围估计无法修正的地形误差；但向未见风暴的迁移仍是未解问题，当前技巧仅限于所采样的事件与区域。

Abstract: Flood peak depth on normally dry land governs damage and risk to life, but is observed only sparsely, by post-event high-water mark (HWM) surveys, and depth derived from satellite flood extent is produced after the event and inherits the vertical error of the digital elevation model (DEM) it is computed from. Deep-learning flood models have in turn been trained on hydrodynamic simulations rather than on observed depths. We ask whether flood peak depth can be learned from field observations and predicted before the peak from spaceborne terrain, geospatial foundation-model embeddings and antecedent meteorological forcing. We assembled 5689 USGS HWM surveys from 39 events (2011-2025) in 24 U.S. states and Puerto Rico, assigned each a peak time from nearby sensors, paired each with a rain-free window at the same site, and linked them to Copernicus GLO-30 terrain, AlphaEarth embeddings and 144 h of hourly forcing masked to the lead time. A cross-modal fusion network trained on these observations predicts depth at the surveyed marks with a mean absolute error of 0.39 m 6 h ahead of the peak. Supervision by surveyed depth corrects the DEM error implicitly: differencing the measured peak water level with the same DEM gives 0.93 m at the same marks, 2.4 times larger, although it uses the measured water level and the model does not. Forcing accounts for 77% of the attributed reduction in depth error; terrain and the embeddings are statistically equivalent to each other and contribute the remaining 23%. On eleven held-out events the model still separates flooded from rain-free conditions but no longer resolves depth at the marks (R2 = 0.03), so the skill reported here is confined to the events and regions sampled. Field-surveyed depths can thus supervise flood depth prediction and correct terrain error that extent-based estimation cannot, while transfer to unseen storms remains the open problem.

</details>


### [332] [Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05222)
*João Matos,Ben Van Calster,Richard D. Riley,Paula Dhiman,Gary S. Collins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统考察了8种基于AUC的临床预测模型公平性指标，指出AUC的非可合并性使子组与总体AUC不可直接比较，并据此评估各指标的估计目标与适用性，推荐以AUC矩阵和子组内AUC一致性为主要报告方式，否定gap-to-overall、equity-scaled与minimum类指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床预测模型的公平性评估常用跨子组AUC比较，但AUC是非可合并（non-collapsible）指标，子组AUC与总体AUC并不天然可比，而现有文献与实践中往往隐含假定其可比。作者因此质疑已有基于AUC的公平性指标应如何正确使用与解释。

Method: 选取文献中8种基于AUC的公平性指标（组内AUC一致性、跨组AUC（xAUC）一致性、gap-to-overall AUC、equity-scaled AUC、minimum类指标、xAUC¹、xAUC⁰、xAUC¹或xAUC⁰一致性），刻画其估计目标（estimand），将其与总体AUC分解为组内与跨组分量相联系，并进行批判性评述；随后以EuroSCORE II（院内死亡预测模型）为基础开展模拟，展示各指标的实际行为。

Result: 分析表明，AUC的可分解结构使多数指标的估计目标并非直观意义上的"公平性差距"。模拟显示：gap-to-overall AUC、equity-scaled AUC及minimum类指标比较的是本不应比较的量，且难以操作化；xAUC¹与xAUC⁰可将组内与跨组AUC汇总为单一值，有可取之处但解释复杂；跨组AUC一致性与校准可能冲突。

Conclusion: 建议主要报告AUC矩阵（含总体AUC及全部组内、跨组AUC分量）并辅以人群特征；若需公平性指标，推荐组内AUC一致性，跨组AUC一致性可作补充但须谨慎（可能与校准冲突）；xAUC¹/xAUC⁰类指标慎用；gap-to-overall、equity-scaled与minimum类指标不适用，一般不推荐。

Abstract: Fairness evaluation of clinical prediction models for binary outcomes often involves fairness metrics that compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, or c-statistic) across subgroups. However, the AUC has been shown to be a non-collapsible metric, meaning that its subgroup specific and overall values are not directly comparable as often implicitly assumed. This raises important questions about how existing AUC-based fairness metrics should be used and interpreted. We examine eight AUC-based fairness metrics proposed in the literature, including: within-group AUC parity; cross-group AUC (xAUC) parity; gap-to-overall AUC; equity-scaled AUC; minimum-based metrics; $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$; $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$; and $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ or $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ parity. We characterise their estimands, relate them to the decomposition of overall AUC (into within- and cross-group components), and critically appraise them. We then illustrate their behaviour using simulations based on the EuroSCORE II, a clinical prediction model for in-hospital mortality. We recommend reporting an AUC matrix, containing the overall AUC and all within- and cross-group AUC components, alongside population characteristics. When fairness metrics are needed, we recommend reporting the within-group AUC parity, with cross-group AUC parity providing supplementary information but requiring caution due to its potential conflict with calibration. Metrics involving $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ and $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ have merit, summarising within- and cross-group AUCs into single values, but their interpretation is non-trivial, and they should be used with caution. Gap-to-overall AUC, equity-scaled AUC, and minimum-based metrics compare quantities that should not be compared and it is unclear how to operationalise them, making them not fit for purpose and generally not recommended.

</details>


### [333] [Post-Inference Model Chaining: A Problem Statement and a Model-based Bootstrap for Training End-to-End Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05225)
*Lukas Madenach,Timo Bailer,Tobias Eilert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究串联式端到端数字孪生中用蒙特卡洛模拟（MCSim）将完整预测抽样逐级前传时的频率学预测性质，揭示其在潜均值确定、各阶段观测含独立正态误差时存在持续性的区间与覆盖率膨胀，并提出基于模型的bootstrap予以修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端数字孪生通常通过分别拟合各阶段模型并在推断后串联来构建。实践中常把完整预测抽样沿链条逐级前传（MCSim），但该做法的频率学预测性质（偏差、区间覆盖）缺乏系统检验，可能导致误导性的不确定性量化。

Method: 用两阶段解析例子推导；模拟4阶段与8阶段线性—二次一元链（7/15/30次训练运行）；用无误差潜训练预测变量做诊断以区分变量误差效应；提出模型bootstrap：初始链只前传拟合均值，bootstrap链在固定中心bootstrap数据上重拟合并前传均值预测，目标阶段未来误差进入学生化预测根。

Result: 两阶段解析显示持续的渐近区间与覆盖率膨胀，二次传播下均值偏差依赖待估参数；模拟显示明显的输入依赖失真。诊断表明主因并非变量误差，而是MCSim本身（甚至出现覆盖率低估）。bootstrap显著降低相对均值偏差，覆盖率更接近名义90%；样本量30时8阶段bootstrap平均宽度比1.16–1.42，而观测到观测的MCSim为4.11–4.97。补充材料中二元6阶段过程结果类似。

Conclusion: 在测试设定下，逐级前传完整预测抽样的MCSim会系统性夸大不确定性且产生参数依赖偏差；所提固定中心均值前传的模型bootstrap能改善端点预测的偏差与覆盖率，支持端到端数字孪生的可靠预测推断。

Abstract: End-to-end digital twins can be constructed by fitting separate stage models and connecting them after inference. We investigate the Frequentist prediction properties of a commonly used Monte Carlo simulation scheme that forwards complete predictive draws through such a chain when measured stage outputs contain independent normal errors, but the latent stage means are deterministic. Analytical two-stage examples show persistent asymptotic interval and coverage inflation and, with quadratic propagation, mean bias dependent on the parameters to be estimated. Simulations of four- and eight-stage linear-quadratic univariate chains with 7, 15 or 30 training runs demonstrate pronounced input-dependent distortions. A diagnostic using error-free latent training predictors shows that the effect is mainly not attributable to errors in variables, but to the MCSim approach even showing underestimation of coverage. We propose a model-based bootstrap: an initial chain forwards fitted means, bootstrap chains are refitted on fixed-center bootstrap data while forwarding their mean prediction, and a target-stage future error enters a studentized prediction root. Across the investigated scenarios, relative mean bias is substantially reduced, and coverage is closer to the nominal 90%. At sample size 30, the eight-stage bootstrap has mean width ratios of 1.16-1.42 relative to the known-parameter normal reference, compared with 4.11-4.97 for observed-to-observed MCSim. These results support improved endpoint prediction in the tested setting. Further investigations of the bootstrap scheme in the supplement for a bivariate 6-stage process show similar satisfactory results.

</details>


### [334] [Shrinkage prior for implicit generative models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05241)
*Shreya Sinha-Roy,Christian P. Robert,Ritabrata Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向隐式生成模型（如GAN类）的样本高效训练机制，利用收缩先验、正则化推断与广义贝叶斯框架，在似然不可解的情况下引入基于严格proper scoring rule的scoring rule后验，并用Gibbs采样中的分块SGMCMC实现高维参数空间的高效探索，从而获得神经隐式生成模型的稀疏表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式生成模型虽能成功建模复杂随机对象，但其似然函数不可解，导致稀疏诱导先验（在大p小n的线性回归中表现优异）难以直接应用于此类模型；同时，在p≫n设定下训练这类模型需要样本高效且能探索高维参数的机制。

Method: 1）采用收缩先验进行正则化推断；2）在广义贝叶斯框架下，基于严格proper scoring rule构造scoring rule后验，绕开不可解的似然；3）提出Gibbs采样内的分块SGMCMC机制，以识别稀疏表示，从而高效探索高维参数空间。

Result: 在p≫n线性回归实验和神经生成模型应用中验证了所提方法的性能，表明该方法能有效实现稀疏表示并高效探索高维参数空间。

Conclusion: 将收缩先验、scoring rule后验与分块SGMCMC结合，为隐式生成模型提供了一种样本高效且可处理似然不可解问题的训练方案，在p≫n场景下获得稀疏有效的高维参数解。

Abstract: Implicit generative models based on deep neural networks have revolutionized many scientific fields, from weather research to language generation. They successfully model complex random objects arising in real-world problems. In this work, we propose a sample-efficient training mechanism for these models. Our approach leverages regularized inference with shrinkage priors and generalized Bayes. In the large $p$ (parameter dimension) and small $n$ (sample size) setting, sparsity-inducing priors have been successfully used for linear regression when $p \gg n$. However, their application to implicit generative models remains challenging due to the intractability of the likelihood function. To address this, we adapt a scoring rule posterior based on a strictly proper scoring rule, following the generalized Bayes framework. We then propose a block SGMCMC within Gibbs sampling mechanism. This enables efficient exploration of high-dimensional parameter spaces by identifying a sparse representation of neural implicit generative models. We demonstrate the performance of our proposed method through experiments on $p \gg n$ linear regression and an application of neural generative models.

</details>


### [335] [Going Deeper With Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05255)
*Afshin Khadangi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeepMem 是一种因果多尺度字节级语言模型结构，将语义压缩与字节精确保留分离，在压缩瓶颈上做推理，从而以极低算力实现更强的语言建模与多语言表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 字节级语言模型虽摆脱分词器依赖、覆盖任意字节，但逐字节全分辨率处理成本过高，因此需要一种既保留字节无损性又能高效压缩的架构。

Method: 提出学习型可逆子带变换，构建短序列层级；用无损载波与显式细节边带保留字节身份；编码器沿路插入快速权重记忆块；在压缩瓶颈处做迭代共享状态计算；并由基于注意力的超分辨率解码器恢复字节分辨率表示。

Result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 与 PG19 上优于同规模字节级 Transformer，在 FLORES 各语言上取得最佳宏平均；PIQA 提升，代码建模、多选题推理与字节级损坏鲁棒性具竞争力；瓶颈精修所需计数 FLOPs 约为全分辨率推理的 1/7600，吞吐仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过多尺度分层压缩并在瓶颈处推理，可在保持字节级无损性的同时显著降低计算开销，兼顾性能与效率，为无分词器语言建模提供可行方向。

Abstract: Byte level language models avoid tokenizer dependence and provide universal coverage, but processing every byte at full resolution is expensive. We introduce DeepMem, a causal multiscale architecture that separates semantic compression from exact byte preservation. A learned invertible subband transform constructs a hierarchy of shorter sequences, while a lossless carrier and explicit detail sidebands preserve byte identity. Fast weight memory blocks operate along the encoder, with iterative shared state computation at the compressed bottleneck, while an attention based super resolution decoder restores byte resolution representations. DeepMem achieves stronger language modeling performance than a matched byte level Transformer on FineWeb-Edu and PG19, and obtains the best macro average performance across the evaluated FLORES languages. It also improves PIQA accuracy while remaining competitive on code modeling, multiple choice reasoning, and byte level corruption robustness. Bottleneck refinement requires approximately $7{,}600\times$ fewer counted FLOPs than equivalent full resolution reasoning, while maintaining competitive evaluation throughput.

</details>


### [336] [NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05260)
*Rui Qiao,Lei Xin,Baozhen Shan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NovoCRF 提出以质量前缀为状态、对全部质量可行肽段做精确全局归一化的 CRF 做从头肽段测序，仅 31 万参数，在多数据集上肽段/氨基酸召回优于 Casanovo v5，且速度提升 55 倍，并支持未见修饰的精确质量搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从头测序从人工设计的动态规划/生成式打分走向端到端大 Transformer，但训练目标未在所有满足母离子质量的肽段集合上精确归一化，可能导致概率不一致、效率低、召回受限。

Method: 构建状态为前缀质量的条件随机场，路径即母离子质量 ±0.06 Da 内的全部肽段；小网络基于物理推导的离子匹配特征为边打分，并对所有质量可行肽段的分数做精确全局归一化训练；软件分三模块：从 MS1 恢复精确母离子质量的模块、用精确 k-best 解码寻找符合母离子质量的 CRF、以及两个补充序列上下文与内部碎片证据的 BiGRU 重排器。

Result: 模型 310k 参数，约 17 GPU 小时训练。在 2026 年发布的七个 DDA 留出集（126,262 条谱）上平均肽段召回 42.4%（Casanovo v5 五束为 39.1%），氨基酸召回 64.0%（对 53.1%），18 CPU 线程下 1,746 谱/秒，为 Casanovo GPU 吞吐的 55 倍；在最多三个肽键缺失 b/y 离子的标签上领先，Casanovo 仅在更多缺失时更好；对羟基脯氨酸的精确质量搜索在狮骨样本中召回 32.1%。

Conclusion: 精确全局归一化的质量约束 CRF 为从头肽段测序提供了更小、更快且召回更高的替代方案，并具备零样本精确质量修饰搜索能力。

Abstract: De novo peptide sequencing has moved from dynamic programming over hand-designed or generative scores to large transformers that learn the task end to end. We present NovoCRF, a conditional random field (CRF) whose states are prefix masses, so that its paths are exactly the peptides within +/-0.06 Da of the precursor mass. A small network scores each edge from physics-derived ion-match features and is trained with its scores globally normalized over all mass-feasible peptides. To our knowledge, NovoCRF is the first de novo method trained with exact normalization over all mass-feasible peptides. Our software has three modules, each with exactly one job: a precursor mass finder recovers the accurate precursor mass from MS1, the CRF finds the peptides that fit the precursor mass by exact k-best decoding, and two BiGRU rerankers add sequence context and internal-fragment evidence. The model has 310k parameters and trains in about 17 GPU-hours. On seven held-out data-dependent acquisition datasets published in 2026 (126,262 labeled spectra), NovoCRF's mean peptide recall is 42.4%, against 39.1% for Casanovo v5 with five beams, and its amino-acid recall 64.0% against 53.1%, at 1,746 spectra/s on 18 CPU threads, 55x Casanovo's throughput on a GPU. Split by fragment evidence, NovoCRF leads on labels with up to three peptide bonds without a b or y ion, and Casanovo only beyond. NovoCRF can also search modifications it was never trained on at their exact mass: it finds 32.1% of the hydroxyproline peptides of a lion bone sample.

</details>


### [337] [Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05266)
*Kevin Frans,Alexander M Rush,Sergey Levine,Pieter Abbeel,Ashvin Nair*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"定向引导"(targeted guidance)框架，利用每轮的文本反馈通过on-policy自蒸馏为RL提供方向性信号，并结合逐条准则的RL奖励、仅在失败轮次提供反馈，从而在不损害基线RL性能的前提下改善难优化行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 朴素on-policy RL受限于基座模型能力，覆盖不足导致无法从某些奖励中学习；而现代后训练中的奖励常来自丰富文本来源（如带评分细则的评判模型）。作者希望利用这些结构化文本反馈，提供能改善"难以优化奖励"的方向性信号。

Method: 采用"定向引导"框架，从per-turn文本反馈经on-policy自蒸馏目标进行学习；将定向自蒸馏与per-criteria RL奖励相结合；并将反馈限制在策略具体失败的轮次上；同时研究使熵稳定、减少训练振荡的设计选择。实验在agentic多轮软件工程环境中进行。

Result: 在多种agentic多轮软件工程设置下，结合定向自蒸馏+per-criteria RL奖励、并仅在失败轮次提供反馈的方案取得成功；并总结出能稳定熵、降低振荡的设计选择。

Conclusion: 结构化文本反馈可作为有效的方向性信号辅助on-policy RL，关键在于与per-criteria奖励结合并聚焦失败轮次的反馈，同时需精细设计以维持训练稳定性，且不牺牲基线RL表现。

Abstract: Naive on-policy RL is often bottlenecked by the capabilities of the base model --- insufficient coverage can result in an inability to learn from certain rewards. At the same time, rewards in modern post-training systems often come from rich textual sources, e.g. judge models with a rubric of criteria. Can we utilize such structures to provide a rich directional signal that enables improving on otherwise difficult to optimize rewards? In this work, we examine a framework we refer to as targeted guidance that learns from per-turn textual feedback via an on-policy self-distillation objective. Our focus is not only on directly improving hard-to-optimize behaviors, but on how to do so throughout the training process without degrading baseline RL performance. Over a range of settings across an agentic multi-turn software engineering environment, we find success by combining targeted self-distillation with a per-criteria RL reward, and by limiting feedback to turns where the policy specifically fails. We further examine the design choices that lead to stable entropy and reduce oscillatory behavior throughout training.

</details>


### [338] [iGC: Antibody Optimization via Reinforcement Learning over a Learned Somatic Hypermutation Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05270)
*Thao Nguyen,Robert G. Alberstein,Ewa Nowara,Homa MohammadiPeyhani,Holly R. Steach,Sarah A. Robinson,Yuval Shechter,Donald W. Lee,Jason A. Vander Heiden,Franziska Seeger,Andrew Leaver-Fay,Richard Bonneau,Joshua Yao-Yu Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出iGC——一个两阶段强化学习框架，用于抗原特异性抗体亲和力成熟：先学习体细胞超突变的生物学先验，再在该先验约束下用带奖励税元梯度的强化学习优化抗原结合，兼顾突变真实性与亲和力提升及多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抗体亲和力成熟是B细胞通过SHM突变+抗原选择迭代优化的自然过程。计算建模需同时满足"生物学合理的突变"与"抗原特异性选择"，但现有突变模型不直接优化结合亲和力，而亲和力优化方法又常忽略真实的突变轨迹，二者割裂。

Method: 两阶段RL框架：(1) 阶段一从B细胞谱系树的亲子对中学习SHM突变先验，并适配到目标亲和力成熟数据集；(2) 阶段二以此先验初始化RL策略，用KL正则约束向冻结先验，优化抗原结合。为防止奖励利用（重复高奖励替换、结构容忍的框架突变），提出Reward-Tax元梯度目标：RewardNet平滑亲和力景观，TaxNet惩罚奖励过度开发，共同构成学习到的元奖励用于策略优化。

Result: 在突变预测、SHM一致性、亲和力优化、突变多样性四方面评估：突变先验在突变位点预测上超过最强基线两倍以上；RL优化后iGC保持SHM序列结构；在不同候选筛选阈值下取得较强探索-利用平衡，奖励-多样性乘积具竞争力。

Conclusion: iGC将生物学合理的突变生成与抗原特异性亲和力选择整合起来，为迭代式抗体亲和力成熟提供了in silico框架。

Abstract: Antibody affinity maturation is a natural optimization process in which B cells acquire mutations through somatic hypermutation (SHM), undergo selection for improved antigen binding, and iteratively evolve toward higher affinity. Computationally modeling this process requires capturing both biologically plausible mutations and antigen-specific selection. However, existing mutation models do not directly optimize binding, while affinity optimization often neglects realistic mutation trajectories.
  We introduce iGC (in silico Germinal Centers), a two-stage reinforcement learning (RL) framework for antigen-specific antibody optimization. Stage 1 learns an SHM mutation prior from parent-child pairs in B-cell lineage trees and adapts it to a target affinity-maturation dataset. Stage 2 initializes an RL policy from this prior and optimizes antigen binding with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the frozen prior. To prevent reward exploitation, including repetitive high-reward substitutions and structurally tolerated framework mutations, we introduce a Reward-Tax Meta-Gradient objective. RewardNet smooths the affinity landscape, while TaxNet penalizes reward overexploitation, jointly defining a learned meta-reward for policy optimization.
  We evaluate iGC on mutation prediction, SHM consistency, affinity optimization, and mutation diversity. The mutation prior more than doubles the strongest baseline in mutation-site prediction. Following RL optimization, iGC maintains SHM sequence structure. It also achieves a strong exploration-exploitation balance, yielding competitive reward-diversity products across candidate-selection cutoffs. These results demonstrate that iGC integrates biologically plausible mutation generation with antigen-specific affinity selection, providing an in silico framework for iterative antibody affinity maturation.

</details>


### [339] [De Rham cohomological architectures for PINNs and PDEs with topological holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05276)
*Andrew Gracyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Hodge-de Rham PINNs，通过 Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs 分解参数化 1-形式并结合 de Rham 上同调，缓解经典 PINN 在孔洞、穿刺等拓扑病态场景下的失效，并给出理论保证与多类实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 PINN 在存在孔洞/穿刺/极点/空腔的拓扑病态区域中易失效，原因包括界面不连续、闭路径积分非零、路径依赖，以及解不能表示为全局恰当形式等。作者希望从 de Rham 上同调角度系统性地解决这些失败模式。

Method: 对带边界流形上的 1-形式采用 Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs (HMF) 分解进行参数化，借助 HMF 同构定理与 de Rham 上同调建立联系；用积分算子把 1-形式映射为标量 PDE 解，并在该 1-形式对应的关联 PDE 上施加 PINN 损失，从而求解势函数问题。利用 Sobolev 正则算子与 Fréchet 微分关联缓解原始 PINN 失效。当损失上不满足可积性条件时，引入 exhaust（穷竭）函数辅助训练。

Result: 作者建立了方法的理论保证，并在多类拓扑不利问题上验证了“病态防护”效果，涵盖非恰当形式、非平凡调和项与余恰当项等场景；同时首次（据作者所知）在 PINN 文献中演示了 Aharonov-Bohm 效应。

Conclusion: 将 HMF 分解与 de Rham 上同调引入 PINN 框架，可有效处理孔洞类拓扑问题中的全局性与路径依赖困难，是对经典 PINN 的重要推广。

Abstract: We attempt to alleviate failure modes of classical physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in scenarios of topological pathologies corresponding to punctures, holes, poles, and voids by introducing de Rham cohomological augmentations, or Hodge-de Rham PINNs. Vanilla PINNs often encounter pitfalls in hole-based settings due to discontinuous interfaces, nonzero closed path integration, path dependence, correspondence to exact forms via the exterior derivative, etc., therefore we absolve traditional failures via parameterizing a 1-form by the Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs (HMF) decomposition for manifolds with boundary, drawing a connection to de Rham cohomology such as through the HMF isomorphism theorem. 1-forms can act as representations of scalar-valued PDE solutions through integral operator mappings. We propose performing a PINN-based loss on the parameterized 1-form through an associated PDE, which subsequently solves the potential-based PINN problem and moreover remedies the failures of vanilla PINNs via the Sobolev-regular operator under a Fréchet differentiation interconnection. The operator relationship often has a nontrivial closed-form and often requires integration or a case-by-case analysis, which we address thoroughly in our experiments. When an integrability condition is not met on our losses, we can equip exhaustion functions to train the networks. We demonstrate our methods on the Aharonov-Bohm effect, which, to our understanding, is largely nonexistent in PINN literature. We develop theoretical guarantees of our methods and demonstrate our pathological safeguards on a broad selection of topologically-adverse problems, including scenarios of inexact forms, and those of nontrivial harmonics and coexact terms.

</details>


### [340] [Universal Hardness From Masking Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05296)
*Parikshit Gopalan,Manoj Prabhakaran,Pranay Tankala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过凸对偶将硬核引理推广为一般的学习论硬度认证框架：用输入相关的掩码信道的保真度（fidelity）刻画非布尔函数在任意凸损失下相对于函数类C的学习难度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典硬核引理（Impagliazzo 1995）只针对布尔函数和0-1损失，且以硬核测度重加权输入分布的方式表述。作者希望将其推广到非布尔函数、多种硬度概念及多类情形，并给出"学习与硬度互为硬币两面"这一原则的清晰、一般化的形式化表述。

Method: 观察：硬核测度等价于一个输入相关的掩码信道，它向函数输出分布注入随机性直到看起来完全伪随机，测度密度对应信道的保真度。据此，通过凸对偶选取合适的保真度概念，构建认证硬度的通用框架；用"掩码信道的最大保真度"刻画用类C在凸损失下学习f的难度，并构造同时适用于多种自然硬度概念的通用掩码信道，分析其与omnipredictor的对偶关系及与伪熵的联系。

Result: 证明学习难度（用C最小化凸损失）被掩码信道可达到的最大保真度紧致刻画，即隐藏f结构、使其与随机噪声C-不可区分所需注入的最小噪声量。由此导出多个多类硬核引理推广，并揭示向更大字母表推广时的意外微妙之处；构造了适用于多种硬度概念的通用掩码信道，并给出基于机器学习MaxEnt算法对伪熵的紧致刻画。

Conclusion: 掩码信道与omnipredictor互为对偶，掩码信道与基于伪熵的硬核引理推广之间存在对称性。该框架通过凸对偶给出了"学习与硬度是同一硬币两面"的清晰而一般的表述。

Abstract: We prove a broad learning-theoretic generalization of the celebrated hardcore lemma concerning the average-case complexity of computing a Boolean function (Impagliazzo, 1995). Our starting point is the observation that the classic notion of a hardcore measure, which reweights a function's input distribution, is equivalent to an input-dependent masking channel that injects randomness into the function's output distribution until it appears fully pseudorandom. The analogue of density of the measure is the fidelity of the channel. From this viewpoint, we develop a general framework for certifying hardness that allows for non-Boolean functions $f$ and a wide range of notions of hardness besides the classic 0-1 loss, by choosing the right notion of fidelity via convex duality. We show the difficulty of learning $f$ using a class $\mathcal{C}$ to minimize a convex loss is tightly characterized by the maximum fidelity possible for a masking channel, which measures the least amount of noise the channel must add to hide the structure of $f$ and make it $\mathcal{C}$-indistinguishable from random noise. Using our framework, we derive a number of multiclass generalizations of the hardcore lemma, and reveal some unexpected subtleties in going to larger alphabets. We construct a universal masking channel that applies to many natural notions of hardness simultaneously. Such channels are dual to omnipredictors, which optimize multiple losses at once (Gopalan, Kalai, Reingold, Sharan, and Wieder, 2022). We observe a symmetry between masking channels and generalizations of the hardcore lemma using pseudoentropy. We present a tight characterization of pseudoentropy using the MaxEnt algorithm from machine learning. A long line of research has shown that learning and hardness are two sides of the same coin; our framework gives a crisp and general formulation of this principle via convex duality.

</details>


### [341] [$Φ$asmaNet: A Staged Spectral Token-Refinement Architecture for Fast Gravitational-Wave Signal-to-Noise Ratio Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05309)
*Ioannis Tsioulis,Anastasios Tefas,Nikolaos Stergioulas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ΦasmaNet——一种紧凑的神经架构，用于快速预测引力波信号的相位平均最优信噪比(SNR)，以加速种群研究中的选择效应量化，速度约比传统波形内积计算快两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引力波种群研究中的选择效应量化需要数百万次昂贵的SNR计算，计算成本极高，亟需快速且准确的替代方法。

Method: ΦasmaNet是一种结构化表格回归架构，采用分阶段光谱细化作为显式架构先验：可学习的输入token经过有序的基于注意力的Φ-Stages细化，每个阶段辅以Φ-Refractor子空间混合模块，再经门控自顶向下的Φ-Feedback重访。应用于进动、高阶模式双黑洞信号(IMRPhenomXPHM)的11维参数，在固定Advanced LIGO设计灵敏度下预测单探测器相位平均最优SNR。模型约732k参数。

Result: 在10^5–10^6样本匹配训练下优于MLP、1D-ResNet和Transformer编码器基线。10^6样本时测试集100-MAPE=98.73%，单调(PCHIP)校准后99.29%，探测相关区ρ>8达99.39%(R²=0.9998)，跨数据集实现稳定。单GPU每秒约1.2×10^5次SNR评估，10^6注入目录端到端约8.3秒，比16核CPU传统方法快约两个数量级。利用ρ∝1/d_L可实现精确距离重缩放。

Conclusion: 该流水线可作为可复现基准，在公开表格数据集上也具竞争力；虽目前针对固定单探测器配置，架构可扩展到探测器网络和不同历元灵敏度。

Abstract: Quantifying selection effects in gravitational-wave population studies requires millions of costly signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) calculations. We present $Φ$asmaNet, a compact neural architecture for structured tabular regression, with staged spectral refinement as an explicit architectural prior. Learned input tokens are refined through ordered attention-based $Φ$-Stages, each augmented by a $Φ$-Refractor subspace-mixing module, then revisited through gated top-down $Φ$-Feedback. Applied to the 11-dimensional parameters of precessing, higher-mode binary black hole signals (IMRPhenomXPHM), it predicts phase-averaged optimal SNR for a single detector at fixed Advanced LIGO design sensitivity. With approximately 732k parameters, it outperforms MLP, 1D-ResNet and Transformer-encoder baselines under matched training across $10^5$--$10^6$ samples. At $10^6$ samples, it achieves $100-\mathrm{MAPE}=98.73\%$ on the held-out test set, $99.29\%$ after rank-preserving monotonic (PCHIP) calibration, and $99.39\%$ ($R^2=0.9998$) in the detection-relevant regime $ρ>8$, with stable accuracy across independent dataset realizations. On a single GPU, it sustains approximately $1.2\times10^5$ SNR evaluations per second and processes a $10^6$-injection catalogue end-to-end in approximately 8.3 s, about two orders of magnitude faster than conventional waveform-and-inner-product calculations on a 16-core CPU. Exact distance rescaling through $ρ\propto1/d_L$ supports repeated catalogue-wide detectability evaluations. The fully documented pipeline is intended as a reproducible benchmark, while results on public tabular datasets indicate competitiveness beyond gravitational-wave applications. Although demonstrated for a fixed single-detector configuration, the construction supports extensions to detector networks and epoch-specific sensitivities. (Abridged)

</details>


### [342] [CATF: A Manager-Worker Framework for Context-Aware Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05325)
*Yueqiao Chen,Dongyu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CATF（Context-Aware Time-Series Forecasting）框架，用 Manager-Worker 架构对上下文做硬路由，让 Worker 无需人工划分数据即可自动专精，显著优于单模型、集成与 MoE 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文感知时间序列预测中，单一模型难以覆盖多样的上下文情境；而集成学习与 MoE 依赖人工数据划分或软路由，导致推理成本上升且可解释性差。

Method: CATF 采用 Manager-Worker 架构：基于 Transformer 的 Manager 根据上下文将每个输入硬路由到单个 Worker，训练与推理阶段均为硬路由；Worker 可为任意单模型预测器，从而实现自动专精而无需人工划分数据。

Result: 在 5 个富上下文数据集、4 个预测步长、2 种归一化方案下，CATF 在 200 组对比中 162 组优于其独立对应模型；最佳 CATF 增强模型在 20 个设置中 19 个超过最佳独立基线，并在 20 个设置中 15 个超过零样本 Time-MoE 基础模型。

Conclusion: CATF 通过可解释的上下文硬路由有效实现模型专精，性能稳定提升；案例研究显示 Manager 主要按日历信息路由，各 Worker 专精于不同的周模式，验证了其可解释性与有效性。

Abstract: We study context-aware time-series forecasting, in which a single target variable is predicted from its own history and a set of contextual variables, such as weather and calendar information. As the context becomes more diverse, a single model struggles to capture all of its regimes, while ensemble learning and Mixture-of-Experts approaches rely on manual data partitioning or soft routing, which increases the inference cost and hinders interpretability. We propose CATF, a Context-Aware Time-Series Forecasting framework built on a Manager-Worker architecture: a Transformer-based Manager routes each input to a single Worker based on the context, using hard routing during both training and inference. The Workers thus specialize without manual data partitioning, and any single-model forecaster can serve as a Worker. On five context-rich datasets, four horizons, and two normalization schemes, CATF improves over its standalone counterpart in 162 of 200 comparisons, the best CATF-enhanced model outperforms the best standalone baseline in 19 of 20 settings, and it outperforms the zero-shot Time-MoE foundation model in 15 of 20 settings. A case study on bike-sharing data shows that the Manager routes inputs by the calendar and that each Worker specializes in a different weekly pattern.

</details>


### [343] [Agnostic Learning by Imitating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05346)
*Sílvia Casacuberta,Parikshit Gopalan,Varun Kanade,Omer Reingold,Konstantinos Stavropoulos,Pranay Tankala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文证明判别式（agnostic learning）与生成式（indistinguishability / multiaccuracy）任务在计算复杂度上等价，并展示 multiaccuracy oracle 是强大原语。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨计算学习理论中两个基本任务——训练判别模型（agnostic learning）与训练生成模型（multiaccuracy，即输出对所有类内模型不可区分）——哪个更难，及其复杂度关系。

Method: 其一方向已有（用复杂性理论正则引理，boost 风格从 indistinguishability 归约到 agnostic learning）；主要贡献是反向的高效 oracle 归约，利用对 oracle 的自适应查询，将离线问题与在线无遗憾学习联系，用 follow-the-leader 类算法修改标签分布并聚合 multiaccuracy oracle 的预测。

Result: 证明两任务复杂度等价；multiaccuracy oracle 不仅能实现 agnostic learning，还能通过高效直接构造实现多种看似更难的学​​习目标。

Conclusion: 自适应查询使 multiaccuracy oracle 成为强大原语，与先前"单一 multiaccurate 预测器后处理不足以实现弱学习"的结论形成鲜明对比。

Abstract: Given a class of machine learning models and sample access to a data distribution with binary labels, which computational task is harder: training a discriminative model that distinguishes positive and negative labels as well as the best member of the class, or training a generative model whose outputs are indistinguishable from real data by all members of the class? We prove that these two fundamental tasks in computational learning theory are not just closely related, but actually equivalent to each other in complexity. One direction of this equivalence was previously known. Indeed, the powerful regularity lemma in complexity theory gives an efficient oracle reduction from the indistinguishability task (a.k.a. multiaccuracy) to the distinguishing task (a.k.a. agnostic learning) in the style of boosting algorithms. Our main contribution is an efficient oracle reduction in the other direction. Taking this idea further, we show that a multiaccuracy oracle is a remarkably powerful primitive, achieving not just agnostic learning but also a wide range of seemingly more demanding learning objectives via similarly efficient and direct constructions. Our results crucially use the power of making adaptive queries to the oracle, and stand in stark contrast to prior work, which showed that post-processing a single multiaccurate predictor is insufficient for even weak forms of learning. On a technical level, we draw a connection between our (offline) problem and a version of no-regret learning in the online setting, which allows us to use follow-the-leader type algorithms to modify the label distribution and aggregate the predictions of the multiaccuracy oracle.

</details>

### [344] [HyVox: Rethinking Low-Power Voice Intelligence towards Neuromorphic-von Neumann Edge Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03735)
*Snehasis Addy,Eduardo Calle Ortiz,Prashant Shenoy,Phuc Nguyen*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: HyVox 是一个神经形态–冯诺依曼混合系统，用于低能耗开集说话人识别：神经形态芯片负责事件驱动的稀疏嵌入，MCU 负责余弦打分、拒识与注册新用户，在 Common Voice 未见说话人上达到 99.6% top-1（2 人）与 5.5% EER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严格能耗预算下的开集说话人识别需要在芯片上高效运行，同时支持未知说话人拒识与免训练注册；纯神经形态方案难以承载画廊存储与决策，纯 ANN 嵌入式方案能耗与延迟偏高。

Method: 在说话人嵌入层切分负载：神经形态处理器上采用分层时间抽象（HTA）SNN 主干，832 个 LIF 神经元学习突触时间常数并分配快/中/慢尺度；32 神经元脉冲嵌入提取器（SEE）经含注册与拒识的 episode 预训练，输出 32 个脉冲计数作为两处理器唯一接口。为适配芯片突触与整数预算，主干压缩 6.5 倍至 29.0k 突触、按整数移位动态训练，并用芯片精确脉冲训练（CAST）——基于周期精确仿真器构建的可微整数神经元副本——微调权重与阈值。

Result: CAST 使映射后主干的未见说话人 top-1 翻倍；在 20 个 Common Voice 家庭上，2 成员时 99.6% top-1、5.5% 拒识 EER，20 成员时 94.9% 与 13.2%；片上网络与训练模型一致。3 秒窗推理耗时 0.96 s、动态能耗 1.63 mJ，比最快嵌入式 ANN 基线延迟低 42%，动态能耗低 13.5 倍、总能耗低 5.8 倍。

Conclusion: HyVox 表明神经形态计算可在极低能耗下承担说话人嵌入，而将画廊与决策留在 MCU 的混合切分既保留开集能力又实现免权重更新注册，显著优于嵌入式 ANN 基线的延迟与能耗。

Abstract: We present HyVox, a hybrid neuromorphic--von Neumann system for low-energy open-set speaker identification under tight energy budgets. HyVox splits the workload at the speaker embedding. A neuromorphic processor embeds the speech with sparse, event-driven computation, and a von Neumann microcontroller holds the speaker gallery and makes every decision: it scores queries by cosine similarity, rejects unknown speakers, and enrolls new users by writing a prototype, with no weight update. On the neuromorphic processor, a hierarchical temporal abstraction (HTA) SNN backbone learns a synaptic time constant per leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron, allocating 832 neurons across fast, medium, and slow timescales. A 32-neuron spiking embedding extractor (SEE), pretrained on episodes that each enroll new speakers and reject outsiders, turns the backbone output into an embedding for speakers unseen in training; its 32 spike counts are the only interface between the two processors. To fit the chip's synapse and integer budgets, we compress the backbone 6.5x to 29.0k synapses, train it for integer bit-shift dynamics, and fine-tune it with chip-accurate spiking training (CAST). CAST trains through a differentiable replica of the chip's integer neuron update, derived from its cycle-accurate simulator, so that gradient descent optimizes the exact weights and thresholds the chip runs; it doubles the top-1 accuracy of the mapped backbone on unseen speakers. On 20 Common Voice households of unseen speakers, HyVox reaches 99.6\% top-1 and 5.5\% rejection EER with 2 members and 94.9\% and 13.2\% with 20, and the network deployed on the neuromorphic chip matches its trained model. Each inference on a 3-s window takes 0.96 s and 1.63 mJ of dynamic energy, 42\% lower latency than the fastest embedded ANN baseline and 13.5x less dynamic and 5.8x less total energy than the most energy-efficient one.

</details>


### [345] [Refined CMA-ES for CEC 2026 Bound-Constrained Single-Objective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04620)
*Adam Stelmaszczyk,Rafał Biedrzycki,Jarosław Arabas*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Refined CMA-ES，一个为 CEC 2026 有界约束单目标优化竞赛设计的简化、参数调优版 CMA-ES，通过移除无益组件并调整种群规模和初始步长，超越基线及多个先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规算法研究倾向于不断添加机制来提升性能，但组件是否真正有效往往缺乏验证。作者希望检验在 CEC 2026 排名规则（精度与收敛速度等权）下，各 CMA-ES 组件的实际贡献，并探索"做减法+调参"能否带来更优表现。

Method: 以标准 CMA-ES 为基础，系统性地移除未带来性能提升的组件（如 flat-land escape），保留有可测收益的标准特性；同时调整关键参数（种群规模与初始步长），在 CEC 2026 有界约束单目标基准上进行评估。

Result: 简化加参数调整后的 Refined CMA-ES 优于基线 CMA-ES 及若干当前先进竞赛方法，参数调整带来显著性能增益。

Conclusion: 在 CEC 2026 评分体系下，简化结构配合更优参数设置即可实现超越复杂机制的性能，凸显了个别 CMA-ES 组件的实际价值与"消融式"方法设计的实用意义。

Abstract: We present a simplified and parameter-adjusted variant of CMA-ES designed for the CEC 2026 Bound-Constrained Single-Objective Optimization competition. Unlike typical algorithmic developments that increase complexity by adding mechanisms, Refined CMA-ES systematically removes components that do not improve performance, such as the flat-land escape, while retaining standard features that provide measurable benefits. Adjusting key parameters (population size and initial step-size) yields substantial gains, outperforming the baseline CMA-ES and several state-of-the-art competitors. The paper highlights the practical relevance of individual CMA-ES components under the CEC 2026 ranking, which equally weights solution accuracy and convergence speed, demonstrating that simplification combined with improved parameter settings can lead to superior performance.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [346] [Alignment Faking Depends on the Value, Not Just the Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03650)
*Manodeep Ray,Vivek Srivastava,Shirish Karande,Murari Mandal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出按价值维度刻画"对齐伪装"（Alignment Faking）的评估框架，在32个ValueBench价值维度、10个开源/闭源模型上测量合规缺口，发现该现象高度依赖"模型—价值"配对，并给出推理轨迹分类与value cards。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作只在有害内容目标和少数道德基础价值上证明模型存在"被监控时服从、不被监控时放弃"的对齐伪装，尚不清楚这一行为在更广价值空间中的分布规律。作者主张对齐伪装是价值依赖的，是"模型—价值"配对的属性，而非模型单独属性。

Method: 构建逐价值画像框架，对每个"模型—价值"配对在三种条件下打分：bare（无系统提示）、unmonitored（不被监控）、monitored（被监控）；覆盖32个ValueBench维度和10个8B~675B参数的开源与闭源模型；并对推理轨迹做六类分类法分析。

Result: 合规缺口跨度0.05–0.50；蒸馏70B模型表现超过~675B模型；结构方差大部分来自"哪个模型被问哪个价值"的交互项，而非模型或价值单独效应；监控下以训练信号推理为主，非监控下以价值冲突推理为主。

Conclusion: 对齐伪装应被刻画为模型—价值配对层面的行为倾向；作者将逐模型结果打包为value cards，扩展模型卡以包含行为倾向信息，并公开代码与数据。

Abstract: Language models can follow a directive when they believe they are monitored and abandon it when they believe they are not, a pattern termed Alignment Faking. Prior work establishes this for harmful-content objectives and a handful of moral-foundations values, leaving open how it distributes across a wider value space. We argue it is value-dependent: whether compliance survives a change in perceived oversight is a property of the model--value pairing, not of the model alone. Our framework profiles Alignment Faking per value, scoring each model-value pair under three conditions: bare (no system prompt), unmonitored, and monitored. On 32 ValueBench dimensions across ten open- and closed-weight models (8B-~675B), compliance gaps span 0.05-0.50, with a distilled 70B above a ~675B model. We observe that majority of the structural variance depends on which model was asked about which value and not on the model or value alone. A six-category taxonomy over reasoning traces tracks the behavioural shift: training-signal reasoning dominates under monitoring and value-conflict reasoning dominates when unmonitored. We package per-model results as value cards, extending model cards with behavioral disposition. Code and data are available at https://github.com/respailab/VALET.

</details>


### [347] [CARD: A Proof-Carrying Certificate-to-Action Interface for Relative-Measurement Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03651)
*Yushan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CARD——一个"携带证明"的接口框架，将几何证书、物理变换、服务决策与证明获取作为彼此区分的对象并记录其组合方式，并在航空测绘与SLAM数据集上验证其语义一致性、可服务性规律与计算效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何证书只对指定估计器对象做数学断言，而机器人行动需要真实物理变换、服务决策与及时证明支持；现有方法混淆了这些对象，需明确区分它们并刻画其组合关系。

Method: 提出lifted-fiber表述，将语义运动与见证修复分离，刻画投影成本与证明携带成本何时相等；给出一项可服务性结果（精确的useful-service law）：无放回均匀采样产生超几何产出，而从合格总体中采样则在观测到的live-confirmation条件下每次请求得到一个有用服务；结合404个Full16案例实测与11个KITTI/EuRoC/TUM SLAM案例的公共下游评估。

Result: 404个经checker确认的优化点全部与参考不一致（中位数旋转1.9891°、平移21.6322 m），而配对因果导航变换全部一致（0.0036566°、0.0104519 m）。五个匹配请求预算下超几何预测与实际均值最大差0.8412个服务；普通匹配随机0/50成功，actionability匹配随机50/50且与CARD策略一致。随机vs CARD图干预的优化器墙钟时间比为1.128x–67.65x，差异源于消元填充、Cholesky因子规模与数值分解。

Conclusion: 通过显式系统对象，将证书语义、物理执行、证明获取与图计算连接起来，验证了CARD在语义一致性、可服务性与计算效率上的有效性。

Abstract: Geometric certificates make mathematical claims about specified estimator objects, while robotic action requires a physical transform, a service decision, and timely proof support. We present CARD, a proof-carrying interface that keeps these objects distinct and records how they combine. Its lifted-fiber formulation separates semantic motion from witness repair and characterizes when projected and proof-carrying costs coincide. Its actionability result gives an exact useful-service law: uniform sampling without replacement produces a hypergeometric yield, while sampling from the eligible population gives one useful service per request under the observed live-confirmation condition. The primary study contains 404 Full16 cases from 20 sorties of an AA15-X500 airborne survey system. All 404 checker-confirmed optimizer points are reference-discrepant, with median rotation and translation discrepancies of 1.9891 degrees and 21.6322 m. The paired causal-navigation transforms are reference-consistent in all 404 cases, with medians of 0.0036566 degrees and 0.0104519 m. Across five matched request budgets, the largest difference between the hypergeometric prediction and the observed ordinary-random mean is 0.8412 services. Ordinary matched random reaches 0/50 target successes, while actionability-matched random reaches 50/50 and matches the CARD policy. Public downstream evaluation on 11 KITTI, EuRoC, and TUM SLAM cases measures optimizer wall-time ratios of 1.128x-67.65x for random versus CARD graph interventions. Native solver records locate this difference in elimination fill, Cholesky factor size, and numeric factorization. Together, these results connect certificate semantics, physical execution, proof acquisition, and graph computation through explicit system objects.

</details>


### [348] [Learning Behaviorally Relevant Dynamics in Multimodal Neural Recordings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05167)
*Parastoo Azizeddin,Eray Erturk,Maryam M. Shanechi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BREM-NET：一种非线性多模态动态模型，将行为与多种统计特性、时间分辨率不同的神经模态联合建模，在推理时进行多模态神经融合，并通过结构化学习分离行为相关与残余神经动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态神经数据（spikes、LFP、行为）从不同时空角度刻画脑活动，但以往神经-行为模型仅依赖单一模态，难以获得对脑-行为过程的统一完整表征。

Method: 提出 BREM-NET 非线性多模态动态模型，整合行为与多种异构神经模态，在推理阶段完成多模态融合，用结构化学习框架将神经动态分解为行为相关成分与残差成分。

Result: 在公开的非人灵长类同步 spike 与 LFP 二维伸手任务数据上，模型更好地分离两类动态，行为解码更准确、神经预测更好、行为-潜变量对齐更强；在模态异步或缺失（dropout）等真实录制挑战下仍保持优势。

Conclusion: 该框架为跨时空尺度研究行为相关神经计算提供了新工具。

Abstract: Multimodal neural data can enable a more complete understanding of brain dynamics underlying behavior. Modalities such as spiking activity, local field potentials (LFPs), and behavior capture diverse spatiotemporal aspects of brain processes, yet prior neural-behavioral models that separate sources of variability rely on a single neural modality. By leveraging these complementary strengths, multimodal neural fusion can provide a unified, rich representation of brain-behavior processes and address the limitations of single-modality analyses. Here we develop BREM-NET, a nonlinear multimodal dynamical model that integrates behavior with multiple neural modalities having distinct statistical characteristics and temporal resolutions. BREM-NET performs multimodal neural fusion during inference while separating behaviorally relevant and residual neural dynamics via a structured learning framework. In a public multimodal non-human primate dataset with simultaneous spiking and local field potential recordings during a 2D reaching task, BREM-NET separates these two types of dynamics and learns them more accurately, as reflected in better behavior decoding, better neural prediction, and stronger latent alignment with behavior, and it retains these capabilities when neural modalities are asynchronous or suffer dropouts, which are major challenges in real-world recordings. This framework provides a new tool for studying behaviorally relevant neural computations across spatiotemporal scales of brain activity.

</details>


### [349] [MCPGuard: Finding Conformance Gaps in MCP SDKs via Dual-Track Analysis and Dynamic Adjudication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03662)
*Xikai Sun,Kebin Liu,Fan Dang,Yawen Zheng,Zihao Yang,Yunhao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM的自动化框架MCPGuard，检测MCP规范到SDK的一致性缺口，在官方Python与TypeScript SDK中分别确认13与19个问题，且黑盒基线无法发现，并证明缺口会向下游传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP官方SDK会省略规范约束，而现有MCP一致性测试工具主要针对运行中的端点，几乎无法揭示SDK模型是否强制执行规范要求，因此SDK级别的一致性测试缺位。

Method: MCPGuard含两条分析轨道：结构轨道将JSON Schema约束与规范化SDK模型对齐并生成约束级证据；行为轨道提取规范性文字规则、检索限定范围内的函数级切片并用LLM审计候选遗漏。随后由证据感知的动态裁决器检查完整源码上下文并构建PoC验证候选，共享内核加语言适配器支持多SDK分析。

Result: 在官方Python 1.26.0与TypeScript 1.29.0 SDK上分别确认13与19个问题，两个黑盒基线均未暴露；对开放MCP服务器的测试显示这些缺口会系统性地传播到下游。

Conclusion: MCPGuard使规范约束的SDK一致性可直接测试，作为面向端点的一致性测试套件的补充，提升MCP生态的可靠性。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects large language model agents to external tools and services through official SDKs that implement message validation and session logic. Specification constraints omitted by these SDKs may propagate to downstream applications, highlighting the importance of SDK-level conformance testing. Yet existing MCP conformance tools mainly exercise running endpoints and reveal little about whether SDK models enforce specification requirements. We present MCPGuard, an automated LLM-based framework for detecting specification-to-SDK conformance gaps. Its structural track aligns JSON Schema constraints with normalized SDK models and produces constraint-specific evidence. Its behavioral track extracts normative prose rules, retrieves bounded function-level slices, and audits them with LLMs for candidate omissions. An evidence-aware dynamic adjudicator then inspects complete source context and builds PoCs to validate candidates. A shared kernel with language-specific adapters enables analysis across SDKs. On the official Python 1.26.0 and TypeScript 1.29.0 SDKs, MCPGuard confirms 13 and 19 findings, respectively, none of which are exposed by two black-box baselines. Tests on open MCP servers further show that these gaps can systematically propagate downstream. By making SDK conformance of specification constraints directly testable, MCPGuard complements conventional endpoint-oriented conformance suites.

</details>


### [350] [DGC-Net: Cross-Modal Dynamic Routing with Global-Guided Compensation in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04841)
*Linan Zhu,Huaijing Wu,Xiao Han,Yuhao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DGC-Net，通过跨模态贡献感知的动态专家路由和全局引导的动态补偿融合，解决多模态情感分析中局部情感线索的跨模态不一致与全局-局部贡献失衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有局部情感线索建模多在单模态内进行，忽略其他模态的全局上下文，导致跨模态情感线索不一致；层次化全局-局部融合方法 implicitly 决定两类表示的相对贡献，无法随样本依赖的局部线索可靠性自适应，造成信息性局部线索利用不足或不可靠线索干扰过度。

Method: DGC-Net包含两部分：1）跨模态贡献感知的动态专家路由，利用辅助全局上下文指导局部专家的选择，缓解跨模态情感线索不一致；2）全局引导的动态补偿融合，以全局语义为主锚点，自适应融入专家精炼后的局部线索，缓解样本依赖的全局-局部贡献失衡。

Result: 在五个多模态基准数据集上的实验验证了DGC-Net的有效性与通用性，消融实验证实了各提出组件的贡献。

Conclusion: DGC-Net通过动态门控与全局引导补偿机制，有效提升了多模态情感分析中情感线索融合的鲁棒性与适应性。

Abstract: User-generated videos, including opinion vlogs and video reviews, provide a rich source of people's attitudes toward products, services, and social topics. Understanding the sentiment expressed by speakers is important for analyzing online opinions, as transcripts alone may not capture the attitude and intensity conveyed through vocal tone and facial expressions. Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) addresses this need by integrating textual, acoustic, and visual cues. However, these cues are often subtle, noisy, and inconsistent across modalities. Existing local affective cue modeling methods typically operate within individual modalities and overlook global contexts from other modalities. This may cause cross-modal affective cue inconsistency. Hierarchical global-local fusion methods integrate global semantics with fine-grained local affective cues. However, they commonly determine the relative contributions of the two representations implicitly, preventing the global-local contributions from adapting to the sample-dependent reliability of local cues and resulting in either insufficient use of informative local cues or excessive interference from unreliable ones. To address these issues, we propose DGC-Net, a Dynamic Gating and Global-Guided Compensation Network for MSA. DGC-Net mitigates cross-modal affective cue inconsistency through cross-modal contribution-aware dynamic expert routing. This mechanism uses auxiliary global contexts to guide local expert selection. Moreover, global-guided dynamic compensation fusion alleviates sample-dependent global-local contribution imbalance while preserving global semantic as the primary anchor and adaptively incorporating expert-refined local cues. Experiments on five multimodal benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of DGC-Net, and ablation studies verify the contribution of each proposed component.

</details>


### [351] [Functional-Group Knowledge Is Structured in Language Models Before It Is Spoken](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03684)
*Tran Nhat Khang Nguyen,Anh Nguyen,Obed Issakah,Janghoon Ock*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文通过读取五个开源模型的内部表征（92种分子、20个官能团），发现即使未经化学训练，模型也在中层突然形成按化学家族组织的官能团表征，且其输出错误多为"答不出"而非"答错"，即知识先于表达存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用于化学与材料科学的语言模型必须理解分子结构，但仅看输出无法区分"没识别出氟原子"和"识别了却没说对"，需要一种能区分缺乏知识与表达失败的评价方式。

Method: 构建覆盖92种分子、20个官能团的提示集，读取并分析五个开源模型的内部表征，考察官能团是否按化学家族聚类、化学差异是否编码为一致方向，以及表征随层数的变化；另比较基座模型与化学微调模型。

Result: 模型无需化学训练即可按化学家族组织官能团，化学差异对应一致方向（如硫醚→硫醇的变化最接近醇）；这种结构在中间层突然出现，表征从追踪提示措辞转向追踪官能团。基座模型正确率仅58.5%（五者最低），但仍编码了有意义的化学模式，错误多为无法作答而非答错。化学微调会重组表征，使官能团而非措辞占主导。

Conclusion: 仅以输出评价化学语言模型会低估其编码的化学信息；表征分析可区分知识缺失与表达失败，对选择与适配化学智能体模型具有实际意义。

Abstract: Language models serve as the reasoning core of agents for chemistry and materials science, where they must interpret molecular structure before planning syntheses or proposing materials. Yet their outputs show only what they say, not what they know. Given a prompt such as ``The primary functional group in 1-Fluorobutane (CCCCF) is'', a small general-purpose model may answer ``the alkyne group'' instead of an alkyl fluoride. The output alone cannot tell whether the model failed to recognize the fluorine or recognized it and failed to say so. We address this by reading the internal representations of five open-source models on prompts covering 92 molecules and 20 functional groups. Even without chemistry training, the models organize functional groups by chemical family, and they encode chemical differences as consistent directions. The shift from thioether ($\mathrm{R{-}S{-}R'}$) to thiol ($\mathrm{R{-}SH}$), added to ether ($\mathrm{R{-}O{-}R'}$), lands nearest alcohol ($\mathrm{R{-}OH}$). This structure emerges abruptly in the middle layers, where representations shift from tracking the wording of the prompt to tracking the functional group. The base model names the correct functional group in only 58.5\% of prompts, the lowest of the five, yet it encodes functional-group families and preserves chemically meaningful patterns. Its errors are mostly failures to answer rather than wrong answers. Functional-group knowledge is structured in the model before it is spoken. Chemistry fine-tuning reorganizes it, making functional groups rather than prompt wording dominate the representation. These results suggest that evaluating chemical language models through outputs alone can underestimate the chemical information they encode. Representation analysis can distinguish a lack of knowledge from a failure to express it, which matters when choosing or adapting models for chemical agents.

</details>


### [352] [LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03685)
*Zhaojian Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LOLPlay基准，在《英雄联盟》中构建36个英雄专属任务，评估视觉智能体的推理-行动协同能力；发现增加推理强度并不能提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉智能体需要在环境动态演变中协调推理与行动，但缺乏贴近真实复杂环境的评测基准，尤其在实时控制场景下推理与行动的权衡不明。

Method: 构建原生《英雄联盟》基准LOLPlay，含36个英雄专属任务（资源管理、战斗、协作、目标）。智能体仅通过截图与鼠标-键盘动作交互；采用自动化初始化与82个可执行子目标检查区分部分进展与完成。对三个模型在三种推理强度下进行324次任务评估。

Result: GPT-6 Astra在低/中推理强度下取得最高任务成功率25.0%，中强度下最高子目标成功率40.3%；但对任何模型而言，高强度推理均未优于低强度。对Astra而言，更长的推理请求减少交互轮次，表明实时控制中额外推理存在代价；轨迹显示存在子目标组合不完整及在场景变化后仍执行动作的问题。

Conclusion: 实时视觉控制任务中，更多推理未必带来提升，反而可能挤占交互机会。未来需发展结合视觉推理与及时行动的智能体，并关注子目标的完整组合与动作时效性。

Abstract: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native \emph{League of Legends} with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse--keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0\% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3\% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. Trajectories reveal incomplete subgoal composition and actions executing after the observed scene changes, motivating agents that combine visual reasoning with timely action.

</details>


### [353] [Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03698)
*Shuzheng Gao,Zhaojian Yu,Penghao Yin,Yuling Shi,Kai Cai,Shilin He,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RSI-Dojo 构建可执行的模型训练环境集合，用于教会 LLM 智能体进行后训练，并蒸馏出 RSI-Dojo-9B/35B 模型，在 PostTrainBench 上显著超越基座模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）需要智能体具备训练与改进基座模型的能力，但现有自动化模型训练研究多停留在工作流或脚手架层面的优化，未把后训练能力内化到模型本身。培养该能力依赖可执行训练环境及高质量轨迹（数据选择、训练、失败诊断、迭代改进），而此类环境稀缺。

Method: 提出 RSI-Craft 自动流水线：从顶会论文中收集研究工件，将数据集与指标实例化为统一接口并复现评测依赖，再按数据规模、执行可靠性与可区分性过滤，得到 281 个种子训练任务构成 RSI-Dojo。随后用改进脚手架从前沿模型采集轨迹，经 rubric 与结果双重过滤，微调 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。

Result: RSI-Dojo-9B 与 RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B 分别较基座模型提升 8.74 与 16.87 个 PostTrainBench 分数；后者达到 PostTrainBench 29.95、PostTrainBench-Lite 53.29，与 GLM-5.2、GPT 5.5 等前沿模型相当。

Conclusion: 可执行、自动构建的训练环境能有效将后训练能力内化为模型能力，小规模开源模型经轨迹蒸馏后可在后训练基准上逼近前沿闭源模型，为 RSI 议程提供了可复用的环境与数据基础。

Abstract: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) aims to enable AI systems to autonomously build and improve AI systems themselves, including models, harnesses, and underlying infrastructure. Within this broader agenda, a central capability is enabling agents to train and improve base models. However, existing studies on automated model training primarily focused on workflow- or harness-level optimizations, rather than internalizing the ability to conduct post-training into the model itself. Developing this capability requires executable model training environments that can produce high-quality trajectories demonstrating how to select data, train models, diagnose failures, and iteratively improve results. In this paper, we introduce RSI-Dojo, a collection of executable model training environments designed to teach LLM agents to conduct post-training. To construct RSI-Dojo, we develop RSI-Craft, an automatic pipeline that converts human research artifacts into executable model training environments. RSI-Craft automatically collects research papers from top venues, instantiates datasets and metrics into a unified interface, and reproduces evaluation dependencies. It then filters tasks by data size, execution reliability, and discriminability, yielding RSI-Dojo with 281 seed model training tasks. Building on RSI-Dojo, we employ a trajectory collection method with an improved harness to collect high-quality model-training trajectories from frontier models, then retain examples through rubric-based and outcome-based filtering. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories. The resulting RSI-Dojo-9B and RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B improve over their base models by 8.74 and 16.87 PostTrainBench points, respectively. RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B reaches 29.95 on PostTrainBench and 53.29 on PostTrainBench-Lite, matching the performance of frontier models such as GLM-5.2 and GPT 5.5.

</details>


### [354] [Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03713)
*Ethan Ji,Wei Wang,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Unsatz是一个要求LLM智能体自行构建模型形式的基准，在20个领域80个模拟系统上，九个模型得分21%–60%，表明难点在于发现模型结构而非估计系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动方程发现基准通常直接提供变量、候选项库或待修改的定律，即预先给出"ansatz"（试验形式），回避了科学家真正面临的建模选择难题。作者希望考察智能体能否自主决定模型包含哪些量、哪些是隐变量、如何相互作用与测量。

Method: 构建Unsatz基准：每项任务是由私有种子生成的模拟系统，用小型建模语言写成（ODE、延迟方程、PDE、离散映射、静态与因果模型、随机过程），可含隐藏状态、失真传感器与无信息测量通道。智能体需在预算内购买实验，用同一语言写候选程序，由基准的拟合器给出系数，最终仅以其程序在未见情形（超出探索范围的条件、干预、更长运行）上的预测表现评分。

Result: 九个语言模型在80个系统、20个领域上的成功率介于21%到60%。在44个系统上经典方程发现方法几乎从不成功，而当给定正确方程仅系数未知时，同样的数据通常足够——说明困难在结构发现而非系数估计。复用相关系统上已发现的程序，仅在新系统共享机制且首次探究成功时才有帮助。更强的智能体犯的"非科学"错误更少；但它们仍只能识别系统有哪些变量，无法确定变量如何作用，且偏好降低训练误差的修改而非预测更准的修改。

Conclusion: 结构发现是自动化科学发现的核心瓶颈，当前LLM智能体在此显著不足；模型选择导向（追求预测泛化）而非仅拟合训练误差，是智能体与现实科学实践之间的关键差距。

Abstract: Before a scientist fits any parameter, they must decide what the model contains: which quantities exist, which are hidden, how they interact, and how they are measured. Physicists call such a trial form an ansatz. Benchmarks for automated equation discovery mostly supply it, by fixing the variables, a library of candidate terms, or a law to be modified. We introduce Unsatz, a benchmark in which an LLM agent must construct the ansatz itself. Each task is a simulated system, generated from a private seed as a program in a small modeling language: ordinary, delay, or partial differential equations, discrete maps, static and causal models, or stochastic processes, possibly with hidden states, distorted sensors, and uninformative measurement channels. The agent buys experiments within a budget, writes candidate programs in the same language, obtains their coefficients from the benchmark's fitter, and is scored only on how its final program predicts experiments it never saw: conditions outside the range it could explore, interventions, and longer runs. Across 80 systems in 20 domains, nine language models solve between 21% and 60%. On 44 of these systems, classical equation-discovery methods almost never succeed, although the same data usually suffice once the true equations are given with unknown coefficients; the difficulty lies in finding the structure, not in estimating it. Because mechanisms recur across systems, we also give agents the program they discovered for a related system; it helped only when the new system shared the mechanism and the first investigation had succeeded. Stronger agents make fewer unscientific errors; beyond these, agents find which variables a system has but not how they act, and prefer revisions that lower the training error to revisions that predict better.

</details>


### [355] [Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03721)
*Bowen Zhu,Jian Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开源框架Simjecture，用语言模型智能体围绕人类设定的物理猜想，以反例驱动证伪与假设修复的方式开展研究，并以计算物理作为可执行测试平台；在82.6小时的Z-pinch辐射能量超出内爆壳动能的长期问题上揭示了能量转换、滞留与释放时序的竞争效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助数学已显示开放式机器搜索可超越人类数学家，但迁移到物理需重构研究流程：物理是经验性的、没有终极模型，且理论必须与真实世界交互。

Method: Simjecture开源框架：语言模型智能体追求人类定义的物理猜想；以反例驱动的证伪与前瞻性假设修复组织探究；以计算物理作为可执行检验平台，并将数值工具的资格审查与科学主张评审分离，使求解器与诊断可在留痕调查中被调整。

Result: 82.6小时调查Z-pinch长期问题（辐射能量超过内爆壳动能）：发现能量转换、滞留与释放时序的竞争效应。更强的相干螺旋形变增强电阻性能量转换而降低辐射、提高滞留能量；更宽的尾随等离子体剖面延迟后期辐射峰值并弥补早期测辐射热计亏损，且脉冲期间光谱响应发生变化。

Conclusion: 结果对高能量密度等离子体物理中的能量转换提供新见解，并展示了一种物理研究新范式。

Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue human-defined physical conjectures. The framework tackles two central challenges in this transfer: first, because physics is empirical and no model is final, it structures inquiry around counterexample-driven falsification and prospective hypothesis repair; second, because physical theories must interact with the real world, it uses computational physics as an executable testbed while separating the qualification of numerical instruments from scientific claim review so solvers and diagnostics can be adapted within a recorded investigation. We apply the framework in an 82.6 h investigation to tackle the long-standing problem of radiated energy exceeding the imploding-shell kinetic energy in a Z-pinch. The investigation reveals competing effects of energy conversion, retention, and release timing. Stronger coherent helical deformation increases resistive conversion while reducing radiation and increasing retained energy. A broader trailing-plasma profile delays the later radiation maximum and recovers much of its early bolometric deficit, with a spectral response that changes during the pulse. These results provide new insight into energy conversion in high-energy-density plasma physics and demonstrate a new paradigm for physics research.

</details>


### [356] [EMBERS: Empirically Motivated Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems via Defect-Guided Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03723)
*Shuochuan Li,Zan Wang,Dong Wang,Yuhang Jiang,Huajin Cui,Chen Zhang,Gang Wang,Junjie Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文对Deep Research系统进行经验性缺陷分析，并据此提出缺陷引导的模糊测试框架EMBERS，用于鲁棒性测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DR系统多阶段执行中，用户问题或中间搜索输入的细微变化会跨阶段传播，导致错误答案；现有评测只关注任务能力或外部证据扰动下的鲁棒性，未充分揭示DR执行流程的内在弱点。

Method: 分析3个代表性DR系统的1,932条执行轨迹，归纳出覆盖子问题生成、在线搜索与最终推理三个阶段的九类反复出现的缺陷；基于此提出EMBERS，以正确回答的种子问题出发，采用缺陷引导变异、网络搜索辅助保真性保障、多样性感知种子维护来生成阶段针对性测试输入。

Result: 在16个框架—模型—数据集设置下，相同测试预算时EMBERS的失败发现吞吐量为最强基线的3.21倍；人工与LLM评估显示大多数生成输入保持了原始信息需求和必要上下文约束；微调实验显示一致的答案性能提升。

Conclusion: EMBERS可有效发现DR系统的内在执行缺陷，生成输入具有高保真性，既适用于鲁棒性测试也能助力模型改进。

Abstract: Deep Research (DR) systems extend large language models into autonomous agents that decompose complex information needs, iteratively search the web, and synthesize evidence to answer challenging questions. However, their multi-stage execution may introduce robustness risks, as variations in user questions or intermediate search inputs may propagate across research stages and lead to incorrect answers. Existing evaluations focus on task-solving capabilities or robustness against external evidence disturbances, leaving intrinsic weaknesses in DR execution insufficiently explored.
