Abstract: The Bayes-Nash equilibria of an auction are the solutions of a variational inequality, and for standard auctions its operator fails every monotonicity notion, so the theory of monotone operators is unavailable to learning in auctions. We show what replaces monotonicity for the first-price auction: a certificate that is strong but local. For uniform values the single-population operator has an exact closed form and an exact Minty identity at the equilibrium; for two bidders its Gateaux derivative there is $L^2$-coercive with best constant exactly one in every piecewise-linear bid space with $m$ pieces, while the Minty inequality holds only on a ball whose radius decays like $m^{-5/2}$. The decay is exact: $m^{5/2}$ times the radius converges to $1/(8 \cdot 3^{1/4})$, and the worst perturbations converge to an alternating geometric profile with ratio $-(2-\sqrt{3})$. Refinement shrinks the ball, not the constant; independent learners see the same constant. For a general prior and bidder count there are two certificates, at the true equilibrium and at the equilibrium of the finite-dimensional bid space a learning algorithm runs in. The first is an explicit weight $w_F$, positive for every log-concave prior, equal to the second exactly for the value distributions $F(v)=v^a$. Otherwise the learners' certificate differs by knot masses, because the discretized equilibrium's slopes oscillate with a law proved for two and three bidders, and for four under a computer-verified bottom layer. The limit of the learners' certificate is proved in closed form, a function of the prior alone, and characterizes positivity: positive uniformly in $m$ in the limit exactly when that minimum is positive, with a known rate; for one prior at every $m$ by interval arithmetic. For more bidders the limit is conjectured. The exact identities and leading-order inequalities are machine-checked in Lean.

</details>


### [490] [Designing AI-Mediated Communication in Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04686)
*Wichinpong Park Sinchaisri,Zhiwei Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究企业如何设计AI助手在员工与公司利益冲突下的信息沟通机制，权衡项目信息披露的"适应性收益"与"扭曲偏好报告"的成本，并给出最优披露时机与粒度设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI助手日益参与需要员工交换信息、协调决策的工作，但员工之间、员工与公司之间的利益可能冲突。企业需要决定AI助手应披露多少项目信息、在何时披露，而透明度在提升适应性的同时可能破坏员工如实报告偏好的激励。

Method: 构建理论模型：两名员工各自私下知晓局部条件与偏好响应，助手知晓总体项目条件；企业在员工报告与行动之前选择信息披露政策。分析不同协调强度（弱/强）与利益对齐程度下的最优披露粒度与时机，并考察分别投递、不可联合修订下的内生转发，以及员工接受约束。辅以数值比较。

Result: 利益对齐且协调弱时，粗化项目信息可在牺牲预测精度的代价下保留有用的偏好报告；协调强时企业偏好完全披露与事实性报告，因为偏好信息会引发对私人目标的高成本迁就。弱协调下企业最优政策可能使员工境况劣于直接交换，若要求员工接受则需进一步粗化。报告后再释放项目背景可维持早期披露会破坏的事实性沟通。不可联合修订的分别投递下，内生转发弱改进（部分环境严格改进）企业偏好绩效。数值上，完全初始披露在对齐环境中已捕获大部分收益；当员工可能偏好相反方向时，进一步设计的价值更大。

Conclusion: 研究区分了员工报告的"可信度"与其"组织价值"，并表明披露时机同时影响二者。企业应视协调强度与利益对齐程度在披露粒度与时机上做差异化设计，而非一味追求透明。

Abstract: AI assistants increasingly participate in work that requires employees to exchange information and coordinate decisions. We study how a firm should design this communication when workers' interests conflict with each other's and the firm's. Two workers privately know local conditions and their preferred responses, while the assistant knows aggregate project conditions. The firm discloses project information before workers report and choose their own actions. Transparency improves adaptation but can undermine truthful preference reporting. When workers agree with the firm on the productive direction, coarsening project information under weak coordination can preserve useful preference reporting at a cost in forecast precision. Under strong coordination, the firm instead prefers full project disclosure and factual reports, because preference information induces costly accommodation of private objectives. Under weak coordination, a firm-optimal policy can leave workers worse off than direct exchange; requiring their acceptance can call for further coarsening. Releasing project context after reports can sustain factual communication that early release would prevent. With separate delivery decisions that cannot be revised jointly, endogenous forwarding weakly improves firm-preferred performance over unchanged forwarding and strictly improves it in some environments. Numerical comparisons show that full initial disclosure captures most gains in the aligned environments considered, while further design has greater value when workers can favor opposing directions. The results distinguish the credibility of employees' reports from their organizational value and show how disclosure timing affects both.

</details>


### [491] [Logarithmic Comparison-Query Complexity for EF1 Allocations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04753)
*Zehan Lin,Shengxin Liu,Biaoshuai Tao,Shengwei Zhou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文解决了任意固定人数 n 下，在仅用比较查询的模型中计算 EF1 分配所需的查询复杂度问题，证明 O(log m) 查询即可达到，匹配已知下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 之前工作仅对至多三个代理建立了 O(log m) 查询上界，对于 n≥4 是否仍能实现关于物品数 m 的对数级查询复杂度仍是开放问题。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在异构加性偏好、不可分物品模型下，仅允许查询"某代理更偏好两个捆绑中的哪个"，不观察数值估价或成本。作者针对每个固定 n≥2 设计算法，分别处理非负成本的杂务和为物品。

Result: 对每个固定 n≥2，所设计算法以 O(log m) 次比较查询计算出 EF1 分配，与已知 Ω(log m) 下界匹配；结果同时适用于杂务（非负成本）和物品（非负估价）。

Conclusion: 关于 m 的对数级查询复杂度对任意固定代理数 n 均可实现，正面回答了此前的开放问题，并给出了紧确的查询复杂度刻画。

Abstract: We study the comparison-query complexity of computing allocations that are envy-free up to one item (EF1) for $n$ agents with heterogeneous additive preferences over $m$ indivisible items. In this model, the algorithm may only query which of two bundles an agent prefers, without ever observing numerical valuations or costs. Prior work established $O(\log m)$ query bounds for at most three agents, leaving open whether query complexity logarithmic in $m$ is achievable for every fixed $n \ge 4$. We resolve this open question in the affirmative: for every fixed $n\ge2$, we design algorithms that compute EF1 allocations using $O(\log m)$ comparison queries, matching the known $Ω(\log m)$ lower bound. Our results hold for both chores with nonnegative costs and goods with nonnegative valuations.

</details>


### [492] [Robust Aggregation of Quantile Statistics: from Median to Interval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04860)
*Mingyu Song,Yizhou Wang,Yuqing Kong*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究有界结果下分位数报告的稳健聚合问题：在平方损失下，最小化相对于全知贝叶斯聚合器的最坏情况遗憾。作者提出"弱替代"条件（信息价值的递减收益），并刻画其下最优聚合规则——对预测区间与中位数均为"正则化简单平均"，即把平均报告向范围中点收缩。该规则在一定覆盖水平下严格优于常数预测，且最优遗憾随覆盖水平非单调变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高度偏斜样本中，实验证据表明均值估计会偏向中位数，而中位数估计较准确。因此，与其聚合报告出来的均值，不如显式聚合专家所报的分位数（如中位数、预测区间）。但如何在有界结果、平方损失下稳健地聚合这些分位数报告，并在最坏情况意义下保证表现，尚缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 在有界结果、平方损失下，以"相对于知晓信息结构并观测所有私人信号的全知贝叶斯聚合器"的最坏情况遗憾为准则。先证明：对信息结构不加限制时，任何规则都无法优于"范围中点常数预测"。据此引入"弱替代"条件（信息价值的递减收益），并在该条件下推导两类报告（中央预测区间、中位数）的最优聚合规则。

Result: 对名义覆盖率为α的中央预测区间，最优规则（正则化简单平均，RSA-PI）将报告区间中点的平均向范围中点收缩，权重由α与专家数n决定；当α<1/√n时严格优于常数基线，α≥1/√n时常数规则最优。最优最坏遗憾在唯一的内点覆盖水平处取得最小值，显示覆盖率与聚合表现之间的非单调关系。对中位数报告，RSA-M 同样将平均中位数向范围中点收缩，给报告均值赋权1/n，且对任意有限n≥2均严格优于常数基线。

Conclusion: 在无信息结构限制的设定下，常数中点预测构成不可超越的遗憾下界；引入弱替代条件后，可得简洁的闭式最优规则——正则化简单平均，其本质是向范围中点做依赖覆盖率和专家数的收缩。该框架为聚合分位数（而非均值）报告提供了稳健的理论依据，并揭示覆盖率选择与聚合性能之间存在非单调权衡。

Abstract: Quantile-based summaries, such as prediction intervals and medians, are commonly used in economic forecasting, climate science, and public health. For highly skewed samples, experimental evidence suggests that estimates of the mean can be biased toward the median, whereas estimates of the median are relatively accurate. This motivates aggregating explicitly elicited quantiles rather than reported means.
  We study robust aggregation of quantile reports for bounded outcomes under squared loss, minimizing worst-case regret relative to an omniscient Bayesian aggregator who knows the information structure and observes all private signals. Without restrictions on the information structure, no rule improves on the constant forecast at the range midpoint in worst-case regret. We therefore consider weak substitutes, a diminishing-returns condition on the value of information, and characterize optimal aggregation rules under this condition.
  For central prediction intervals with common nominal coverage $α$, the optimal rule, which we call regularized simple average for prediction intervals, shrinks the average reported interval midpoint toward the range midpoint, with a weight determined by $α$ and the number $n$ of experts. This optimal rule strictly improves on the constant baseline in worst-case regret when $α<1/\sqrt{n}$; at or above this threshold, the constant rule is optimal. The optimal worst-case regret is minimized at a unique interior coverage level, revealing a nonmonotonic relationship between coverage and aggregation performance. For median reports, regularized simple average for medians similarly shrinks the average reported median toward the range midpoint, assigning weight $1/n$ to the reported average and strictly improving on the constant baseline in worst-case regret for every finite $n\ge2$.

</details>


### [493] [Best-of-Many-Worlds MMS Allocation for Chores with Sublinear Disposals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04884)
*Zehan Lin,Xiaowei Wu,Shengwei Zhou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究可加成本下不可分家务（chores）的随机分配（抽签），提出 MMS1 概念，并证明每个实例都存在事前比例性的抽签，其支撑中的每个分配都是 MMS1 且除 o(n) 个代理外均满足 MMS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不可分家务的公平分配中，MMS（极大极小份额）保证往往无法精确实现，需要借助处置（disposal）、补贴或随机化来放宽；已有界（如带处置/补贴的 MMS、best-of-both-worlds、近似 AMMS、序数 MMS 近似）仍有较大改进空间。

Method: 提出 MMS1：要求移除至多一个家务后每个代理的份额满足 MMS 下界；构造事前比例性的随机分配（lottery），使支撑内每个分配均为 MMS1，且除 o(n) 个代理外全部满足 MMS；进一步将该框架扩展到 ex-post 4/3-MMS、o(n)-AMMS 及 d=(1-o(1))n 的 1-out-of-d MMS。

Result: 证明每个实例都存在满足上述性质的事前比例抽签；由此任何实现出的分配只需处置至多 o(n) 个家务即可变为 MMS；同时实现事前比例性与 ex-post 4/3-MMS、o(n)-AMMS、1-out-of-d MMS（d=(1-o(1))n）。

Conclusion: 该框架在带处置/补贴的 MMS 分配、best-of-both-worlds 公平性、近似 AMMS 及序数 MMS 近似等方面显著优于现有最优界，为不可分家务的随机公平分配提供了更强保证。

Abstract: We study randomized allocations (lotteries) of indivisible chores under additive costs and introduce the notion of MMS1, which requires each agent's bundle to satisfy the maximin share (MMS) bound after the removal of at most one chore. Our main result establishes that every instance admits an ex-ante proportional lottery in whose support every allocation is MMS1 and all but $o(n)$ agents satisfy MMS. Consequently, every realized allocation can be made MMS by disposing of at most $o(n)$ chores. The proposed framework further achieves ex-ante proportionality alongside ex-post $4/3$-MMS, $o(n)$-AMMS, or $1$-out-of-$d$ MMS for $d=(1-o(1))n$. These guarantees substantially improve upon state-of-the-art bounds for MMS allocation for chores with disposal or subsidy, best-of-both-worlds fairness, approximate AMMS, and ordinal MMS approximations.

</details>


### [494] [The Complexity of Continuous Contract Design over Polymatroids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04934)
*Max Klimm,Paul Lippke,Philipp Warode*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究多项式拟阵容量约束下的最优合同设计：线性成本可多项式时间求解，二次成本下最优份额优化为NP难，但最优份额不超过1/2，故可实现FPTAS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理人努力受 polymatroid 容量约束的连续努力分配场景（如多任务、资源受限的隐式激励）此前缺乏对最优合同计算复杂度的系统刻画，尤其是二元结果、有限责任约束下的情形。

Method: 建模为委托人选择单一奖励份额、代理人在 polymatroid 约束下分配连续努力（线性期望收益+凸成本）。对线性成本给出多项式时间算法；对二次成本用多项次子模最小化刻画唯一最优响应，并分析最优份额优化与最优响应路径的复杂度；进一步推广到 p 次齐次凸成本。

Result: 线性成本：多项式时间可解最优合同。二次成本：最优响应可用多项式次子模最小化计算，但优化委托人份额即使对显式割基秩函数也 NP 难；最优响应路径可含 2^{n-O(log n)} 个断点（即使系数与秩值仅需 O(n log n) 位表示），该构造也回答了 Allman–Lo–McCormick 关于源汇单调双参数最小割多项式位长的问题。积极结论：二次成本最优份额≤1/2，故 O(1/ε) 次最优响应计算可达 (1-ε) 近似；有理二次成本、显式有理多面体（含零点）下得到 FPTAS。更一般地，p>1 次齐次凸成本、含零紧凸行动集下最优份额≤1/p；一般凸成本（精确值+有界次梯度 oracle）下可用近似最优响应与正福利下界得 oracle 近似方案。

Conclusion: 合同优化在 polymatroid 约束下呈现"计算难但结构良"的特征：精确优化 NP 难且最优响应路径可指数复杂，但最优份额有 1/p 上界，使近似算法高效可行，并给出 FPTAS 与 oracle 近似方案。

Abstract: We study optimal contracts when an agent allocates continuous effort subject to polymatroid capacity constraints. Effort produces a linear expected reward and incurs a cost. With binary outcomes and limited liability, the principal chooses a single reward share. For linear costs, an optimal contract can be computed in polynomial time. For quadratic costs, the agent has a unique best response computable by polynomially many submodular minimizations, yet optimizing the principal's share is NP-hard even for explicitly represented cut-based rank functions. With $n$ activities, the best-response path can have $2^{n-O(\log n)}$ breakpoints even when each reward coefficient and each rank value is an integer representable in $O(n\log n)$ bits. The construction also answers a question of Allman, Lo, and McCormick on polynomial bit length for source-sink monotone two-parameter minimum cuts. Despite this complexity, an optimal contract for quadratic costs always exists with a share of at most $1/2$. Consequently, $O(1/\varepsilon)$ best-response computations suffice for a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation. For rational quadratic costs on explicitly described rational polytopes containing zero, this gives a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme. More generally, a share of at most $1/p$ suffices for continuous convex costs homogeneous of degree $p>1$, on any compact convex action set containing zero. For general convex costs with an exact value and bounded-subgradient oracle, we obtain an oracle approximation scheme using approximate best responses and a supplied lower bound on positive welfare.

</details>


### [495] [Toward Constant-Factor Maximin Share Guarantees for Subadditive Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05073)
*Bo Li,Ankang Sun*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分物品分配中的最大最小份额(MMS)近似。对一般次可加估值,将保证从Ω(1/log log n)指数级提升到Ω(1/log* n);并引入q- partitioning估值层级,证明当q/n有正下界时常数保证(如q≥n时1/6,q≥2n时1/4);对XOS将通用保证从4/17提升到5/16。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MMS的常数近似已知适用于可加、次模或XOS估值,但一般次可加估值是否存在常数保证仍是公开问题,本文从两个方向推进该问题。

Method: 对次可加估值证明"竞价放大"定理,使每名代理获得低于其MMS一半的概率指数级小,同时在每种结果下满足预算约束;对q-partitioning估值给出标量判据,将束内不相交删除所损失价值的界转化为潜在损失的界;对XOS证明保留定理,为整数分配选品并配以辅助可加估值,并计入舍入损失。

Result: 次可加估值下的近似保证从Ω(1/log log n)提升至Ω(1/log* n);q-partitioning估值在q/n有正下界时获得常数保证(q≥n为1/6,q≥2n为1/4);XOS保证从约0.2353提升至5/16=0.3125。

Conclusion: 本文显著改进了次可加估值的MMS近似,并通过q-partitioning层级填补了次可加与XOS之间中间类的MMS研究空白,同时提升了XOS的通用常数保证。

Abstract: For $n$ agents and $m$ indivisible goods, an agent's maximin share (MMS) is the largest minimum bundle value she can obtain by partitioning the goods into $n$ bundles. Constant MMS approximations are known for additive, submodular, or XOS valuations, but whether such a guarantee exists for general subadditive valuations remains open. We advance this question in two directions. For general subadditive valuations, we exponentially improve the guarantee from $Ω(1/\log\log n)$ to $Ω(1/\log^* n)$, where $\log^* n$ is the iterated logarithm. We then seek constant MMS guarantees under additional structure on subadditive valuations by studying $q$-partitioning valuations: every partition of a bundle into at most $q$ groups admits nonnegative group prices that sum to the bundle's value and whose sum on any collection of groups is at most the value of their union. This hierarchy ranges from subadditivity at $q=2$ to XOS for $q\ge m$. We give the first study of MMS in the intermediate classes and prove constant guarantees whenever $q/n$ has a fixed positive lower bound, including $1/6$ for $q\ge n$ and $1/4$ for $q\ge2n$. For XOS valuations, we further improve the universal guarantee from $4/17\approx 0.2353$ to $5/16=0.3125$.
  For subadditive valuations, we prove a bidding amplification theorem that gives an exponential bound on each agent's probability of receiving less than half her MMS, while satisfying her budget in every outcome. For $q$-partitioning valuations, we give a scalar criterion that converts bounds on the value lost from disjoint deletions within a bundle into bounds on potential losses, even when an agent contributes zero below the target bundle value. For XOS valuations, we prove a reservation theorem that selects goods for integral assignment together with auxiliary additive valuations and accounts for the loss in rounding.

</details>


### [496] [Search and Verification for Strategyproof Facility Location on Metric Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05092)
*Krzysztof Rogowski,Marcin Dziubiński*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究连续度量图上随机设施选址问题的策略证明（SP）机制自动设计，通过线性规划对偶证书计算近似比下界、用分段线性归因（PL attributions）表示机制计算上界，并在多个度量图上给出可验证的上、下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机设施选址中SP机制的最优近似比通常依赖具体图结构，缺乏针对给定图与代理数自动计算紧界的方法；作者希望实现可认证（certified）的上下界自动计算与机制搜索。

Method: 下界：提出保成本归约到有限域，借助LP对偶证书给出无限制SP机制的下界。上界：引入分段线性归因（PL attributions），在报告空间三角剖分上用仿射权重混合分段线性确定性机制；证明SP与近似保证可化为有限个紧多面体上的二次非负性检验，精确算术下可给出认证或反例。另提出强策略证明性，证明对固定分量机制与区域，其要求可写成归因系数的有限线性约束，并据此设计启发式搜索上界的流程。

Result: 在若干度量图上计算出经认证的上、下界，并对所提搜索流程进行了数值评估；同时证明图上确定性SP满射机制均是强策略证明的且具有PL归因表示，因此聚焦于具PL归因的强SP机制不会遗漏任何确定性SP满射机制。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了可认证的SP机制近似比上下界计算框架与自动化搜索方法，并通过PL归因与强策略证明性在不失一般性（针对确定性满射机制）的前提下使验证有限化、可计算。

Abstract: We study automated design of strategyproof (SP) mechanisms for randomized facility location on continuous metric graphs, with the objective of minimizing total distance. We develop methods for computing upper and lower bounds on the optimal approximation ratio achievable by SP mechanisms for a given graph and number of agents.
  For the lower bound, we propose a cost-preserving reduction to a finite domain that yields lower bounds for unrestricted SP mechanisms through linear programming dual certificates.
  For the upper bound, we introduce finite representations of mechanisms, called piecewise-linear attributions (PL attributions), that mix piecewise-linear deterministic mechanisms using affine weights on a triangulation of the report space. We show that for mechanisms represented by PL attributions, checking SP and an approximation guarantee reduces to finitely many quadratic nonnegativity tests over compact polytopes. With exact arithmetic and comparisons, each verification certifies the proposed property or returns locations where it fails. In addition, we introduce a strengthening of the incentive notion called strong strategyproofness. We show that for fixed component mechanisms and regions of a PL attribution, the strong strategyproofness requirement can be expressed by a finite number of linear constraints on the attribution coefficients. Using these theoretical results, we propose a heuristic procedure for computing an upper bound on the approximation ratio.
  We compute certified upper and lower bounds on several metric graphs and numerically evaluate the proposed search procedure.
  Lastly, we show that deterministic SP onto mechanisms on graphs are strongly strategyproof and admit PL attributions. Thus restricting attention to strongly strategyproof mechanisms admitting PL attributions loses no deterministic SP onto mechanisms.

</details>


### [497] [Sharp Bounds for Truthful-in-Expectation Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05134)
*Yunpeng Li*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究无关并行机上不可分工作的随机真值机制调度问题，证明了当机器数 n≥7 时最优近似比为 (n+1)/2（相对整数分配最优 makespan），并精确刻画了两台机器（约 1.505995705434）、三台机器（2）的最优比，给出四至六台机器的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 调度中机器为自私代理且处理时间私有，需要满足期望真值性的机制来最小化 makespan 的期望；此前该问题的随机机制最优近似比未被完整刻画。

Method: 构造基于关联取整（correlated rounding）的真值随机机制，并用下界证明（允许任意计算与任意关联、有限期望支付）给出近似比下界；两、三台机器使用精确有理数计算机辅助证书刻画最优常数。

Result: n≥7 时最优近似比为 (n+1)/2 且上下界匹配，机制在有理输入上以期望多项式比特时间运行，适用于任意有限非负处理时间；两机器最优比约 1.505995705434，三机器为 2，四、五、六机器上界分别为 3、105/32、29/8。

Conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了多机器（n≥7）情形下随机真值调度关于 makespan 期望的最优近似比，并精确解决了小规模机器数的常数，为自私机器调度提供了紧界与高效机制。

Abstract: We study randomized mechanisms for scheduling indivisible jobs on $n$ unrelated machines. Each machine is controlled by a selfish agent who privately knows its processing time for each job. A mechanism assigns every job to a machine and makes payments. We require truthfulness in expectation: no agent can increase its expected payment minus its expected processing cost by misreporting, regardless of the other agents' reports. The makespan is the maximum total processing time assigned to a machine; the objective is to minimize its expectation. We prove that the optimal approximation ratio is $(n+1)/2$ for every $n\ge7$, relative to the minimum makespan of an integral assignment. The lower bound holds for every $n$ and allows unrestricted computation and arbitrary correlations among assignments, assuming finite expected payments and a guarantee uniform over all finite job counts. The matching mechanism uses correlated rounding and runs in expected polynomial bit time on rational inputs. These guarantees hold for all finite nonnegative processing times. For two machines, we characterize the optimal approximation ratio exactly as an analytic constant, approximately $1.505995705434$, and give a mechanism attaining it. For three machines the optimal ratio is $2$. For four, five, and six machines we obtain upper bounds of $3$, $105/32$, and $29/8$, respectively, compared with the general lower bound $(n+1)/2$. The proofs for $n\ge7$ do not rely on computer-assisted certificates; the two- and three-machine results use exact rational computer-assisted certificates.

</details>


### [498] [Tight Analysis of Randomized Truthful Scheduling: An $(m+1)/2$ Lower Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05142)
*Wenqian Wang,Chenyang Xu,Yuhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明无关机器makespan最小化的truthful-in-expectation机制存在$(m+1)/2$近似下界，从而将TIE最优近似比确定在$m/2+\Theta(1)$，并把universally truthful机制的下界主常数从$0.0858$提升到$1/2$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nisan-Ronen猜想（确定性）已于2023年解决，但随机机制的最优近似比仍开放。此前TIE机制的上界为$(m+5)/2$、下界仅为$2-1/m$，差距巨大；universally truthful机制的下界主常数也偏小。

Method: 借鉴确定性证明与Anastasiadis等人工作的技术，构造新的困难实例/分析框架，证明对TIE机制的$(m+1)/2$下界，并将其推广以改进universally truthful机制的下界常数。

Result: 得到TIE机制的$(m+1)/2$下界，将最优比确定在$m/2+\Theta(1)$；同时把universally truthful机制下界的主常数从$3/2-\sqrt{2}\approx0.0858$提升到$1/2$，结合已有$m/2+o(m)$上界，确定其最优近似比至低阶项。

Conclusion: 随机机制下Nisan-Ronen问题的最优近似比基本被刻画：TIE为$m/2+\Theta(1)$，universally truthful为$m/2+o(m)$（至低阶项确定），显著缩小了此前差距。

Abstract: The Nisan-Ronen conjecture, a central problem in algorithmic game theory, asserts that no deterministic truthful mechanism for makespan minimization on $m$ unrelated machines can achieve an approximation ratio better than $m$. Christodoulou, Koutsoupias, and Kovács resolved it in 2023, but the optimal approximation ratio achievable by randomized truthful mechanisms remained open. Recently, Anastasiadis, Christodoulou, Koutsoupias, Kovács, and Schecker extended techniques from the deterministic proof to establish a $(3/2-\sqrt{2})(m-1)$ lower bound for universally truthful mechanisms with discrete support and gave a universally truthful mechanism with approximation ratio $m/2+o(m)$. For the broader class of truthful-in-expectation (TIE) mechanisms, however, the gap remained large: the best known upper bound was $(m+5)/2$, while the lower bound was only $2-1/m$. We prove a lower bound of $(m+1)/2$, determining the optimal TIE approximation ratio up to an additive constant as $m/2+Θ(1)$. Our result also improves the leading constant in the lower bound for universally truthful mechanisms from $3/2-\sqrt{2} \approx 0.0858$ to $1/2$. Together with their $m/2+o(m)$ upper bound, our result determines the optimal approximation ratio for universally truthful mechanisms up to lower-order terms.

</details>


### [499] [Efficient Equilibrium Computation in Colonel Blotto Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05221)
*Martin Bichler,Abheek Ghosh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文为经典连续版Colonel Blotto博弈（任意预算、战场价值可不同但双方相同）给出了完全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS），可在关于输入长度和1/ε的多项式时间内计算ε-Nash均衡，且固定ε时对输入长度近似线性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Colonel Blotto是资源分配的基本博弈，但经典连续版本（任意预算、战场价值可变但双方共享）的高效均衡计算长期未解决，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 设计了一个完全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS），用于计算ε-Nash均衡；对预算与战场价值足够均衡的情形，还给出线性时间的精确均衡算法。

Result: 算法在输入长度与1/ε的多项式时间内求出ε-Nash均衡；固定ε时对输入长度近线性；在预算和价值较均衡时线性时间得到精确均衡。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了连续Colonel Blotto均衡高效计算的开放问题，提供了近似与精确两类高效算法。

Abstract: Colonel Blotto is a fundamental resource-allocation game in which two players divide their budgets across battlefields, and the higher allocation on each battlefield wins its value. The problem of computing an equilibrium efficiently has remained unresolved for its classical continuous version with arbitrary budgets and with values that may vary across battlefields but are the same for both players. We give a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme that computes an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium in time polynomial in the input length and $1/\varepsilon$, and nearly linear in the input length for fixed $\varepsilon$. For sufficiently balanced budgets and battlefield values, we also compute exact equilibria in linear time.

</details>


### [500] [Computational Aspects of Distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05257)
*Soroush Ebadian,Aris Filos-Ratsikas,Mohamad Latifian,Nisarg Shah*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文对社会选择理论中的扭曲（distortion）框架做出两项基础贡献：一是给出基于线性规划的最优随机决策算法，更简单快捷；二是基于非凸二次规划精确计算任意（及最优）随机位置评分规则的扭曲度，小规模下精确界显著优于以往的渐近上界并改变规则推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最优随机决策算法复杂、较慢；实践中人们更愿意使用经典评分规则，但以往只知渐近上界，缺乏精确扭曲度，可能误导规则选择。

Method: 1) 线性规划算法，用于在给定实例上计算最优随机决策；2) 非凸二次规划算法，用于精确计算任意随机位置评分规则的扭曲度及最优规则；3) 提出对最坏扭曲实例的新刻画。

Result: LP 算法比现有方法更简单更快；对小规模备选方案，精确扭曲界显著优于既有渐近上界，并给出不同的规则推荐。

Conclusion: 为 distortion 框架提供更高效的算法工具与更精确的分析，其中最坏实例刻画或具独立价值。

Abstract: The distortion framework in social choice theory allows quantifying the efficiency of (randomized) selection of an alternative based on the preferences of a set of agents. We make two fundamental contributions to this framework. First, we develop a linear-programming-based algorithm for computing the optimal randomized decision on a given instance, which is simpler and faster than the state-of-the-art solutions. For practitioners who may prefer to deploy a classical decision-making rule over the aforementioned optimal rule, we develop an algorithm based on non-convex quadratic programming for computing the exact distortion of any (and the best) randomized positional scoring rule. For a small number of alternatives, we find that the exact distortion bounds are significantly better than the asymptotic upper bounds established in prior literature and lead to different recommendations on which rules to use. These results rely on a novel characterization of the instances yielding the worst distortion, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [501] [Almost-MMS allocations with small agent redundancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05360)
*Uriel Feige,Vadim Grinberg*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究带"代理冗余"的不可分物品分配问题，证明当有 εn 个额外代理时，可保证的 n-MHS 近似比 ρ_{ε,n} 随 n 增长趋于 1，从而回答了无冗余情形下 ρ_n 是否趋于 1 的开放问题（在 m ≤ (2-c)n 时为正）；并改进了 Ezra 与 Garbuz 的结论，证明总能给 n - O(log² n) 个代理满足完整 MMS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在标准无冗余设定下，已知 7/9 ≤ ρ_n < 1-Ω(1/log² n)，但 ρ_n 是否随 n 趋于 1 仍是开放问题。作者希望借助"代理冗余"(比代理数多出 εn 个)这一放松条件来正面回答该问题，并顺带推进相关的 MMS 满足人数下界结果。

Method: 定义 ρ_{ε,n}：在任意 m 个不可分物品、 (1+ε)n 个代理的实例中，总能找到 n 个代理的子集，使限制到该子集上的实例存在一个分配，让每个代理获得至少 ρ_n 比例的 n-MMS。通过分析带冗余的分配实例结构，作者构造性地证明了该比值随 n 趋于 1；并将技术适配到相关设定，用于分析给出完整 MMS 的代理人数。

Result: 对每个 ε>0，ρ_{ε,n} 随 n→∞ 趋于 1。由此得推论：对任意 c>0，若物品数满足 m ≤ (2-c)n，则无冗余的 ρ_n 也趋于 1。此外，在相关设定下证明无冗余时总存在一个分配，使至少 n - O(log² n) 个代理获得其完整 MMS，改进了 Ezra 与 Garbuz 的近期结果。

Conclusion: 代理冗余使近似比渐近达到完美（趋于 1），正面回答了标准设定下的开放问题（受物品数约束时）；技术方法还带来对"获得完整 MMS 代理人数"下界的改进，表明冗余与物品-代理比例是影响 MMS 可实现性的关键因素。

Abstract: For a fixed $ε\ge 0$, let $ρ_{ε, n}$ be the maximum value of $ρ_n$ such that, in every allocation instance with $m$ indivisible goods and $(1 + ε)n$ agents, there is a subset of $n$ agents with the following property. The allocation instance restricted to only this subset of $n$ agents has an allocation that gives each agent at least $ρ_n$-fraction of her $n$-maximin share (MMS).
  When $ε> 0$ we refer to $εn$ as the {\em agent redundancy}. The case $ε= 0$ is the standard setting without agent redundancy, and we use $ρ_{0,n}$ and $ρ_n$ interchangeably.
  For allocation instances with additive valuations, % agents, it is known that $\frac{7}{9} \le ρ_n < 1-Ω(\frac{1}{\log^2 n})$ for every $n \ge 2$ (with stronger lower bounds for small $n$). It is an open question whether $ρ_n$ tends to~1 as $n$ grows. We show that with agent redundancy, the answer to this question is positive. That is, for every $ε> 0$, $ρ_{ε, n}$ tends to~1 as $n$ grows. A straightforward corollary of this result is that for every $c > 0$, if the number of items satisfies $m \le (2 - c)n$, then the answer is positive also for $ρ_n$ (with no agent redundancy). Adapting our techniques to a related setting, we also improve a recent result of Ezra and Garbuz, and show that without agent redundancy, there always exists an allocation that gives $n - O(\log^2 n)$ agents their full MMS.

</details>

### [502] [ReVi: Recursive Recap Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03674)
*Kyrie You Wu,Chaozhuo Li,Songyang Liu,Xueyang Feng,Ziluowen Luo,Chenxu Wang,Ji Qi,Jinfu Zhu,Litian Zhang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出新颖到回顾视频生成任务（novel-to-recap），并设计双环多智能体框架ReVi，以"先编辑、后生成"为原则生成自包含、忠实原著、时长可控的音视频故事复述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小说文本无法直接呈现视听世界；影视改编制作成本高、观看时间长；影视回顾虽短但依赖已有素材。两者均无法直接从小说给出简洁的视听复述，因此需要一项新任务：在固定观看时长预算内，直接从小说生成自包含、忠实原著的音视频复述，其中需压缩情节同时保留因果连贯、为保留事件分配足够时长、并使旁白与生成画面对齐。

Method: 提出ReVi，一个遵循"先编辑、后生成"的双环多智能体框架。内环在视频生成前完成故事内容规划、旁白时长分配与对应镜头设计；外环跨小说进行递归自我改进，同时修订编辑策略以及指导修订过程的元策略。

Result: 在两个评测集上，ReVi相比代表性基线在回顾质量与时长合规性上均有提升；人工评分与多轮迭代改进结果进一步支持其有效性。

Conclusion: ReVi表明"先编辑、后生成"的双环多智能体策略可有效实现从小说到时长受控的音视频回顾生成，为小说内容的多模态转化提供了新范式。

Abstract: Novels tell rich stories, but their textual form cannot directly present the sights and sounds of the worlds they describe. Film adaptations offer an audiovisual experience but require substantial production effort and viewing time; film recaps are shorter but depend on existing footage. Neither route directly provides a concise audiovisual account of a novel. We therefore study novel-to-recap video generation: producing a self-contained, source-grounded audiovisual retelling directly from a novel within a fixed viewing-time budget. This task requires compressing the story while preserving causal connections, allocating sufficient time to retained events, and aligning narration with newly generated visuals. We propose ReVi, a dual-loop multi-agent framework guided by edit first, generate second. Its Inner Loop plans story content, narration time, and corresponding shots before video generation. Across novels, its Outer Loop performs recursive self-improvement by revising both the editing policy and the meta policy that governs its revision. Experiments on two evaluation sets show that ReVi improves recap quality and duration compliance over representative baselines, with human ratings and multi-round improvement results providing further support.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [503] [A Compact Formula-Aware Spreadsheet Abstraction for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03705)
*Tie Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出一种紧凑的、公式感知的电子表格抽象，用位置、类型、R1C1公式模式和边界值表示大块同构区域，先向LLM提供该抽象摘要再提供详细内容，从而提升处理精度与效率并减少token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于辅助电子表格建模、公式生成和数据分析，但电子表格的结构与通常喂给LLM的顺序文本表示之间存在不匹配，限制了其在真实电子表格上的表现。

Method: 设计一种紧凑的公式感知电子表格抽象，用区域位置、类型、R1C1公式模式和选定边界值表示大型同构区域；用高效算法检测并结构化这些区域后序列化为文本；先将抽象提供给LLM，再按需提交详细内容。

Result: 在50个电子表格查询案例上评估：抽象本身足以回答部分查询；当需更多内容时，抽象减少了需提交的数据量与token消耗；该抽象层还提升了处理的可信性与准确性。

Conclusion: 将电子表格静态分析与AI结合可提升AI辅助表格任务的可靠性、准确性和效率，作者进一步讨论了相关技术方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assist spreadsheet users with tasks such as spreadsheet model construction, formula generation, and data analysis, yet their interaction with real-world spreadsheets remains limited by the mismatch between the structure of spreadsheets and the sequential textual representations typically provided to LLMs. We propose a compact formula-aware spreadsheet abstraction that represents large homogeneous ranges through their positions, types, R1C1 formula patterns, and selected boundary values. An efficient algorithm detects and structures these ranges before a textual serialization is supplied to an LLM. The abstraction is provided to the LLM before detailed spreadsheet content is submitted, improving the accuracy and efficiency of spreadsheet processing while reducing token consumption. We evaluate the method on 50 spreadsheet-query cases. The evaluation shows that the abstraction alone was sufficient to answer some queries. When additional spreadsheet content is required, the abstraction reduces the amount of data that must be submitted to the LLM, thereby reducing token consumption. The abstraction layer also improves the reliability and accuracy of spreadsheet processing. We conclude by discussing further techniques for combining spreadsheet static analysis with artificial intelligence to improve the reliability, accuracy, and efficiency of AI assisted spreadsheet tasks.

</details>


### [504] [Testing Processor Contracts in Speculative Decoding Engines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04042)
*Tianyu Ding,Yaocheng Tong,Muzhi Yang,Lei Yang,Fei Jiang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文形式化了推测采样中"处理器-前缀契约"，提出BADC分支感知差分一致性测试方法，发现logits处理器读取未验证草稿或未回滚状态是导致解码分布偏移的两类根因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测采样虽承诺不改变目标分布，但该保证依赖logits处理器在每个验证位置收到正确的前缀与状态。实际实现可能违反此前提，导致可观察的解码差异，因此需要系统性的检测方法。

Method: 提出处理器-前缀契约的形式化，并设计BADC测试框架：结合小随机模型上的枚举参考、处理器输入与状态检查，以及输出事件概率的同时置信界；在选定的Transformer与llama-cpp-python版本上做预注册、源码引导的实验，并用受控对比与置换检验比较诊断能力。

Result: 确认两类根因：处理器读取未验证草稿、状态推进却无回滚。某训练检查点上，普通解码与prompt-lookup解码的首token事件概率差在名义同时95%覆盖下得到60.26个百分点下界；定向选择相对随机选择无因果恢复优势，置换检验对各家族的检出率不低于BADC。

Conclusion: 研究将处理器接口失效与可观察的解码差异联系起来，但不主张BADC具有诊断优越性，也未确立该问题在实际工作负载中的普遍性。

Abstract: Speculative sampling can accelerate decoding without changing the target distribution. Its standard guarantee assumes that logits processors, which enforce constraints or modify token scores, receive the appropriate token prefix and state at each verification position. We formalize this processor-prefix contract and present BADC (branch-aware differential conformance testing). BADC combines enumerated references on tiny random models, checks of processor inputs and state, and simultaneous confidence bounds on output-event probabilities. Preregistered, source-informed experiments on selected Transformers and llama-cpp-python releases confirm two causes: processors read unverified drafts or advance state without rollback. For one pilot-selected prompt on a trained checkpoint, fresh samples give a 60.26-percentage-point lower bound on the difference in the probability of a predefined first-token event between ordinary and prompt-lookup decoding, with nominal simultaneous 95% coverage under within-arm i.i.d. sampling. Controlled comparisons establish no cause-recovery advantage of directed selection over random selection, while permutation testing detects each tested family at least as often as BADC. These findings connect processor-interface failures to observable decoding differences without establishing diagnostic superiority or workload prevalence.

</details>


### [505] [Are We Just Applying LLMs? What SE Research Studies, Underexplores, and Could Do Next in the LLM Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04206)
*Zeinadsadat Saghi,Sadra Sabouri,Souti Chattopadhyay*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对ICSE、FSE、ASE 2018–2026年4,790篇研究论文的普查及ICSE 2026 FoSE对244名研究者的调查，发现AI正在重塑而非简单取代软件工程研究：AI贡献了93.1%的论文增长，但更多是围绕AI能力重组既有议程，学界对AI的反思与回应明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 到2025年，AI已出现在ICSE、FSE、ASE半数以上的研究论文中，但"无处不在"本身无法说明AI究竟是扩展了发表版图、挤占了其他研究，还是改变了领域的知识议程，因此需要系统性的计量与实证考察。

Method: 对三大SE会议2018–2026年的4,790篇研究论文进行人工/结构化普查（统计AI论文占比、增长贡献、问题来源、研究姿态等），并结合ICSE 2026 FoSE调查中244名研究者的自由文本回答，对定量结果与社区认知做互补分析。

Result: AI占论文增长的93.1%，但某些会议与问题领域的扩张掩盖了其他方向的收缩；LLM浪潮主要改变工具而非问题边界，92.6%的LLM时代AI论文重访既有SE问题，新问题多源自LLM进入SE过程本身；95.7%的AI论文是应用、评估或支持AI，仅4.3%质疑该范式或提出替代方案；调查中AI驱动变革是第二大未来担忧（20.2%），但仅7.0%的改进建议提及AI。

Conclusion: SE领域正以快于自我反思的速度围绕AI重组其继承而来的议程。作者建议：跨技术浪潮做累积性研究、加强评估与保障、发展SE原生基础理论，并在AI改变的世界中重新研究软件工程本身。

Abstract: Is AI taking over software engineering research? By 2025, AI appeared in more than half of the research-track papers at ICSE, FSE, and ASE. Yet ubiquity alone cannot show whether AI expanded the publication portfolio, displaced other work, or redirected the intellectual agenda. We investigate this shift through a census of 4,790 research papers (three SE conferences; 2018--2026) and free-form responses from 244 SE researchers discussing the future of the SE research community (ICSE 2026 FoSE survey). We found that while AI is taking over, it is not simply replacing non-AI research; it is unevenly reorganizing SE research around its capabilities. AI accounted for 93.1% of publication growth, but expansion in some venues and problem areas concealed contraction in others. The LLM wave also changed the field's tools more than its problem boundaries: 92.6% of LLM-wave AI papers revisit established SE problems, while most new problems arise from the introduction of LLMs in the SE process themselves. Engagement with AI remains predominantly downstream: 95.7% of AI papers apply AI or evaluate and support its use, while only 4.3% interrogate the paradigm or develop alternatives. The FoSE survey reveals a similar imbalance between recognition and response. AI-driven change was the second-most frequent concern about the field's future 20.2%, yet only 7.0% of responses mentioned AI when researchers were asked to identify one change the community should make. Together, our findings reveal a field reorganizing an inherited agenda around AI faster than it is questioning that reorganization. We discuss how SE can respond by building cumulatively across technological waves, strengthening evaluation and assurance, developing SE-native foundations, and studying software engineering in an AI-transformed world.

</details>


### [506] [Do Coding Agents Follow AGENTS.md? The Effect of Policy Wording on Instruction Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04367)
*Rikuto Tsuchida,Youmei Fan,Kazumasa Shimari,Raula Gaikovina Kula,Kenichi Matsumoto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究编码智能体是否遵守Agent Context File（ACF）中的策略，通过在86个基准任务、4种harness-模型组合中注入四种表述风格的同一策略，发现条件式表述的遵守率最低，而规定式与解释式中较优者因组合而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体并不总是遵循ACF中的策略，但策略的表述方式是否影响其遵守程度尚不清楚。

Method: 在4种harness-模型组合的86个基准任务的ACF中，以四种风格插入同一条策略，并比较各风格下的策略遵守情况。

Result: 条件式（Conditional）表述的遵守频率低于规定式（Prescriptive）和解释式（Explanatory）；规定式与解释式之间哪种更优，取决于具体的harness-模型组合。

Conclusion: 策略措辞风格显著影响智能体的遵守行为，应避免使用条件式表述，且最优风格选择需结合具体harness与模型搭配进行调优。

Abstract: Coding agents do not always follow the policies in an Agent Context File (ACF). We inserted one policy, in four styles, into the ACFs of 86 benchmark tasks across four harness-model combinations. Conditional phrasing was followed less often than Prescriptive and Explanatory. The better of those two varied by combination.

</details>


### [507] [Disposable Implementations: What Is Software Engineering For?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04383)
*Christoph Treude*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"再生成(regeneration)"概念——智能体依据需求、测试、架构约束与运维记录重建新实现以替代维护现有代码库，并讨论实现"可丢弃性"的可行性与风险。通过从业者文献的探索性综述，发现已有案例表明智能体能替换现有实现，但尚不能证明重复再生成是安全且经济的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件实现通常被长期维护、仅在例外情况下被替换；而编码智能体的出现可能使"从需求与测试重建实现"成为维护的常规替代方案，从而有望消除大量技术债务。但再生成可能丢失代码中未被文档化的知识（如故障后加入的防护措施、隐含假设），引发对系统连续性、维护成本转移及"应保留什么"的疑问。

Method: 采用探索性文献综述方法，系统梳理从业者（工业界）文献中公开的编码智能体替换现有实现的案例。

Result: 公开案例显示智能体确实能够替换现有实现，但这些案例不足以证明重复再生成过程是安全的或经济的；也未澄清再生成是减少维护工作，还是将其转移到支撑性工件与流程上。

Conclusion: 再生成作为维护替代方案尚缺乏安全性与经济性证据。若实现变得可丢弃，软件工程的核心问题转为：应保留哪些知识/工件以确保跨替换的连续性，以及如何构建支持再生成的工件与流程。

Abstract: Existing implementations are usually maintained for most of their life and replaced only as an exception. Coding agents may change that. If agents can produce new implementations from requirements, tests, architectural constraints, and operational records that survive replacement, changing a system may no longer require modifying its existing codebase. We call this process regeneration. An implementation is disposable when regeneration becomes a routine alternative to maintenance. Regenerating and verifying a clean implementation from current requirements and tests may be cheaper than having agents navigate (and potentially compound) existing technical debt, and could eliminate much of that debt. Yet existing code may contain knowledge absent from the preserved artifacts, including safeguards introduced after failures and assumptions that were never documented. A regenerated implementation may pass the available tests and still lose behavior that matters in production. This leaves open how to establish continuity across replacements and whether regeneration reduces maintenance effort or shifts it to the artifacts and processes that support it. We examine these questions through an exploratory review of practitioner literature. Published examples show that agents can replace existing implementations, but do not establish that repeated regeneration is safe or economical. If implementations become disposable, what should software engineering preserve?

</details>


### [508] [How Agent Skills Evolve: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Skills on GitHub](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04456)
*Jinjun Huang,Jialun Cao,Junxiao Han,Zhonghao Jiang,Shing-Chi Cheung,Zhongxin Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对GitHub上84,200个agent skills和750,898次提交做大规模实证研究，构建技能组件、变更模式与演化动机的分类体系并自动化标注，揭示技能演化的五大规律与启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent日益依赖外部技能复用知识，但现有研究多从静态视角考察agent技能，缺乏对真实仓库中技能如何演化、为何演化的理解，限制了技能相关技术的设计。

Method: 从GitHub采集84,200个技能与750,898次提交；人工构建技能组件、变更模式、演化动机三类分类法；搭建自动标注流水线进行大规模变更标注；结合定量分析（技能构成、创建后演化频率）与定性评估（被修改组件、变更模式、动机）。

Result: 发现五方面问题：(i) 可靠性在技能构成与变更中关注不足；(ii) 演化集中在与项目耦合的技能上；(iii) 变更以增量丰富与精炼为主；(iv) 冗余是实际维护负担；(v) 安全动机变更的风险降低效果有限。

Conclusion: 提出五点启示：设计含验证与恢复机制的“执行契约”技能；引入即时自动化技能更新；开发模式引导的技能增强器；采用上下文高效的技能表示；建立技能回归测试以客观验证功能与安全性。数据集为后续自动化技能研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Large language model-based agents increasingly rely on external skills to reuse task-specific knowledge without retraining the model. As skills become common for extending agent capabilities, understanding creation and evolution is critical for reliable agent systems. However, existing studies mainly examine agent skills from a static perspective, leaving their evolution in real-world repositories largely unexplored. This limits our understanding of the patterns and motivations behind skill changes. To fill this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of agent skills, capturing 84,200 skills and 750,898 commits from GitHub. We manually construct taxonomies of skill components, change patterns, and evolution motivations, and build an automated annotation pipeline to label changes at scale. Based on the taxonomy, we conduct quantitative analyses of skill composition and post-creation evolution frequency, together with qualitative assessments of modified components, change patterns, and motivations. Our findings reveal five implications: (i) reliability receives less attention in skill composition and change, motivating execution-contract skill design that incorporates verification and recovery mechanisms; (ii) evolution changes concentrate in project-coupled skills, calling for automated just-in-time skill updating mechanisms; (iii) change patterns are dominated by incremental enrichment and refinement, motivating pattern-guided skill enhancers that diagnose and improve incomplete skill components; (iv) redundancy is a practical maintenance issue, highlighting the need for context-efficient skill representation; (v) security-motivated changes show limited risk reduction, suggesting skill regression testing methods that objectively verify skill functionality and security. Beyond these insights, our dataset provides a basis for future studies on automated skill techniques.

</details>


### [509] [FreeForm Harness: A Mobile-Native Agent Harness for Open and Composable Extensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04579)
*Bo Zhang,Pengbo Zhang,Jiaxin Jiao,Yue Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: FFH 是一个移动原生智能体 Harness，通过"冻结底座+统一插件契约+分层委托创作"让第三方与终端用户可发布、安装、组合移动智能体扩展，实现手机上"人人都是开发者"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动智能体把能力打包成单体流水线，缺乏开放的重组合点，用户和第三方无法发布、安装、组合新行为，个性化日常请求得不到满足。作者认为缺失的是一层"基底（substrate）"：手机虽是 Web 的主要入口，但去中心化创作下的开放发布与组合在智能体 Harness 处中断。

Method: 提出 FreeForm Harness（FFH）：(1) 冻结底座 + 带持久性感知的必需层，处理位置、主动触发、稀缺通道等移动约束；(2) 统一插件契约，使独立编写的扩展可在冻结套接字集上组合、可检查、可替换；(3) 分层委托创作路径——当无现成扩展匹配意图时，由 Web 编码智能体生成候选制品，在设备上按同一契约校验并准入。

Result: Android 原型覆盖设备、市场与云端。评测表明：架构边界在运行时被强制执行；真实日常请求能落在声明的组合空间内而不需扩展该空间；用户意图可通过检索或委托创作到达端侧执行，最终信任决策保留在设备本地。

Conclusion: FFH 推动智能体 Web 从"一切皆插件"迈向移动端"人人都是开发者"，为开放可组合的移动智能体生态提供了可行基底。

Abstract: Mobile phones support many everyday agent tasks, but current mobile agents bundle capabilities into monolithic pipelines with no open recombination point. Users and third parties cannot publish, install, and compose new behaviors, leaving personalized daily-life requests underserved. We argue that the missing piece is a substrate: although phones are the Web's dominant access point, open publication and composition under decentralized authorship stop at the agent harness. We present FreeForm Harness (FFH), a mobile-native agent harness for open, composable extensions. A frozen base and a permanence-aware required layer handle mobile constraints, including location, proactive triggering, and scarce channels. A uniform plugin contract makes independently authored extensions composable, checkable, and replaceable over a frozen socket set. FFH also supports end-user authorship through a tiered commissioned-authoring path. When no existing extension matches a user's intent, a Web coding agent generates a candidate artifact, which is validated and admitted on device under the same contract as other extensions. An Android prototype spans device, market, and cloud. Evaluation shows that architectural boundaries are enforced at runtime; realistic daily-life requests fit the declared composition space without widening it; and user intent reaches on-device execution through retrieval or commissioned authoring, with final trust decisions remaining device-local. FFH advances the agentic Web from "everything is a plugin" toward "everyone is a developer" on mobile.

</details>


### [510] [RESTberus: Trace-Aware Benchmarking of Automated REST API Testing Tools Across Microservice Dependencies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04769)
*John Toniutti,Massimiliano Baldo,Marino Miculan,Vincenzo Riccio*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RESTberus 是一个基于 Kubernetes 的黑盒 REST API 测试工具基准平台，通过结合分布式追踪区分目标服务自身失败与下游依赖失败；追踪感知去重准确率达 87.1%，高于先前基线 10–13 个百分点；实验显示所有被测工具都会暴露下游失败（平均约占 11.7% 的唯一失败），而单服务基准无法揭示这一点，同时其在单服务基准上与 RESTgym 结果统计等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 REST API 测试基准只关注孤立服务，忽视了微服务系统中因下游依赖交互而产生的失败；仅凭响应体和入口操作无法可靠区分失败来源，导致工具对比失真。

Method: 提出 RESTberus：基于 Kubernetes 的基准平台，在已部署的微服务系统上对黑盒 REST API 测试工具进行评估。核心思路是在 API 层证据之外引入分布式追踪，从而区分在目标服务中显现的失败与在下游依赖中显现的失败；并设计追踪感知的去重策略。

Result: 在两个微服务基准上评测 6 个工具：追踪感知去重达到 87.1% 准确率，优于先前工作的基线 10–13 个百分点；所有工具均暴露下游失败，平均占估计唯一失败的 11.7%；在单服务基准上，RESTberus 与 RESTgym 结果统计等价。

Conclusion: 集成级（多微服务）评估能够保持与现有工具的兼容性及与既往评测的可比性，同时揭示孤立服务基准无法暴露的下游失败，为微服务场景下的 REST API 测试工具提供了更可靠的比较方式。

Abstract: Existing REST API testing benchmarks focus on isolated services, overlooking failures arising from interactions with downstream dependencies. In microservice systems, response bodies and entry-point operations alone cannot reliably distinguish failures, compromising tool comparisons. We present RESTberus, a Kubernetes-based benchmarking platform for black-box REST API testing tools on deployed microservice systems. By complementing API-level evidence with distributed traces, RESTberus can distinguish failures manifesting in the target service from those manifesting in downstream dependencies. Across six tools on two microservice benchmarks, our trace-aware deduplication strategy achieves 87.1% accuracy, outperforming baselines from prior work by 10-13 percentage points. Our empirical study shows that all tools expose downstream failures, accounting for 11.7% of estimated unique failures on average, which isolated-service benchmarks cannot expose. On single-service benchmarks, RESTberus produces statistically equivalent results to RESTgym, demonstrating that integration-level assessments can preserve compatibility with existing tools and comparability with prior evaluations.

</details>


### [511] [Who Is Doing the Thinking? Characterising Human Agency in First-Year Students' AI Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04783)
*Ali Shakiba,Thomas Chaffey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出HADT六层分类法，从提示词本身评估学生的工程贡献（而非AI产出），并在105名学生962条AI日志中验证：多数提示含学生贡献，代理水平随开发阶段变化而非随学生变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI使学生学习过程"隐形"，Bloom分类法等现有框架只能评价AI产出物的认知层次，无法衡量学生自身的贡献，因此需要一个独立于AI输出的、面向提示词的人机贡献度量框架。

Method: 提出Human Agency Depth Taxonomy（HADT），一个初步的六层分类法，综合三个维度：上下文带宽、工程抽象层次、学生代理性。将其应用于一门AI开放的一年级软件工程课程（145名学生）中105名学生结构化AI日志的962条提示，追踪10周内代理水平的变化。

Result: 84.2%的提示含超出"委托"的学生贡献；代理水平与开发生命周期同步：架构探索类提示占需求阶段的48%，第9周起降至5–12%；分析已有系统的提示在构建与验证阶段上升（OR=2.88，且按学生聚类）；层级差异的三分之二来自学生内部，说明代理更多取决于工作阶段而非个人特质；截止周的委托上升在聚类后不显著；明确指定输出约束的提示始终稀少，作者解读为新手知识瓶颈而非教学缺失。

Conclusion: HADT可作为形成性视角考察学生如何与AI互动；代理性主要由开发阶段驱动，对课程与评估设计（鼓励约束指定、按阶段设计AI使用任务）具有启示，但该分类法仍为初步版本。

Abstract: When students use generative AI to produce their work, the learning process becomes invisible. Established frameworks such as Bloom's taxonomy then classify the cognitive level of what the AI produced, not what the student contributed. We propose the Human Agency Depth Taxonomy (HADT), a preliminary six-tier taxonomy that classifies the engineering contribution a student makes in a prompt, independent of the AI's output. HADT combines three dimensions: contextual bandwidth, engineering abstraction and student agency. We applied HADT to 962 prompts from 105 students' structured AI Journals in an AI-permissive, first-year software engineering course of 145 students, and examined how agency changed over ten journalled weeks. Most prompts (84.2%) carried some student contribution beyond delegation. Agency tracked the development lifecycle. Architecture-discovery prompts dominated the requirements phase (48% of turns) and fell to 5-12% from week 9, while prompts analysing existing systems rose during build and verification (odds ratio 2.88, with turns clustered by student). Two-thirds of the variance in tier lay within students, so agency depended more on the phase of work than on the student. A turn-level rise in delegation in deadline weeks did not hold once turns were clustered by student. Explicitly specifying constraints on the AI's output was rare throughout, which we interpret as a knowledge bottleneck for novices rather than a gap in instruction. We discuss implications for course and assessment design, and for using HADT as a formative lens on how students engage with AI.

</details>


### [512] [Reproducibility in open-source RISC-V HW flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04883)
*Peter Kourzanov,Anmol Anmol*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出让RISC-V与可复现构建社区合作，采用Guix解决开源硬件的依赖管理与可复现性问题，并以CVA6为案例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源硬件蓬勃发展但面临碎片化问题，需要鼓励协作与复用，并把创新潜力集中在最有价值处：新微架构、IP及其集成到新SoC与应用中。

Method: 选用Guix这一严格的软件制品可复现方案，将其应用于开源硬件的依赖管理与可复现性问题。

Result: 以CVA6为例，得到完全可复现的打包测试、仿真、模拟与周期精确模型集合，验证了方法有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作流前景可期，未来有望扩展以支持更大的RISC-V社区，提供可复用的软硬件组件用于下一代平台。

Abstract: Open-source hardware is booming. To prevent fragmentation, encourage collaboration and reuse we propose the RISC-V to join forces with Reproducible Builds communities and concentrate innovation potential where its needed most: creation of new micro-architectures, IPs and their integration into new SoCs and applications. To facilitate this goal, we chose Guix, a rigorous solution for reproducible software artefacts. We apply it to dependency management & reproducibility problems in open-source hardware and show the validity of the approach, taking CVA6 as a running example. The end result - a fully reproducible collection of packaged tests, emulation, simulation and cycle-accurate models - shows a promising workflow that could (in future) scale to support larger RISC-V community with reusable software & hardware components for next-generation platforms.

</details>


### [513] [One Strategy Does Not Fit All: Rethinking Data Labeling for Just-in-Time Vulnerability Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05013)
*Quan Tran,Duong Nguyen,Thanh Le-Cong,Triet Huynh Minh Le,M. Ali Babar,Hoang Dieu Vu,Quyet-Thang Huynh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统实证研究了漏洞修复/引入提交的标注策略如何影响JIT漏洞预测的下游任务（分类、优先级排序、定位），发现最优标注策略高度依赖任务，不存在通用最优方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JIT-VP需在提交时识别安全风险，但准确的标签构建困难；不同VFC/VIC标注策略权衡各异导致数据集差异大，使模型性能与数据集构建难以区分，且实际质量保障还需优先级排序和漏洞定位。

Method: 在OpenSSL与Linux内核上，用4种VFC策略×4种VIC策略构建28个数据集，评测6个代表性JIT-VP模型在分类、优先级排序、定位三类任务上的表现。

Result: 标注有效性强烈依赖任务：人工VFC标注+漏洞特定VIC标注在分类与排序上最可靠，显著优于15种替代方案中的11种；精度优先VFC标注+LLM辅助VIC标注在定位上最佳，显著优于15种中的7种。

Conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的标注策略，数据集构建应以任务为导向；研究强调任务导向式数据集构建对JIT-VP实际可靠性的重要性。

Abstract: Just-In-Time Vulnerability Prediction (JIT-VP) identifies security risks in code changes at commit time, enabling early feedback before vulnerabilities enter software systems. However, its practical reliability is challenged by the difficulty of constructing accurate labels. Multiple strategies with different trade-offs have been proposed to identify vulnerability-fixing commits (VFCs) and vulnerability-introducing commits (VICs) for dataset construction, leading to substantially different datasets. This makes it difficult to separate model performance from dataset construction. Moreover, real-world quality assurance requires not only classification but also prioritizing high-risk commits and localizing vulnerable causes. This paper presents an extensive empirical study of how labeling strategies affect these downstream tasks. We constructed 28 datasets using four VFC and four VIC labeling strategies across OpenSSL and Linux kernel, then evaluated six representative JIT-VP models for classification, prioritization, and localization. Our results show that labeling effectiveness is strongly task-dependent. Manual VFC labeling combined with vulnerability-specific VIC labeling provides the most reliable performance for classification and prioritization, significantly outperforming 11 of 15 alternatives. Meanwhile, precision-first VFC labeling combined with LLM-assisted VIC labeling performs best for localization, significantly outperforming 7 of 15 alternatives. These findings demonstrate that no single labeling strategy is universally optimal and highlight the importance of task-oriented dataset construction.

</details>


### [514] [Equal Access, Unequal Gains? GitHub Copilot and Productivity Among Developers with Disabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05056)
*Emeralda Sesari,Daria Ana-Maria Mogoş,Federica Sarro,Ayushi Rastogi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究基于199名自述有残障的GitHub开发者数据，比较GitHub Copilot免费开放前后的活动变化，发现多数残障群体呈"提交次数减少、代码修改量增加"的描述性趋势，但无统计证据表明不同残障群体间变化存在差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI工具在软件开发中的益处是否适用于不同开发者群体尚不明确，尤其对已面临可访问性障碍的残障开发者，且跨多种残障群体的证据有限。

Method: 利用公开的个人资料与仓库数据，构建涵盖多个残障类别的199名开发者数据集，对比Copilot免费开放前后的提交次数与净代码修改行数，并按残障群体分组分析分布变化。

Result: 多数残障群体呈描述性模式：提交更少但修改代码更多；部分群体的提交活动分布向高、低两端移动，中等水平开发者减少；但未发现提交或净修改行数变化在残障群体间存在显著差异的证据。

Conclusion: Copilot的广泛可用性无法被关联为可观测开发活动的普遍增加或减少，变化模式因开发者个体与残障群体而异。

Abstract: Generative AI tools are increasingly used in software development and have been associated with benefits such as faster task completion and improved perceived productivity. However, whether these benefits extend across different developer populations remains unclear. This is especially relevant for developers with disabilities, whose work can already be impacted by accessibility barriers. Yet, evidence remains limited across a broader range of disability groups. This study investigates whether the wider availability of GitHub Copilot is associated with changes in productivity among GitHub users who self-identify as having a disability. Using publicly available profile and repository data, we curated a dataset of 199 developers across multiple disability groups and compared their activity before and after GitHub Copilot became freely available. We found that most disability groups showed a descriptive pattern of fewer commits but more code modified. In several disability groups, the distribution of developers across commit activity levels shifted toward both lower and higher level, leaving fewer developers at moderate level. However, we found no evidence that changes in commits or net lines modified differed across disability groups. These findings suggest that the wider availability of GitHub Copilot cannot be associated with a broad increase or decrease in observable development activity, while patterns of change varied across developers and disability groups.

</details>


### [515] [A Gated Spec-Driven Workflow: An Audit-Trail Study of Coding-Agent Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05094)
*Rodrigo Figueiredo Abdo,Pedro Carvalho Brom*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究 Claude Code 中一种规范驱动开发（SDD）工作流，几乎每个控制都是由被约束的同一模型执行的指令；分析七个项目九个特性的日志，五特性全部任务完成，581 个任务完成 288 个；执行子代理基本守规（仅 1 处未声明改动且被捕获），但编排者自查存在薄弱点，247 次块检查中 11 次记录到未声明改动，仅 4 次停工。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索 SDD 中"控制者与被控制者为同一模型"这一自约束机制的可行性与可靠性，检验分阶段人工审批、评审子代理与文件清单检查是否足以约束编码代理的行为。

Method: 针对 Claude Code 设计并实运行一套 SDD 工作流：以规格、计划、任务清单替代聊天记录驱动；每阶段需用户批准；评审子代理按固定的阶段专属缺陷清单核查产物；执行子代理仅能改动任务列出的文件；每批任务后由编排者做文件清单检查以发现未声明变更。对七个项目九个特性（Fortran 求解器、Python 程序、书籍乃至本文）的日志与对话记录进行分析。

Result: 五/九个特性完成了全部计划任务（含 Fortran 求解器特性）；581 个计划任务完成 288 个。执行子代理仅留下 1 处未声明的交付目录改动，且被检查捕获；其报告显示存在其他协议偏离。薄弱点在编排者：它运行并评判自己的检查，247 次块检查中 11 次记录到未声明改动（多源于作者轮内请求与环境），仅 4 次停止工作。

Conclusion: SDD 工作流在任务执行与文件约束层面有效，但"同一模型自我核查"的编排环节是可靠性瓶颈，需外部或独立校验机制。

Abstract: Spec-driven development (SDD) asks a coding agent to work from specifications, plans, and task lists rather than from the chat transcript. We study one such workflow for Claude Code, in which almost every control is an instruction carried out by the same model that it constrains. The user must approve each stage before the next begins. A reviewer subagent checks each artefact against a fixed, stage-specific defect list, and an executor subagent may only touch the files listed in its task. After each block of tasks, the orchestrator runs a file-inventory check to detect undeclared changes. We analyse the logs and transcripts of nine features in seven projects, all run by the authors, ranging from a Fortran solver and Python programs to books and this paper. Of these, five finished with every planned task done, including the Fortran solver feature, and 288 of the 581 planned tasks were completed block by block. The executor kept to its declared files: it left only one undeclared change in the deliverable folder, and the check caught it, although its reports record other departures from the protocol. The weak point was the orchestrator, which runs and judges its own checks. It recorded undeclared changes in 11 of 247 block checks, mostly from the authors' in-round requests and the environment, and stopped work in only four.

</details>


### [516] [An Investigation on Numerical Bugs in GPU Programs Towards Automated Bug Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05121)
*Ravishka Rathnasuriya,Nidhi Majoju,Zihe Song,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了GPU数值缺陷（GPU-NBs），通过分析GitHub上397个真实缺陷样本，归纳其根因、症状、触发输入模式、测试oracle及修复策略，并提出初步检测工具GPU-NBDetect，在4个库的186个数学函数中检出226个缺陷，其中60个已被开发者确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU程序易受数值缺陷影响，这类缺陷依赖特定输入值或类型、缺乏可靠的错误检查机制与oracle，难以检测、调试和修复；GPU独特的编程惯例和所需领域知识进一步增加了定位根因与修复的难度。因此亟需理解GPU数值缺陷的特征以支撑有效解决方案的设计。

Method: 对GitHub上397个真实世界GPU数值缺陷样本进行实证研究，分析其常见根因、症状、触发输入模式、测试oracle和修复策略；在此基础上设计并实现初步检测工具GPU-NBDetect，覆盖六类缺陷类别。

Result: GPU-NBDetect在4个库的186个数学函数中共检出226个缺陷，其中60个已被开发者确认。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了GPU数值缺陷的特征规律，为GPU-NBs的检测与预防技术奠定基础，并为构建更有效的调试与自动修复工具提供启示。

Abstract: General-purpose graphics processing unit (GPU) computing has emerged as a leading parallel computing paradigm, offering significant performance gains in various domains such as scientific computing and deep learning. However, GPU programs are susceptible to numerical bugs, which can lead to incorrect results or crashes. These bugs are difficult to detect, debug, and fix due to their dependence on specific input values or types and the absence of reliable error-checking mechanisms and oracles. Additionally, the unique programming conventions of GPUs complicate identifying the root causes of bugs, while fixing them requires domain-specific knowledge of GPU computing and numerical libraries. Therefore, understanding the characteristics of GPU numerical bugs (GPU-NBs) is crucial for developing effective solutions. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study of GPU-NBs by analyzing 397 real-world bug samples from GitHub. We identify common root causes, symptoms, input patterns, test oracles that trigger these bugs and the strategies used to fix them. We also present GPU-NBDetect, a preliminary tool designed to detect numerical bugs across six distinct bug categories. GPU-NBDetect detected a total of 226 bugs across 186 mathematical functions in four libraries, with 60 of the bugs confirmed by developers. Our findings lay the groundwork for developing detection and prevention techniques for GPU-NBs and offer insights for building more effective debugging and auto-repair tool.

</details>


### [517] [DSL-Bench: Evaluating and Explaining LLM Code Generation Across Domain-Specific Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05168)
*Zihan Zhou,Mingxi Ye,Yan Gao,Guipeng Wei,Zibin Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 DSL-Bench，首个跨领域特定语言（DSL）的可执行代码生成基准与分析框架，基于 13,045 篇论文梳理出 18 个代表性领域，揭示 LLM 在 DSL 上语法通过率远高于语义正确率的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准多聚焦通用编程语言，而 DSL 在语法、语义和验证要求上差异显著，单个 DSL 基准的结果难以横向比较，缺乏统一的跨 DSL 评估手段。

Method: 从 13,045 篇 DSL 相关论文出发，借助 LLM 辅助开放式卡片分类确定 18 个代表应用领域，每个领域选取一个可评估 DSL 并提供语法检查器与任务级语义预言机；用 7 个 LLM 在 18 个 DSL 上评测，并进行方差分解以归因语义通过率差异，分析 4 个 DSL 层面因素，评估全量 DSL 上的提示工程及 5 个目标 DSL 上的 5 种改进方法。

Result: 平均语法通过率 31.37%、语义通过率 11.64%；语义通过率方差 76.99% 归因于 DSL 间差异，仅 7.86% 归因于模型差异；Knowledge Demand 与语义正确性负相关最强（r = -0.508）；提示工程收益不均衡，RAG-Refinement 平均提升 16.29 个百分点；并给出能力画像与 DSL-Profiler 摘要以解释数据稀缺的 DSL。

Conclusion: DSL 代码生成的关键瓶颈在于工具链相关的语义正确性而非语法接受度，评估需超越语法层面；DSL 本身的特性比模型选择更主导结果，针对性方法如 RAG-Refinement 能带来实质改善。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software-engineering workflows, but code-generation benchmarks largely focus on general-purpose languages. Domain-specific languages (DSLs) have distinct syntax, semantics, and validation requirements, making results from individual DSL benchmarks difficult to compare. We present DSL-Bench, an executable benchmark and analysis framework for cross-DSL code generation. Starting from 13,045 DSL-related papers, LLM-assisted open card sorting identifies 18 representative application domains. For each domain, we select an evaluable DSL and provide a syntax checker and task-level semantic oracle. Evaluating 7 LLMs on 18 DSLs, we observe mean syntax and semantic pass rates of 31.37% and 11.64%, respectively, revealing a substantial gap between syntax acceptance and semantic correctness. A variance decomposition attributes 76.99% of semantic pass-rate variation to differences among DSLs and 7.86% to differences among models. Among four DSL-level factors, Knowledge Demand has the strongest negative association with semantic correctness (r = -0.508). We evaluate prompt engineering across all 18 DSLs and study five improvement methods on five targeted DSLs. Prompt engineering yields uneven gains; RAG-Refinement, the strongest targeted method, improves semantic correctness by 16.29 percentage points on average over matched baselines. We further derive capability profiles and DSL-Profiler summaries for interpreting data-scarce DSLs. These results highlight toolchain-specific semantic bottlenecks and the need to evaluate DSL code generation beyond syntax acceptance.

</details>


### [518] [Extending the MM-AR Metamodeling Platform with Process Mining Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05176)
*Geraldine Hürzeler,Hans-Georg Fill,Daniel Borcard*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个概念验证，通过独立的Python服务将PM4Py流程挖掘能力集成到XR元模型平台MM-AR中，无需修改平台核心，实现2D/3D模型的流程发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流程挖掘结果通常是二维可视化，与企业模型创建维护环境相分离；XR元模型平台（如MM-AR）虽支持2D/3D建模，却无法访问事件数据或挖掘算法。

Method: 通过基于开源PM4Py库的独立Python服务扩展XR平台，保持平台核心不变；使用三种常见发现算法从CSV或XES日志生成Petri网和BPMN模型，并用四个公开事件日志做技术评估。

Result: 16种配置下模型实例元素数量均与PM4Py模型一致；每次运行增加约8–53秒开销，且开销随发现模型规模而非日志规模增长。

Conclusion: 集成成功建立基础，原型尚未利用第三维编码流程信息，为后续XR流程挖掘研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Process mining derives process models from event data recorded by information systems, but its results are usually presented as two-dimensional visualizations that are separate from the environments in which enterprise models are created and maintained. Metamodeling platforms for extended reality (XR), such as MM-AR, allow users to define modeling languages and to display models in 2D and 3D, but they do not provide access to event data or mining algorithms so far. In this paper we therefore present a first proof-of-concept for showing how an XR-based metamodeling platform can be extended with process discovery capabilities without changes to the platform core through a separate Python service based on the open source PM4Py process mining library. We demonstrate the approach using three common discovery algorithms for obtaining Petri nets and BPMN models based on CSV or XES event logs. A technical evaluation using four public event logs shows that the element counts of the created model instances match those of the PM4Py models in all 16 configurations. The integration adds between about 8 and 53 seconds per run, and this overhead grows with the size of the discovered model rather than the size of the event log. Although the prototype does not yet use the third dimension to encode process information, it established the foundations for studying such approaches.

</details>


### [519] [Noisy Issues, Noisy Results: Mislabeling in Information Retrieval-based Bug Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05314)
*Moumita Asad,Rafed Muhammad Yasir,Yirui He,Ziyao He,Sam Malek*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文大规模实证分析IRBL评测基准中缺陷报告标签错误（mislabeling）的普遍性与影响：平均34.82%的issue被错标；剔除错标issue后六种IRBL技术性能MRR下降4.68%–21.74%，但不改变技术相对排名，仅影响性能差距幅度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IRBL评测依赖issue跟踪系统中的标签，而既往研究表明开源项目的issue标签常不正确，威胁评测有效性。已有研究只考察传统IRBL技术、小规模数据，且忽视了噪声数据集与清洗数据集之间的部分重叠，缺少对现代方法（深度学习、LLM）的大规模系统分析。

Method: 构建含5个基准数据集、超过55,000条issue报告的大规模实证研究：先统计错标issue的普遍性；再在广泛使用的Ye et al.基准上，用考虑数据集重叠的统计方法评测六种IRBL技术（传统、深度学习、大语言模型三类）。

Result: 平均34.82%的issue被错标；从评测集中移除错标issue后，六种技术测得的性能均显著下降，MRR降低4.68%–21.74%；错标不改变技术的相对排名，但改变其性能差异的幅度。

Conclusion: 标签错误显著高估IRBL性能并扭曲性能差距幅度，可靠的评测数据对于IRBL技术间的有效、有意义比较至关重要；后续基准构建与评测应重视issue标签质量。

Abstract: Information Retrieval-based Bug Localization (IRBL) leverages bug reports to identify faulty source files. Evaluations of IRBL approaches primarily rely on labeled issues from issue tracking systems. However, prior research has shown that issue labels are frequently incorrect in open-source projects, threatening the validity of IRBL evaluations. Existing studies have primarily examined traditional IRBL techniques on small datasets, overlooking modern approaches and the partial overlap between noisy and cleaned datasets. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale empirical study to investigate the prevalence and impact of mislabeled issues in IRBL benchmarks. We analyze five benchmark datasets comprising over 55,000 issue reports and find that, on average, 34.82% of issues are mislabeled. We further evaluate six IRBL techniques, spanning traditional, deep learning-based, and large language model-based approaches using the widely adopted Ye et al. benchmark and statistical methods that account for dataset overlap. Our results show that removing mislabeled issues from evaluation datasets significantly reduces measured performance across all six techniques, with Mean Reciprocal Rank decreasing by 4.68%-21.74%. Although mislabeling does not change the relative ranking of techniques, it affects the magnitude of their performance differences. These findings highlight the importance of reliable evaluation data for ensuring valid and meaningful comparisons of IRBL techniques.

</details>
